info.description: 5E Advanced Materials, Inc. is an exploration stage company, which engages in the provision of boron and lithium properties in Australia and the United States. It focuses on supplying boron specialty materials, complemented by lithium co-product production. The company was founded on September 23, 2021 and is headquartered in Hesperia, CA.
info.description_zh: 5E Advanced Materials, Inc.是一家處於勘探階段的公司，主要在澳洲和美國提供硼和鋰資源。它專注於供應硼特種材料，並輔以鋰副產品生產。該公司成立於2021年9月23日，總部位於加州希斯皮里亞。

info.description: Vicor Corp. engages in the design, development, manufacture, and marketing of modular power components. The firm provides complete power systems based upon a portfolio of patented technologies. Its products include AC-DC converters, power systems, and accessories. The company was founded by Patrizio Vinciarelli in 1981 and is headquartered in Andover, MA.

Canary Staked SUI ETF is a spot digital asset exchange-traded product that provides regulated exposure to the price of SUI, the native token of the Sui Layer-1 blockchain, while simultaneously participating in the network's proof-of-stake validation process. The fund enables investors to capture both the price performance of SUI and net in-kind staking rewards, which are reflected in the fund's net asset value (NAV) without the need for direct digital wallet management.
info.description_zh: Canary Staked SUI ETF 是一種現貨數位資產交易所交易產品，提供受監管的 SUI（Sui Layer-1 區塊鏈的原生代幣）價格曝險，同時參與網路的權益證明驗證過程。該基金使投資者能夠捕獲 SUI 的價格表現和淨實物質押獎勵，這些獎勵反映在基金的資產淨值（NAV）中，而無需直接數位錢包管理。

info.description: Illumina, Inc. engages in the development, manufacturing, and marketing of life science tools and integrated systems for large-scale analysis of genetic variation and function. The company was founded by David R. Walt, John R. Stuelpnagel, Anthony W. Czarnik, Lawrence A. Bock, and Mark S. Chee in April 1998 and is headquartered in San Diego, CA.
info.description_zh: Illumina, Inc. 從事生命科學工具和整合系統的開發、製造和行銷，用於大規模遺傳變異和功能分析。該公司由 David R. Walt、John R. Stuelpnagel、Anthony W. Czarnik、Lawrence A. Bock 和 Mark S. Chee 於 1998 年 4 月創立，總部位於加利福尼亞州聖地亞哥。

info.description: FormFactor, Inc. engages in the provision of test and measurement solutions. It operates through the Probe Cards and Systems segments. The Probe Cards segment consists of technologies and product architectures, including micro-electromechanical systems technologies. The Systems segment consists of analytical probe solutions for on-wafer probing, board tests, and package tests. The company was founded by Igor Khandros on April 15, 1993 and is headquartered in Livermore, CA.
info.description_zh: FormFactor, Inc. 致力於提供測試和測量解決方案。它透過探針卡和系統部門運作。探針卡部分由技術和產品架構組成，包括微機電系統技術。系統部門包括用於晶圓探測、電路板測試和封裝測試的分析探針解決方案。該公司由 Igor Khandros 於 1993 年 4 月 15 日創立，總部位於加州利弗莫爾。

info.description: ChipMOS Technologies, Inc. provides total semiconductor testing and packaging solutions to fabless companies, integrated device manufacturers (IDM) and foundries. It operates through the segment Testing, Assembly, Crystal Display and other Flat-Panel Display Driver Semiconductors (LCDD), Bumping, and Others. The company was founded on July 28, 1997 and is headquartered in Hsinchu, Taiwan.

Fastly, Inc. provides real-time content delivery network services. It offers edge compute, edge delivery, edge security, edge applications like load balancing and image optimization, video on demand, and managed edge delivery. The company was founded by Artur Bergman, Tyler McMullen, Simon Wistow, and Gil Penchina in March 2011 and is headquartered in San Francisco, CA.

OraSure Technologies, Inc. engages in the development, manufacture, and distribution of point of care diagnostic tests and molecular collection devices designed to detect or diagnose critical medical conditions. It operates through the OSUR and DNAG segments. The OSUR segment offers oral fluid diagnostic products and specimen collection devices. The DNAG segment produces specimen collection kits that are used to collect, stabilize, transport, and store samples of genetic material for molecular testing in the consumer genetic, clinical genetic, academic research, pharmacogenomics, personalized medicine, microbiome, and animal genetics markets. The company was founded by Michael J. Gausling in 2000 in and is headquartered in Bethlehem, PA.

Xometry, Inc. offers an AI-powered marketplace, the popular Thomasnet industrial sourcing platform, and a suite of cloud-based services. Xometry's marketplaces use proprietary AI to help buyers efficiently source custom-manufactured parts and assemblies and attain instant pricing and lead times. The AI enables a rapidly growing network of manufacturers to select the optimal jobs to fill capacity. The firm's suite of cloud-based services and Thomasnet industrial sourcing platform help manufacturers and industrial service providers grow businesses using advertising, marketing, and financial services. It operates through the following geographical segments: the United States and International. The company was founded by Laurence Zuriff and Randolph Altschuler in 2013 and is headquartered in North Bethesda, MD.
info.description_zh: Xometry, Inc. 提供人工智慧驅動的市場、受歡迎的 Thomasnet 工業採購平台以及一套基於雲端的服務。 Xometry 的市場使用專有的人工智慧來幫助買家有效地購買客製化製造的零件和組件，並獲得即時定價和交貨時間。人工智慧使快速成長的製造商網路能夠選擇最佳工作來填補產能。該公司的基於雲端的服務套件和 Thomasnet 工業採購平台可協助製造商和工業服務供應商利用廣告、行銷和金融服務發展業務。它透過以下地理部門運作：美國和國際。該公司由 Laurence Zuriff 和 Randolph Altschuler 於 2013 年創立，總部位於馬裡蘭州北貝塞斯達。

info.description: Mereo BioPharma Group Plc is a biopharmaceutical company, which engages in the development and commercialization of therapeutics that aim to improve outcomes for oncology and rare diseases. Its portfolio include Etigilimab (MPH-313), Alvelestat (MPH-966), Setrusumab (BPS-804), Navicixizumab (OMP-305B83), Acumapimod (BCT-197), and Leflutrozole (BGS-649). The company was founded by Denise Vera Scots-Knight, Charles Edward Sermon, Alastair Graham MacKinnon, and John P. Richard in March 10, 2015 and is headquartered in London, the United Kingdom.
info.description_zh: Mereo BioPharma Group Plc 是一家生物製藥公司，致力於治療藥物的開發和商業化，旨在改善腫瘤和罕見疾病的治療結果。其產品組合包括 Etigilimab (MPH-313)、Alvelestat (MPH-966)、Setrusumab (BPS-804)、Navicixizumab (OMP-305B83)、Acumapimod (BCT-197) 和 Leflutrozole (BGS-649)。該公司由 Denise Vera Scots-Knight、Charles Edward Sermon、Alastair Graham MacKinnon 和 John P. Richard 於 2015 年 3 月 10 日創立，總部位於英國倫敦。

info.description: Rambus, Inc. is a global semiconductor company providing industry chips and silicon IP for data-intensive computing systems, focusing on data center and artificial intelligence (AI) infrastructure. Its products include Memory Interface Chips, Interface IP, and Security IP. The company was founded by P. Michael Farmwald and Mark A. Horowitz in March 1990 and is headquartered in San Jose, CA.

Lakefront Biotherapeutics is a biotechnology company, which engages in the identification and development of small molecule and antibody therapies. Its clinical pipeline includes filgotinib, GLP3667, Toledo program, and idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis. The company was founded by Onno van de Stolpe, Rudi Pauwels, and Helmuth van Es on June 30, 1999 and is headquartered in Mechelen, Belgium.
info.description_zh: Lakefront Biotherapeutics 是一家生物技術公司，從事小分子和抗體療法的鑑定和開發。其臨床管線包括filgotinib、GLP3667、Toledo計畫、特發性肺纖維化等。該公司由 Onno van de Stolpe、Rudi Pauwels 和 Helmuth van Es 於 1999 年 6 月 30 日創立，總部位於比利時梅赫倫。

info.description: Astera Labs, Inc. provides rack-scale AI infrastructure through purpose-built connectivity solutions. The company offers a range of semiconductor-based connectivity solutions designed to address bandwidth, latency, and reliability challenges in AI and cloud data centers. The company was founded by Jitendra Mohan, Casey Morrison, and Sanjay Gajendra in October 2017 and headquartered in San Jose, CA.

Fossil Group, Inc. engages in the design, marketing and distribution of consumer fashion accessories. The firm operates through the following geographical segments: Americas, Europe, and Asia. Its products include men's and women's fashion watches, jewelry, handbags, small leather goods, belts, sunglasses, shoes, soft accessories and clothing which are sold through department stores, specialty retail locations, specialty watch and jewelry stores, owned retail and factory outlet stores, mass market stores, owned, and affiliate internet sites. The company was founded by Tom Kartsotis in 1984 and is headquartered in Richardson, TX.
info.description_zh: Fossil Group, Inc. 從事消費時尚配件的設計、行銷和分銷。該公司透過以下地理區域開展業務：美洲、歐洲和亞洲。其產品包括男士和女士時尚手錶、珠寶、手袋、小皮具、皮帶、太陽眼鏡、鞋子、軟配件和服裝，透過百貨公司、專賣零售店、專賣手錶和珠寶店、自營零售店和工廠直銷店、大眾市場商店、自營和附屬網路網站銷售。該公司由 Tom Kartsotis 於 1984 年創立，總部位於德克薩斯州理查森。

info.description: CEVA, Inc. engages in the provision of silicon and software intellectual property solutions that enable smart edge products to connect, sense, and infer data. Its products include Ceva-Waves Links, Ceva-Waves Wi-Fi, Ceva-Waves Dragonfly, Ceva-XC23, Ceva-XC21, Ceva-Waves Bluetooth, Ceva-Waves UWB, Ceva-PentaG2, and Ceva-PentaG RAN. The company was founded on November 22, 1999 and is headquartered in Rockville, MD.

Riot Platforms, Inc. is a bitcoin mining company, which engages in the provision of special cryptocurrency mining computers. It invests in Verady, Coinsquare, and Tess. It operates through the Bitcoin Mining and Engineering segments. The Bitcoin Mining segment focuses on maximizing ability to successfully mine Bitcoin by growing hash rate. The Engineering segment designs and manufactures power distribution equipment and custom engineered electrical products that provides them the ability to vertically integrate many of the critical electrical components and engineering service. The company was founded on July 24, 2000 and is headquartered in Castle Rock, CO.

Allient, Inc. is a global engineering and manufacturing enterprise that engages in the designing, manufacturing and sale of precision and specialty-controlled motion components and systems used in a broad range of industries, including industrial, vehicle, medical, and aerospace and defense. The company was founded in 1962 and is headquartered in Buffalo, NY.
info.description_zh: Allient, Inc. 是一家全球性工程和製造企業，從事設計、製造和銷售精密和專業控制運動部件和系統，這些部件和系統廣泛應用於工業、車輛、醫療、航空航太和國防等行業。該公司成立於 1962 年，總部位於紐約州布法羅。

info.description: 21Shares Active Crypto ETF is an actively managed exchange-traded fund that primarily invests in a diversified selection of digital assets and related instruments to achieve total return based on active market repositioning. The strategy utilizes a systematic screening framework requiring underlying tokens to possess a minimum 12-month trading history, a $25 million average daily trading volume over the trailing 30 days, and active quotation across at least three distinct marketplaces, while explicitly prohibiting exposure to speculative meme tokens lacking fundamental functional utility.

GraniteShares 2x Long ISRG Daily ETF seeks daily investment results, before fees and expenses, of 2 times (200%) the daily percentage change of the common stock of Intuitive Surgical, Inc. The fund is an actively managed exchange traded fund that attempts to replicate 2 times (200%) the daily percentage change of the Underlying Stock by entering into financial instruments such as swaps and options Underlying Stock as well as directly purchasing the Underlying Stock. The fund will aim to primarily obtain its notional exposure against the Underlying Stock through swap agreements.
info.description_zh: GraniteShares 2x Long ISRG Daily ETF 在尋求扣除費用和開支之前，Intuitive Surgical, Inc. 普通股每日百分比變化的 2 倍 (200%) 的每日投資結果。該基金是一檔主動管理的交易所交易基金，試圖透過簽訂掉期和選擇權等金融工具以及直接購買基礎股票來複製基礎股票每日百分比變化的 2 倍 (200%)。該基金的目標主要是透過掉期協議獲得其標的股票的名義曝險。

info.description: GSR Crypto Core3 ETF provides diversified exposure to a basket of major digital assets, specifically Bitcoin, Ethereum, and Solana, utilizing a proprietary dynamic allocation framework. The strategy combines direct holdings-facilitated via a subsidiary to enable staking capabilities on eligible assets-and indirect exposure through various exchange-traded products to capture potential price appreciation alongside staking yield.

GraniteShares 2x Long MRVL Daily ETF seeks daily investment results, before fees and expenses, of 2 times (200%) the daily percentage change of the common stock of Marvell Technology, Inc. (NASDAQ: MRVL). The fund is an actively managed exchange traded fund that attempts to replicate 2 times (200%) the daily percentage change the underlying stock by entering into financial instruments such as swaps and options underlying stock as well as directly purchasing the underlying stock. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: GraniteShares 2x Long MRVL Daily ETF 尋求每日投資結果（扣除費用和開支）為 Marvell Technology, Inc.（納斯達克股票代碼：MRVL）普通股每日百分比變化的 2 倍（200%）。該基金是一檔主動管理的交易所交易基金，試圖透過進入掉期和選擇權標的股票等金融工具以及直接購買標的股票來複製標的股票每日百分比變化的兩倍（200%）。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Twist Bioscience Corp. engages in the development of a proprietary semiconductor-based synthetic DNA manufacturing process. It operates through the following geographical segments: Americas, EMEA, and APAC. The Americas segment consists of the United States of America, Canada, Mexico, and South America. The EMEA segment includes Europe, Middle East, and Africa. The APAC segment focuses on Japan, China, South Korea, India, Singapore, Malaysia, and Australia. The company was founded by William Marine Banyai, Emily Marine Leproust, and Bill James Peck in 2013 and is headquartered in San Francisco, CA.
info.description_zh: Twist Bioscience Corp. 致力於開發基於半導體的專有合成 DNA 製造流程。它透過以下地理區域開展業務：美洲、歐洲、中東和非洲和亞太地區。美洲部分包括美國、加拿大、墨西哥和南美洲。歐洲、中東和非洲地區包括歐洲、中東和非洲。亞太地區市場主要集中在日本、中國、韓國、印度、新加坡、馬來西亞和澳洲。該公司由 William Marine Banyai、Emily Marine Leproust 和 Bill James Peck 於 2013 年創立，總部位於加州舊金山。

info.description: GraniteShares 2x Long MARA Daily ETF seeks daily investment results, before fees and expenses, of 2 times (200%) the daily percentage change of the common stock of MARA Holdings Inc. (NASDAQ: MARA). The fund is an actively managed exchange traded fund that attempts to replicate 2 times (200%) the daily percentage change the underlying stock by entering into financial instruments such as swaps and options underlying stock as well as directly purchasing the underlying stock. The fund is non-diversified.

First Trust NASDAQ-100-Technology Sector Index Fund seeks investment results that correspond generally to the price and yield (before the fund's fees and expenses) of an equity index called the NASDAQ-100 Technology Sector TM Index. The fund will normally invest at least 90% of its net assets (including investment borrowings) in the securities that comprise the index. The index is an equal-weighted index composed of the securities comprising the NASDAQ-100 Index that are classified as "technology" according to the Industry Classification Benchmark classification system.
info.description_zh: First Trust NASDAQ-100-Technology Sector Index Fund 尋求的投資結果通常與稱為 NASDAQ-100 Technology Sector TM Index 的股票指數的價格和收益率（在基金費用和開支之前）相對應。該基金通常將至少 90% 的淨資產（包括投資借款）投資於構成該指數的證券。該指數是一個等權重指數，由納斯達克 100 指數中根據行業分類基準分類系統歸類為「科技」的證券組成。

info.description: Fidelity Disruptive Technology ETF seeks long-term growth of capital. The fund normally invests at least 80% of assets in securities of disruptive technology companies. Fidelity's disruptive strategies seek to identify innovative developments that could signal new directions for delivering products and services to customers. Generally, these companies have or are developing new or unconventional ways of doing business that could disrupt and displace incumbents over time. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 富達顛覆性技術 ETF 尋求資本的長期成長。該基金通常將至少 80% 的資產投資於顛覆性科技公司的證券。富達的顛覆性策略旨在識別創新發展，這些發展可能標誌著向客戶提供產品和服務的新方向。一般來說，這些公司已經或正在開發新的或非常規的經營方式，隨著時間的推移，這些方式可能會顛覆和取代現有企業。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: iShares Semiconductor ETF seeks to track the investment results of the ICE Semiconductor Index composed of U.S. equities in the semiconductor sector. The fund generally will invest at least 80% of its assets in the component securities of its index and in investments that have economic characteristics that are substantially identical to the component securities of its index and may invest up to 20% of its assets in certain futures, options and swap contracts, cash and cash equivalents. The fund is non-diversified.

VanEck Fabless Semiconductor ETF seeks to replicate as closely as possible, before fees and expenses, the price and yield performance of the MarketVector US Listed Fabless Semiconductor Index. The fund normally invests at least 80% of its total assets in securities that comprise the fund's benchmark index. The Fabless Index is composed of U.S.-listed common stocks of companies that derive at least 50% of their revenues from the semiconductor industry and operate as fabless semiconductor companies. The fund is non-diversified.

Invesco PHLX Semiconductor ETF seeks to track the investment results (before fees and expenses) of the PHLX Semiconductor Sector Index . The fund generally will invest at least 90% of its total assets in the securities that comprise the underlying index. Strictly in accordance with its guidelines and mandated procedures, Nasdaq compiles the underlying index, which is a modified market-capitalization weighted index designed to measure the performance of the 30 largest companies listed in the United States that are engaged in the semiconductor business, as determined by the index Provider. The fund is non-diversified.

Eaton Corp. Plc is a power management company, which provides energy-efficient solutions for electrical, hydraulic, and mechanical power. It operates through the following segments: Electrical Americas and Electrical Global; Aerospace, Vehicle, and eMobility. The Electrical Americas and Electrical Global segments engage in sales contracts for electrical components, industrial components, power distribution and assemblies, residential products, single and three phase power quality, wiring devices, circuit protection, utility power distribution, power reliability equipment, and service. The Aerospace segment supplies aerospace fuel, hydraulics, and pneumatic systems for commercial and military use. The Vehicle segment deals with the design, manufacture, marketing, and supply of drivetrain and powertrain systems and critical components that reduce emissions and improve fuel economy, stability, performance and safety of cars, light trucks and commercial vehicles. The eMobility segment designs, manufactures, markets, and supplies electrical and electronic components and systems that improve the power management and performance of both on-road and off-road vehicles. The company was founded in 1911 and is headquartered in Dublin, Ireland.
info.description_zh: 伊頓公司是一家電力管理公司，為電力、液壓和機械動力提供節能解決方案。它透過以下部門運作：Electrical Americas 和 Electrical Global；航空航太、車輛和電動車。 Electrical Americas 和 Electrical Global 部門從事電氣元件、工業元件、配電和組件、住宅產品、單相和三相電能品質、接線設備、電路保護、公用配電、電力可靠性設備和服務的銷售合約。航空航太部門提供商業和軍事用途的航空燃料、液壓和氣動系統。車輛部門從事傳動系統和動力系統以及關鍵部件的設計、製造、行銷和供應，以減少排放並提高轎車、輕型卡車和商用車的燃油經濟性、穩定性、性能和安全性。電動交通部門設計、製造、行銷和供應電氣和電子元件及系統，以改善公路和越野車輛的電源管理和性能。該公司成立於1911年，總部位於愛爾蘭都柏林。

info.description: Invesco DWA Technology Momentum ETF seeks to track the investment results (before fees and expenses) of the Dorsey Wright Technology Technical Leaders Index (the "underlying index"). The fund generally will invest at least 90% of its total assets in the securities that comprise the underlying index. The underlying index is composed of at least 30 securities of companies in the technology sector that have powerful relative strength or "momentum" characteristics.
info.description_zh: Invesco DWA Technology Momentum ETF 旨在追蹤 Dorsey Wright Technology Technical Leaders Index（「基礎指數」）的投資結果（扣除費用和開支之前）。該基金通常將至少 90% 的總資產投資於構成標的指數的證券。標的指數由至少 30 家科技業公司的證券組成，這些公司具有強大的相對實力或「動量」特徵。

info.description: CYBER HORNET S&P 500 and Ethereum 75/25 Strategy ETF seeks to replicate, before fees and expenses, the total return of the S&P 500 and S&P Ether Futures 75/25 Blend Index. The index measures the weighted return performance of a multi-asset strategy that consists of a 75% weight in the S&P 500 Index and a 25% weight in the S&P Ether Futures Index. The fund will invest approximately 75% of its assets in the stock of large U.S. companies that comprise the S&P 500 Index and will invest in Ether futures contracts so that the total value of the Ether to which the fund has economic exposure is approximately 25% of the assets of the fund.
info.description_zh: CYBER HORNET S&P 500 和以太坊 75/25 策略 ETF 力求在扣除費用和開支之前複製 S&P 500 和 S&P 以太期貨 75/25 混合指數的總回報。該指數衡量多元資產策略的加權回報表現，其中標普 500 指數權重為 75%，標普以太期貨指數權重為 25%。該基金將把約75%的資產投資於構成標準普爾500指數的美國大型公司的股票，並將投資於以太坊期貨合約，以便該基金所擁有的經濟風險敞口的以太幣總價值約佔該基金資產的25%。

info.description: Graniteshares YieldBOOST AMD ETF seeks to seek current income and to exposure to the performance of one or more exchange-traded funds whose shares trade on a U.S.-regulated securities exchange and that seek daily leverage investment results of 2 times (200%) the daily percentage of the common stock of Advanced Micro Devices, Inc. (NASDAQ: AMD) subject to a limit on potential investment gains. The fund will invest at least 80% of its net assets (plus any borrowings for investment purposes) in derivatives contracts that utilize the Underlying AMD ETF as the reference asset. The fund is non-diversified.

Direxion Daily TSM Bull 2X Shares seeks daily investment results, before fees and expenses, of 200% of the daily performance of TSM. The fund, under normal circumstances, invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus any borrowings for investment purposes) in the securities of TSM and financial instruments, such as swap agreements and options, that, in combination, provide 2X daily leveraged exposure to TSM, consistent with the fund's investment objective. The fund is non-diversified.

GraniteShares 2x Long TSM Daily ETF seeks daily investment results of2 times (200%) the daily percentage change of the ADR of Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Co Ltd (NYSE: TSM). The fund is an actively managed exchange traded fund that attempts to replicate 2 times (200%) daily percentage change of the underlying stock by entering into financial instruments such as swaps and options on the underlying stock as well as as directly purchasing the underlying stock. The fund is non-diversified.

Mango Growth ETF is an actively managed ETF. The fund seeks long-term capital appreciation by investing primarily in the common stock of companies that the fund manager believes have high growth characteristics. The fund manager considers a company to have high growth characteristics if it demonstrates consistently strong year-over-year growth across multiple fundamental and market-based metrics. These may include, but are not limited to, sustained increases in sales, earnings, and cash flows, as well as positive share price trends over a specified evaluation period. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 芒果成長ETF是主動式管理型ETF。該基金透過主要投資於基金經理人認為具有高成長特徵的公司的普通股來尋求長期資本增值。如果一家公司在多個基本面和基於市場的指標上表現出持續強勁的同比增長，基金經理就會認為該公司具有高成長特徵。這些可能包括但不限於銷售額、收益和現金流量的持續成長，以及在特定評估期間內積極的股價趨勢。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Nomura Transformational Technologies ETF is an actively managed fund targeting capital growth by investing in global technology companies at the forefront of secular shifts and disruptive innovations. The strategy emphasizes a bottom-up stock selection process to identify businesses across any market capitalization that demonstrate high barriers to entry and the potential for rapid earnings growth relative to the broader economy.
info.description_zh: 野村轉型技術 ETF 是一檔積極管理的基金，透過投資處於長期變革和顛覆性創新前沿的全球科技公司來實現資本成長。該策略強調自下而上的選股流程，以識別任何市值的企業，這些企業表現出較高的進入障礙以及相對於更廣泛的經濟而言具有快速盈利增長潛力的企業。

info.description: Leverage Shares 2X Long BLSH Daily ETF seeks daily levered investment results, before fees and expenses, of two times (200%) of the daily percentage change in the price of the common stock of BLSH. The fund invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus borrowings for investment purposes) in the underlying security and financial instruments with economic characteristics that, in combination, provide 200% daily leveraged exposure to the price of the underlying security, consistent with the fund's investment objective. It is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 槓桿股票 2 倍多頭 BLSH 每日 ETF 尋求 BLSH 普通股價格每日百分比變化兩倍 (200%) 的每日槓桿投資結果（扣除費用和開支）。該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上用於投資目的的借款）投資於標的證券和具有經濟特徵的金融工具，這些證券和金融工具結合起來提供標的證券價格的 200% 每日槓桿敞口，與基金的投資目標一致。它是非多元化的。

info.description: GraniteShares YieldBOOST TSM ETF is an actively managed ETF designed to generate high levels of monthly and weekly income. The fund primarily employs an options-based strategy, selling put options on a leveraged ETF that tracks Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Co. Ltd. (TSM) ADR. By selling these options, the fund seeks to capture premium income, with secondary objectives of gaining exposure to the performance of the underlying leveraged ETF, subject to a cap on potential investment gains.
info.description_zh: GraniteShares YieldBOOST TSM ETF 是一款主動管理的 ETF，旨在產生高水準的月度和周收入。該基金主要採用基於選擇權的策略，出售追蹤台積電 (TSM) ADR 的槓桿 ETF 的看跌期權。透過出售這些選擇權，該基金尋求獲取溢價收入，次要目標是獲得基礎槓桿 ETF 表現的曝險，但須遵守潛在投資收益的上限。

info.description: Manzil Russell Halal USA Broad Market ETF seeks to track the total return performance, before fees and expenses, of the Russell IdealRatings Manzil Halal USA Broad Market Custom Index. The fund uses a "passive management" approach to track the performance of the index. The index is composed of the common stock of large capitalization U.S. companies. The index is constructed by evaluating the components of the index, using the Russell IdealRatings system, to identify companies that comply with Shariah principles. These ratings were developed based on the AAOFI. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Manzil Russell Halal USA Broad Market ETF 旨在追蹤 Russell IdealRatings Manzil Halal USA Broad Market Custom Index 扣除費用和開支之前的總回報表現。該基金採用「被動管理」的方式來追蹤指數的表現。該指數由大型美國公司的普通股組成。該指數是透過使用 Russell IdealRatings 系統評估該指數的組成部分來建構的，以識別符合伊斯蘭教法原則的公司。這些評級是根據 AAOFI 制定的。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Xtrackers Semiconductor Select Equity ETF seeks investment results that correspond generally to the performance, before fees and expenses, of the Solactive Semiconductor ESG Screened Index. The fund, using a "passive" or indexing investment approach, seeks investment results that correspond generally to the performance, before fees and expenses, of the underlying index, which is comprised of companies that have business operations in the semiconductor industry and that fulfill certain sustainability criteria. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Xtrackers Semiconductor Select Equity ETF 尋求與 Solactive Semiconductor ESG 篩選指數的表現（未計費用和開支）大致相符的投資結果。該基金採用「被動」或指數投資方法，尋求與相關指數（未計費用和開支）的表現大致相對應的投資結果，該指數由在半導體行業開展業務並滿足某些可持續性標準的公司組成。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Social Commerce Partners Corp. is a blank check company, which engages in the purpose of effecting a merger, amalgamation, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, reorganization or similar business combination with one or more businesses. The company was founded on August 11, 2025 and is headquartered in Plano, TX.
info.description_zh: Social Commerce Partners Corp. 是一家空白支票公司，其目的是與一個或多個企業進行合併、合併、股份交換、資產收購、股份購買、重組或類似業務合併。該公司成立於2025年8月11日，總部位於德克薩斯州普萊諾。

info.description: Spear Alpha ETF seeks long-term capital growth. The fund is an actively-managed exchange-traded fund ("ETF") that will invest primarily in equity securities, including common stock or American depositary receipts ("ADRs") of companies that Spear Advisors LLC (the "Adviser") believes are poised to benefit from breakthrough innovation in industrial technology. The Adviser defines "innovation in industrial technology" as those technological developments that are transforming or have the potential to transform the industrial sector. It is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Spear Alpha ETF 尋求長期資本成長。該基金是一檔主動管理的交易所交易基金（「ETF」），主要投資於股票證券，包括 Spear Advisors LLC（「顧問」）認為有望從工業技術突破性創新中受益的公司的普通股或美國存託憑證（「ADR」）。顧問將「工業技術創新」定義為那些正在改變或有潛力改變工業部門的技術發展。它是非多元化的。

info.description: STF Tactical Growth ETF seeks long-term growth of capital. The fund is an actively-managed ETF that seeks to achieve its investment objective by allocating its investments among a combination of (i) U.S. equity securities or ETFs that, in the aggregate, seek to replicate the Nasdaq-100 Index (the "Index Allocation"), (ii) directly in, or in ETFs that hold, long-duration U.S. Treasury securities (the "Fixed Income Allocation"), and (iii) short-term U.S. Treasury bills, money market funds, and cash and/or cash equivalents (the "Cash Equivalents"). It is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: STF Tactical Growth ETF 尋求資本的長期成長。該基金是一款主動管理型 ETF，旨在透過將其投資分配到以下組合中來實現其投資目標：(i) 總體而言旨在複製納斯達克 100 指數的美國股本證券或 ETF（「指數配置」），(ii) 直接投資或持有長期美國國債的 ETF（「固定收益配置」），以及 (iii) 短期貨幣基金等價物、現金、現金、現金、現金、現金等價物或現金（現金或現金基金等現金、現金或現金基金等現金（它是非多元化的。

info.description: Cabana Target Leading Sector Moderate ETF seeks to provide long-term growth. The fund is an actively managed exchange-traded fund ("ETF") that seeks to achieve its investment objective primarily by allocating its assets among ETFs that invest in securities of companies in the various sectors of the U.S. market: communication services, consumer discretionary, consumer staples, energy, financials, health care, industrials, information technology, materials, real estate, and utilities. It is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Cabana Target 領先產業溫和 ETF 尋求提供長期成長。該基金是一檔主動管理的交易所交易基金（「ETF」），主要透過將其資產分配給投資於美國市場各行業公司證券的 ETF 來實現其投資目標：通訊服務、非必需消費品、必需消費品、能源、金融、醫療保健、工業、資訊科技、材料、房地產和公用事業。它是非多元化的。

info.description: GraniteShares YieldBOOST Single Stock Universe ETF seeks current income and pay weekly distributions. The Fund is a "fund of funds," meaning that it primarily invests its assets in the shares of other ETFs, rather than in securities of individual companies. The Fund's portfolio will be primarily composed of "YieldBOOST ETFs," which are all affiliated ETFs advised by GraniteShares Advisors LLC (the "Adviser") (each, an "Underlying YieldBOOST ETF"). Each of the Underlying YieldBOOST ETFs in which the Fund may invest has for objective to achieve 2 times (200%) the income generated from selling options on an "Underlying Stock" by selling options on leveraged exchange-traded funds designed to deliver 2 times (200%) the daily performance of the Underlying Stock (the "Underlying ETF"). The Underlying YieldBoost ETF's secondary investment objective is to gain exposure to the performance of the Underlying ETF, subject to a cap on potential investment gains. Each Underlying YieldBoost ETF may implement a downside protection which could affect the net income level.
info.description_zh: GraniteShares YieldBOOST Single Stock Universe ETF 尋求當前收入並支付每週分配。該基金是“基金中的基金”，這意味著它主要將其資產投資於其他 ETF 的股票，而不是個別公司的證券。該基金的投資組合將主要由「YieldBOOST ETF」組成，這些都是由 GraniteShares Advisors LLC（「顧問」）提供諮詢服務的附屬 ETF（每個都是「基礎 YieldBOOST ETF」）。本基金可能投資的每隻標的 YieldBOOST ETF 的目標是透過出售槓桿交易所交易基金的選擇權來實現出售「標的股票」選擇權所產生的收入的 2 倍 (200%)，該基金旨在實現標的股票（「標的 ETF」）每日表現的 2 倍（200%）。標的 YieldBoost ETF 的次要投資目標是獲得標的 ETF 表現的投資機會，但須遵守潛在投資收益的上限。每個基礎 YieldBoost ETF 可能會實施下行保護，這可能會影響淨收入水準。

info.description: Janus Henderson Global Artificial Intelligence ETF seeks long-term growth of capital. The fund pursues its investment objective by investing, under normal circumstances, at least 80% of its net assets (plus any borrowings for investment purposes) in equity securities of companies that portfolio management believes will contribute to or benefit from artificial intelligence technologies. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Janus Henderson Global Artificial Intelligence ETF 尋求資本的長期成長。在正常情況下，該基金透過將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上任何用於投資目的的借款）投資於投資組合管理認為將有助於人工智慧技術或受益於人工智慧技術的公司的股本證券來實現其投資目標。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: 2x Solana ETF seeks daily investment results, before fees and expenses, that correspond to two times (2x) the daily performance of SOL. The fund is an ETF that seeks to achieve its investment objective primarily through managed exposure to SOL futures contracts that trade only on an exchange registered with the Commodity Futures Trading Commission, and cash, cash-like instruments or high-quality securities that serve as collateral to the fund's investments in Solana futures contracts. The fund is non-diversified.

Datadog, Inc. engages in the development of a monitoring and analytics platform for developers, information technology operations teams and business users. Its platform integrates and automates infrastructure monitoring, application performance monitoring and log management to provide real-time observability of its customers' entire technology stack. The company was founded by Olivier Pomel and Alexis Le-Quoc on June 4, 2010 and is headquartered in New York, NY.

Marriott International, Inc. engages in the operation and franchise of hotel, residential, and timeshare properties. It operates through the following geography segments: United States and Canada, Europe, Middle East, and Africa, and Asia Pacific excluding China. Its brands include Marriott Bonvoy, The Ritz-Carlton, Edition, W Hotels Worldwide, The Luxury Collection, and Stregis Hotels and Resorts etc. The company was founded by John Willard Marriott and Alice Sheets Marriott in 1927 and is headquartered in Bethesda, MD.
info.description_zh: 萬豪國際集團從事酒店、住宅和分時度假物業的營運和特許經營。該公司透過以下地理區域開展業務：美國和加拿大、歐洲、中東和非洲以及除中國外的亞太地區。旗下品牌包括萬豪旅享家、麗茲卡爾頓酒店、艾迪遜酒店、W 酒店全球、豪華精選、斯特吉斯酒店及度假村等。該公司由 John Willard Marriott 和 Alice Sheets Marriott 於 1927 年創立，總部位於馬裡蘭州貝塞斯達。

info.description: Monolithic Power Systems, Inc. designs, develops, and markets integrated power semiconductor solutions and power delivery architectures for computing and storage, automotive, industrial, communications, and consumer applications markets. The firm's products include portable electronic devices, wireless LAN access points, computers and notebooks, monitors, infotainment applications, and medical equipment. It operates through the following geographical segments: China, US, Taiwan, and Other. The company was founded by Michael R. Hsing, and James C. Moyer on August 22, 1997, and is headquartered in West Palm Beach, FL.
info.description_zh: Monolithic Power Systems, Inc. 為運算和儲存、汽車、工業、通訊和消費應用市場設計、開發和銷售整合式功率半導體解決方案和電力傳輸架構。該公司的產品包括便攜式電子設備、無線區域網路存取點、電腦和筆記型電腦、顯示器、資訊娛樂應用和醫療設備。它透過以下地理區域開展業務：中國、美國、台灣和其他地區。該公司由 Michael R. Hsing 和 James C. Moyer 於 1997 年 8 月 22 日創立，總部位於佛羅裡達州西棕櫚灘。

info.description: Akamai Technologies, Inc. is the cybersecurity and cloud computing company that powers and protects business online. The market security solutions, superior threat intelligence, and global operations team provide defense in depth to safeguard enterprise data and applications everywhere. The firm full-stack cloud computing solutions deliver performance and affordability on the world's most distributed platform. The global enterprises trust Akamai to provide the industry reliability, scale, and expertise they need to grow their business with confidence. The company was founded by Frank T. Leighton, Jonathan Seelig, Randall S. Kaplan, and Daniel M. Lewin on August 20, 1998 and is headquartered in Cambridge, MA.

ACM Research, Inc. engages in the development, manufacture, and sale of single-wafer wet cleaning equipment. It supplies process solutions that semiconductor manufacturers can use in numerous manufacturing steps to remove particles, contaminants and other random defects, and thereby improve product yield. The company tools can be used in fabricating foundry, logic and memory chips including dynamic random-access memory, or DRAM, and 3D NAND-flash memory chips. The company was founded by David H. Wang and Hui Wang in January 1998 and is headquartered in Fremont, CA.
Arhaus, Inc. engages in the retail of furniture, outdoor, lighting, textiles, and decor. The company was founded by John Reed in 1986 and is headquartered in Hudson, OH.
info.description_zh: Arhaus, Inc. 從事家具、戶外用品、照明、紡織品和裝飾品的零售。該公司由 John Reed 於 1986 年創立，總部位於俄亥俄州哈德遜。

info.description: Aytu Biopharma, Inc. is a specialty pharmaceutical company, which engages in identifying, acquiring, and commercializing novel products. It operates through the Rx and Consumer Health segments. The RX segment consists of various prescription pharmaceutical products sold through third parties. The Consumer Health segment includes various consumer health products sold directly to consumers. Its products include Adzenys ER, Adzenys XR-ODT, Cotempla XR-ODT, Karbinal ER, Poly-Vi-Flor, Tri-Vi-Flor, Generic Tussionex, Tuzistra XR, and ZolpiMist. The company was founded on August 9, 2002 and is headquartered in Denver, CO.
info.industry_zh: 藥品製造商 - 特用藥品和非專利藥品
info.description_zh: Aytu Biopharma, Inc. 是一家專業製藥公司，致力於識別、收購和商業化新產品。它透過處方藥和消費者健康部門運作。 RX 部門由透過第三方銷售的各種處方藥品組成。消費者健康部門包括直接銷售給消費者的各種消費者健康產品。其產品包括 Adzenys ER、Adzenys XR-ODT、Cotempla XR-ODT、Karbinal ER、Poly-Vi-Flor、Tri-Vi-Flor、Generic Tussionex、Tuzistra XR 和 ZolpiMist。該公司成立於2002年8月9日，總部位於科羅拉多州丹佛市。

info.description: Atlanta Braves Holdings, Inc. owns and operates a Major League Baseball (MLB) club. It operates through the Baseball and Mixed-Use Development segments. The Baseball segment includes its operations relating to the Braves baseball franchise and Truist Park and includes revenue generated from ticket sales, concessions, local broadcasting rights, advertising sponsorships, suites, and premium seat fees, retail and licensing revenue, shared MLB revenue streams, including national broadcasting rights and licensing, and other sources. Ticket sales, concessions, broadcasting rights and advertising sponsorship sales are the baseball segment's primary revenue drivers. The Mixed-Use Development segment includes retail, office, hotel and entertainment operations within The Battery Atlanta. The Battery Atlanta derives revenue primarily from office and retail rental income including overage rent and tenant reimbursements and, to a lesser extent, parking and advertising sponsorships. The company was founded on December 7, 2022 and is headquartered in Atlanta, GA.
info.description_zh: 亞特蘭大勇士控股公司 (Atlanta Braves Holdings, Inc.) 擁有並經營美國職棒大聯盟 (MLB) 俱樂部。它透過棒球和混合用途開發部門運作。棒球部門包括與勇敢者棒球特許經營權和Truist Park相關的業務，包括門票銷售、特許權、當地廣播權、廣告贊助、套房和高級座位費、零售和許可收入、共享MLB收入流（包括國家廣播權和許可）以及其他來源產生的收入。門票銷售、優惠、轉播權和廣告贊助銷售是棒球業務的主要收入來源。混合用途開發部門包括亞特蘭大砲台內的零售、辦公室、飯店和娛樂業務。亞特蘭大砲台的收入主要來自辦公室和零售租金收入，包括超額租金和租戶報銷，以及較小程度的停車和廣告贊助。該公司成立於2022年12月7日，總部位於喬治亞州亞特蘭大。

info.description: 8x8, Inc. engages in the provision of enterprise communication solutions. It offers solutions to the business services, education, financial services, government, healthcare, and manufacturing industries. The company was founded in February 1987 and is headquartered in Campbell, CA.
info.description_zh: 8x8, Inc. 從事提供企業通訊解決方案。它為商業服務、教育、金融服務、政府、醫療保健和製造業提供解決方案。該公司成立於 1987 年 2 月，總部位於加州坎貝爾。

info.description: Future Money Acquisition Corp. is a blank check company. It was formed for the purpose of entering into a merger, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, recapitalization, reorganization or similar business combination with one or more businesses. The company was founded on September 29, 2025 and is headquartered in San Francisco, CA.
info.description_zh: Future Money Acquisition Corp. 是一家空白支票公司。它的成立目的是與一個或多個企業進行合併、股份交換、資產收購、股份購買、資本重組、重組或類似的業務合併。該公司成立於2025年9月29日，總部位於加州舊金山。

info.description: Global-e Online Ltd. engages in the provision of cross-border e-commerce solutions. It offers Global-e Pro and Global-e enterprise. The firm enables merchants to increase the conversion of international traffic into sales by providing online shoppers across global destinations with a seamless, localized shopping experience. Global-e Online was founded by Shahar Tamari, Amir Schlachet, and Nir Debbi on February 21, 2013 and is headquartered in Petach Tikva, Israel.
info.description_zh: Global-e Online Ltd.從事提供跨境電子商務解決方案。它提供 Global-e Pro 和 Global-e enterprise。該公司為全球目的地的線上購物者提供無縫、在地化的購物體驗，幫助商家提高國際流量轉換為銷售額的能力。 Global-e Online 由 Shahar Tamari、Amir Schlachet 和 Nir ​​Debbi 於 2013 年 2 月 21 日創立，總部位於以色列佩塔提克瓦。

info.description: Innoviz Technologies Ltd. engages in providing automotive-grade LiDAR sensor platforms. It offers its solutions to the aerospace, defense, and homeland security markets. The firm's products include InnovizOne, InnovizTwo Long-Range, InnovisTwo Short-to Mid-Range, InnovizThree, InnovizSMART, and InnovizTwo Ultra Long-Range (ULR). The company was founded by Omer David Keilaf, Oren Buskila, and Oren Rosenzweig on January 18, 2016 and is headquartered in Rosh HaAyin, Israel.
Skyline Builders Group Holding Ltd. focuses on the construction industry in Asia. The company was founded on June 25, 2024 and is headquartered in Hong Kong.

Kimball Electronics, Inc. engages in the provision of contract manufacturing services including engineering and supply chain support for the production of electronic assemblies and other products including medical devices, medical disposables, precision molded plastics, and automation, test, and inspection equipment primarily in automotive, medical, and industrial applications. It operates through the following geographical segments: the United States, China, Mexico, Poland, Romania, and Thailand. The company was founded in 1961 and is headquartered in Jasper, IN.

Ollie's Bargain Outlet Holdings, Inc. is a holding company, which engages in the retail of closeouts, excess inventory, and salvage merchandise. The firm offers overstocks, discontinued merchandise, package changes, cancelled orders, buybacks from retailers, and major manufacturers. Its products include housewares, bed and bath, food, floor coverings, health and beauty aids, books and stationery, toys and electronics. The company was founded by Mark Butler, Mort Bernstein, Oliver Rosenberg and Harry Coverman on July 29, 1982, and is headquartered in Harrisburg, PA.
info.description_zh: Ollie's Bargain Outlet Holdings, Inc. 是一家控股公司，從事清倉、過剩庫存和回收商品的零售業務。該公司提供庫存過剩、停產商品、包裝變更、取消訂單、零售商和主要製造商的回購服務。其產品包括家庭用品、床具和浴室、食品、地板覆蓋、健康和美容用品、書籍和文具、玩具和電子產品。該公司由 Mark Butler、Mort Bernstein、Oliver Rosenberg 和 Harry Coverman 於 1982 年 7 月 29 日創立，總部位於賓州哈里斯堡。

info.description: Omeros Corp. operates as a biopharmaceutical company, which engages in the research, discovery, development, and commercialization of small-molecule and protein therapeutics targeting immunologic diseases. It also offers orphan indications targeting inflammation, coagulopathies, and disorders of the central nervous system. The company was founded by Gregory A. Demopulos and Pamela Pierce Palmer on June 16, 1994 and is headquartered in Seattle, WA.

Perpetuals.com Ltd. engages in providing blockchain-based technology solutions. It operates its proprietary private blockchain technology, Grid Ledger System (GLS), a hybrid blockchain that combines the technical advantages of blockchain technology and database technology, to leverage blockchain technology in various applications in a range of industries. It offers software and system development services and consulting and solution services. The company was founded by Satoshi Kobayashi and Hiroki Yamamoto on May 1, 2018 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

Leverage Shares 2X Long PLTR Daily ETF seeks daily levered investment results, before fees and expenses, of two times (200%) of the daily percentage change in the price of the common stock of PLTR. The fund invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus borrowings for investment purposes) in financial instruments with economic characteristics that, in combination, provide 200% daily leveraged exposure to the price of PLTR, consistent with the fund's investment objective. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 槓桿股票 2 倍多頭 PLTR 每日 ETF 尋求每日槓桿投資結果（未計費用和開支），為 PLTR 普通股價格每日百分比變化的兩倍 (200%)。該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上投資目的借款）投資於具有經濟特徵的金融工具，這些金融工具組合起來可提供 PLTR 價格的 200% 每日槓桿敞口，與基金的投資目標一致。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Direxion Daily PLTR Bull 2X Shares seeks daily investment results, before fees and expenses, of 200% of the daily performance of PLTR. The fund, under normal circumstances, invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus any borrowings for investment purposes) in the securities of PLTR and financial instruments, such as swap agreements and options, that, in combination, provide 2X daily leveraged exposure to PLTR, consistent with the fund's investment objective. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Direxion Daily PLTR Bull 2X Shares 尋求 PLTR 每日表現的 200% 的每日投資表現（未計費用和開支）。在正常情況下，該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上任何用於投資目的的借款）投資於 PLTR 證券和金融工具，例如掉期協議和期權，這些證券結合起來為 PLTR 提供 2 倍的每日槓桿敞口，這與基金的投資目標一致。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: GraniteShares 2x Long PLTR Daily ETF seeks daily investment results, before fees and expenses, of 2 times (200%) the common stock of Palantir Technologies Inc. (NYSE: PLTR). The fund is an actively managed exchange traded fund that attempts to replicate 2 times (200%) the daily percentage change of the underlying stock by entering into a swap agreement on the underlying stock. It will enter into one or more swap agreements with major financial institutions for a specified period ranging from a day to more than one year whereby the fund and the financial institution will agree to exchange the return earned or realized on the underlying stock. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: GraniteShares 2x Long PLTR Daily ETF 寻求每日投资收益（扣除费用和开支）为 Palantir Technologies Inc.（纽约证券交易所股票代码：PLTR）普通股的 2 倍（200%）。该基金是一种主动管理的交易所交易基金，试图通过签订标的股票掉期协议来复制标的股票每日百分比变化的两倍（200%）。它将与主要金融机构签订一份或多份互换协议，期限从一天到一年以上不等，根据该协议，基金和金融机构将同意交换标的股票赚取或实现的回报。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: ProShares Nasdaq-100 Dorsey Wright Momentum ETF seeks investment results, before fees and expenses, that track the performance of the Nasdaq-100 Dorsey Wright Momentum Index (the "index"). The index, which is constructed and maintained by Dorsey, Wright & Associates, LLC (Dorsey Wright), consists of 21 securities from the Nasdaq-100 Index with the highest price momentum. The fund will invest principally in the Equities and Depositary Receipts which principally include ADRs. It will concentrate or focus its investments in a particular industry or group of industries, country or region to approximately the same extent the index is so concentrated or focused. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: ProShares Nasdaq-100 Dorsey Wright Momentum ETF 尋求在費用和支出之前追蹤 Nasdaq-100 Dorsey Wright Momentum Index（「指數」）表現的投資結果。該指數由 Dorsey, Wright & Associates, LLC (Dorsey Wright) 建構和維護，由 Nasdaq-100 指數中價格動量最高的 21 種證券組成。該基金將主要投資於股票和存託憑證，其中主要包括美國存託憑證。它將把投資集中或集中在特定產業或產業組、國家或地區，其程度與指數的集中程度大致相同。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: SC II Acquisition Corp. operates as a blank check company. It was formed for the purpose of effecting a merger, capital stock exchange, asset acquisition, stock purchase, reorganization, or similar business combination with one or more businesses. The company was founded on June 30, 2025 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: SC II Acquisition Corp. 作為一家空白支票公司運作。它的成立目的是與一個或多個企業進行合併、股本交換、資產收購、股票購買、重組或類似的業務合併。該公司成立於2025年6月30日，總部位於紐約州紐約。

info.description: Sonos, Inc. engages in the provision of multi-room wireless audio products. It supports streaming services and provides access to music, Internet radio, podcasts, and audiobooks, with control from Android smartphones, iPhone or iPad. The company was founded by Mai Trung, John MacFarlane, Craig A. Shelburne, and Thomas S. Cullen in 2002 and is headquartered in Santa Barbara, CA.

Streamex Corp. operates as a Real-World Asset (RWA) tokenization. It engages in the provision of blockchain technology to tokenize physical commodities such as gold and create related financial products. The company was founded by Kenneth L. Londoner, Karl Henry McPhie, and Morgan Lekstrom on February 24, 2009 and is headquartered in Winter Park, FL.
info.description_zh: Streamex Corp. 作為現實世界資產 (RWA) 代幣化運作。它致力於提供區塊鏈技術來對黃金等實體商品進行代幣化並創建相關的金融產品。該公司由 Kenneth L. Londoner、Karl Henry McPhie 和 Morgan Lekstrom 於 2009 年 2 月 24 日創立，總部位於佛羅裡達州溫特帕克。

info.description: Thayer Ventures Acquisition Corp. II is a blank check company, which was formed for the purpose of effecting a merger, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, reorganization, or similar business combination with one or more businesses. The company was founded by Mark E. Farrell and Christopher Hemmeter on April 23, 2024 and is headquartered in Valencia, CA.
