info.description: Democratic Large Cap Core ETF seeks to track the total return performance, before fees and expenses, of the Democratic Large Cap Core Index. The index is a subset of the S&P 500 Index designed to provide exposure to large capitalization companies that make political contributions to Democratic Party candidates and political action committees above a certain threshold. Under normal circumstances, the fund will invest at least 80% of its net assets (plus the amount of any borrowings for investment purposes) in securities of companies included in the index.
info.description_zh: 民主大盤核心 ETF 旨在追蹤民主大盤核心指數（未計費用和支出）的總回報表現。該指數是標準普爾 500 指數的子集，旨在為向民主黨候選人和政治行動委員會提供超過一定門檻的政治捐款的大型資本公司提供投資機會。在正常情況下，該基金將至少80%的淨資產（加上任何用於投資目的的借款金額）投資於指數所包含公司的證券。

info.description: State Street My2027 High Yield Corporate Bond ETF is an actively managed fund that employs a target maturity strategy, primarily investing in high-yield corporate bonds scheduled to mature in 2027. The fund utilizes a bottom-up security selection process to overweight attractive sectors and issuers while seeking to maximize current income and preserve capital as it approaches its planned liquidation date on or about December 15, 2027.

Motley Fool Momentum Factor ETF seeks investment results that correspond generally to the total return performance of the Motley Fool Momentum Index. Under normal circumstances, at least 80% of the fund's total assets will be invested in the component securities of the index. The Adviser expects that, over time, if it has sufficient assets, the correlation between the fund's performance and that of the index, before fees and expenses, will be 95% or better. The fund will generally use a "replication" strategy to achieve its investment objective, meaning it generally will invest in all of the component securities of the index. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Motley Fool Momentum Factor ETF 尋求與 Motley Fool Momentum Index 的總回報表現大致相對應的投資結果。一般情況下，基金總資產至少80%會投資於指數成分證券。顧問預計，隨著時間的推移，如果擁有足夠的資產，在扣除費用和開支之前，基金績效與指數績效之間的相關性將達到 95% 或更高。該基金通常會使用「複製」策略來實現其投資目標，這意味著它通常會投資於該指數的所有組成證券。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Tradr 2X Long Triple Q Monthly ETF seeks calendar month investment results, before fees and expenses, that correspond to two times (200%) the calendar month performance of the Invesco QQQ Trust. Under normal market circumstances, the fund will maintain at least 80% exposure to financial instruments that provide two times leveraged exposure to the calendar month performance of the Invesco QQQ Trust. The fund will enter into one or more swaps with major global financial institutions whereby the fund and the global financial institution will agree to exchange the return (or differentials in rates of return) earned or realized on the Invesco QQQ Trust. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Tradr 2X Long Triple Q Monthly ETF 尋求不計費用和開支的日曆月投資結果，相當於 Invesco QQQ Trust 日曆月業績的兩倍 (200%)。在正常市場情況下，該基金將維持至少 80% 的金融工具敞口，這些金融工具為景順 QQQ 信託的日曆月表現提供兩倍的槓桿敞口。該基金將與全球主要金融機構進行一項或多項掉期，其中該基金和全球金融機構將同意交換在 Invesco QQQ Trust 上賺取或實現的回報（或回報率差異）。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Seastar Medical Holding Corp. operates as a holding company whose subsidiaries manufacture and supply medical devices. The company was founded on June 6, 2007 and is headquartered in Denver, CO.

Arcutis Biotherapeutics, Inc. engages in the development and commercialization of treatments for dermatological diseases. Its pipeline consists of topical treatments for plaque psoriasis, atopic dermatitis, hand eczema, vitiligo, scalp psoriasis, alopecia areata, and seborrheic dermatitis. The company was founded by Bhaskar Chaudhuri and David W. Osborne in June 2016 and is headquartered in Westlake Village, CA.
info.description_zh: Arcutis Biotherapeutics, Inc. 從事皮膚病治療的開發和商業化。其產品線包括斑塊型乾癬、異位性皮膚炎、手部濕疹、白斑症、頭皮乾癬、斑禿和脂漏性皮膚炎的局部治療。該公司由 Bhaskar Chaudhuri 和 David W. Osborne 於 2016 年 6 月創立，總部位於加州西湖村。

info.description: iShares Nasdaq Premium Income Active ETF seeks to provide current income with consideration for capital appreciation. The fund seeks to achieve its investment objective by employing a targeted outcome strategy that is intended to optimize, in the opinion of Fund management, premium income generation and the potential for capital appreciation. The fund invests at least 80% of its net assets in equity securities listed on the Nasdaq Stock Market. Investments in derivatives are counted toward the fund's 80% policy to the extent that they provide investment exposure to the securities included within that policy or to one or more market risk factors associated with such securities.
info.description_zh: iShares Nasdaq Premium Income Active ETF 旨在提供當前收入，同時考慮資本增值。該基金尋求透過採用有針對性的結果策略來實現其投資目標，該策略旨在根據基金管理層的意見優化保費收入的產生和資本增值的潛力。該基金將至少80%的淨資產投資於納斯達克股票市場上市的股票證券。衍生性商品投資計入基金的 80% 保單，只要它們提供對該保單中包含的證券或與此類證券相關的一個或多個市場風險因素的投資曝險。

info.description: SGI Dynamic Tactical ETF seeks to provide long-term capital appreciation. The fund is an actively-managed ETF and invests in securities of affiliated and unaffiliated ETFs and open-end mutual funds. The fund may allocate among major equity asset classes and sectors, within the underlying funds, of the U.S., foreign and emerging markets equity of any capitalization.
info.description_zh: SGI 動態戰術 ETF 旨在提供長期資本增值。該基金是主動式管理 ETF，投資於附屬和非附屬 ETF 以及開放式共同基金的證券。該基金可以在基礎基金內的美國、外國和新興市場任何資本的股票的主要股票資產類別和部門之間進行配置。

info.description: Defiance Quantum ETF seeks to track the total return performance, before fees and expenses, of the BlueStar Quantum Computing and Machine Learning Index (the "index"). The fund uses a "passive management" (or indexing) approach to track the total return performance, before fees and expenses, of the index. The index consists of a modified equal-weighted portfolio of the stock of companies that derive at least 50% of their annual revenue or operating activity from the development of quantum computing and machine learning technology.
info.description_zh: Defiance Quantum ETF 旨在追蹤藍星量子計算和機器學習指數（「指數」）扣除費用和支出之前的總回報表現。該基金採用「被動管理」（或指數化）方法來追蹤該指數扣除費用和支出之前的總回報表現。該指數由經過修改的等權重公司股票投資組合組成，這些公司的年收入或營運活動至少有 50% 來自量子計算和機器學習技術的發展。

info.description: Logitech International SA is a holding company, which engages in the design of software-enabled hardware solutions. Its portfolio includes gaming, keyboards and combos, pointing devices, video collaboration, webcams, tablet accessories, and headsets. Its cloud based services includes video conferencing platforms, esports or video games, music streaming platforms, content streaming platforms, and and creativity and productivity platforms. It enhances through software, including machine learning and artificial intelligence. The company was founded by Daniel Borel, Pierluigi Zappacosta, and Giacamo Marini on October 2, 1981 and is headquartered in Lausanne, Switzerland.

Baron Technology ETF invests in equity securities (including depositary receipts) of U.S. and non-U.S. technology companies of any market capitalization, selected for their durable growth potential from the development, advancement and use of technology, however, investments in non-U.S. securities are limited to 35% of the Fund's total assets at the time of purchase. Technology companies may be located anywhere in the world, including developing countries. A developing country is a country included in the MSCI Emerging Markets (EM) Index and other countries determined by the Adviser to be developing countries based on classifications made by the International Monetary Fund or on country characteristics similar to those of the countries in the EM Index. BAMCO seeks to invest in businesses it believes have significant opportunities for growth, sustainable competitive advantages, exceptional management, and an attractive valuation.
info.description_zh: Baron Technology ETF 投資於任何市值的美國和非美國科技公司的股本證券（包括存託憑證），因其在技術開發、進步和使用方面的持久增長潛力而被選擇，但對非美國證券的投資僅限於購買時基金總資產的 35%。科技公司可能位於世界任何地方，包括發展中國家。發展中國家是指納入 MSCI 新興市場 (EM) 指數的國家以及顧問根據國際貨幣基金組織的分類或根據與新興市場指數國家類似的國家特徵確定為發展中國家的其他國家。 BAMCO 尋求投資於它認為具有重大成長機會、可持續競爭優勢、卓越管理和有吸引力估值的企業。

info.description: Thornburg International Growth ETF seeks long-term capital growth. The fund adviser expects to invest primarily in equity securities or depositary receipts of non-U.S. developed market issuers selected for their growth potential. Thornburg, the fund's investment adviser, intends to invest in companies that it believes have growth characteristics, such as growing revenues and earnings or the prospect for such growth in revenues or earnings. The fund can invest in companies of any size, from larger, well-established companies to smaller, emerging growth companies. It is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Thornburg International Growth ETF 尋求長期資本成長。該基金顧問預計將主要投資於根據成長潛力而選擇的非美國已開發市場發行人的股本證券或存託憑證。該基金的投資顧問桑伯格打算投資於它認為具有成長特徵的公司，例如收入和收益不斷增長或收入或收益有成長前景的公司。該基金可以投資任何規模的公司，從大型、成熟的公司到小型、新興的成長型公司。它是非多元化的。

info.description: Westport Fuel Systems, Inc. engages in the business of engineering, manufacturing, and supplying alternative fuel systems and components for transportation applications. It operates through the following segments: Original Equipment Manufacturers (OEM), Independent Aftermarket (IAM), and Corporate. The OEM segment includes designing, manufacturing, and selling alternative fuel systems, components, and electronics including the HPDI 2.0 fuel systems product and engineering services. The IAM segment focuses on alternative fuel systems and components that consumers can purchase and have installed onto vehicles to use liquid petroleum or compressed natural gas fuels in addition to gasoline. The Corporate segment is involved in public company activities, corporate oversight, financing, capital allocation, and general administrative duties such as securing intellectual property. The company was founded on March 20, 1995 and is headquartered in Vancouver, Canada.

JPMorgan Equity And Options Total Return ETF seeks to provide total return. To implement its investment objective, the fund manager uses a multi-pronged approach to total return, sourced from dividends, options premium and capital appreciation. Under normal circumstances, the fund invests at least 80% of its assets in equity securities and call options on S&P 500 ETFs or on the index.

Amana Growth ETF is an actively managed fund that seeks long-term capital growth by investing at least 80% of its total net assets in growth-oriented common stocks of domestic and foreign companies selected in accordance with Islamic principles. The fund targets financially sustainable companies characterized by low debt, strong balance sheets, and robust management strength, applying past earnings and revenue growth rates alongside future expansion expectations to construct a non-diversified, large-cap focused portfolio.
info.description_zh: Amana Growth ETF是一檔主動式管理基金，透過將至少80%的總淨資產投資於根據伊斯蘭原則挑選的國內外公司的成長型普通股來尋求長期資本成長。該基金針對以低債務、穩健的資產負債表和強大的管理實力為特徵的財務可持續公司，利用過去的盈利和收入增長率以及未來的擴張預期來構建非多元化、以大盤股為重點的投資組合。

info.description: Infrastructure Capital Nasdaq Option Income ETF is an actively managed exchange-traded fund that combines a long equity portfolio with dynamic options overlays to generate high monthly distribution returns while preserving capital appreciation potential. The fund utilizes a top-down macroeconomic framework to selectively buy and write short-duration put and call options alongside an actively managed, value-tilted stock portfolio that mirrors the economic risk profile of the Nasdaq Composite Index.
info.description_zh: 基礎設施資本納斯達克選擇權收益 ETF 是一款主動管理的交易所交易基金，將長期股票投資組合與動態選擇權疊加相結合，產生高月度分配回報，同時保留資本增值潛力。該基金利用自上而下的宏觀經濟框架，選擇性地購買和賣出短期看跌期權和看漲期權，以及反映納斯達克綜合指數經濟風險狀況的積極管理、價值傾斜的股票投資組合。

info.description: First Trust S-Network Future Vehicles & Technology ETF seeks investment results that correspond generally to the price and yield (before the fund's fees and expenses) of an equity index called the S-Network Electric & Future Vehicle Ecosystem Index. The fund will normally invest at least 90% of its net assets in the common stocks and depositary receipts that comprise the index. To be eligible for inclusion in the index, a company must be listed on a major recognized stock exchange and engaged in one of the following sectors: electric and autonomous vehicle manufacturing; enabling technologies or enabling materials. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: First Trust S-Network 未來車輛和技術 ETF 尋求的投資結果通常與名為 S-Network 電動和未來車輛生態系統指數的股票指數的價格和收益率（基金費用和開支之前）相對應。該基金通常將至少 90% 的淨資產投資於構成該指數的普通股和存託憑證。為了有資格納入該指數，公司必須在主要認可的證券交易所上市，並從事以下行業之一：電動和自動駕駛汽車製造；使能技術或使能材料。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Astoria US Quality Growth Kings ETF seeks to provide long-term capital appreciation. The fund is an actively managed exchange-traded fund ("ETF") that seeks to achieve its investment objective by investing, under normal circumstances, at least 80% of its net assets (plus the amount of any borrowings for investment purposes) in equity securities (including depositary receipts) of issuers outside the U.S. that the fund's sub-adviser, Astoria Portfolio Advisors, LLC (the "Sub-Adviser") believes has the potential for growth.
info.description_zh: Astoria US Quality Growth Kings ETF 尋求提供長期資本增值。該基金是一檔主動管理型交易所交易基金（「ETF」），旨在透過在正常情況下將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上任何用於投資目的的借款金額）投資於美國境外發行人的股本證券（包括存託憑證）來實現其投資目標，該基金的副顧問 Astoria Portfolio, LLC（「顧問」具有成長潛力）。

info.description: GraniteShares Autocallable COIN ETF seeks to generate current monthly income while providing limited downside protection by investing in a laddered, rolling portfolio of single-stock autocallable option-linked derivatives. The fund executes its defined-income strategy primarily through over-the-counter or exchange-traded derivatives that utilize the common stock of Coinbase Global, Inc. as their single reference asset.
info.description_zh: GraniteShares Autocallable COIN ETF 旨在透過投資單股可自動贖回選擇權掛鉤衍生性商品的階梯式滾動投資組合，在產生當前每月收入的同時提供有限的下行保護。該基金主要透過場外交易或交易所交易的衍生性商品來執行其固定收益策略，這些衍生性商品利用 Coinbase Global, Inc. 的普通股作為其單一參考資產。

info.description: BlackRock Large Cap Growth ETF seeks long-term capital appreciation. Under normal circumstances, the fund seeks to invest at least 80% of its net assets plus the amount of any borrowings for investment purposes in large cap equity securities and derivatives that have similar economic characteristics to such securities. For purposes of the fund's 80% policy, large cap equity securities are equity securities that at the time of purchase have a market capitalization within the range of companies included in the Russell 1000 Growth Index. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 貝萊德大盤成長 ETF 尋求長期資本增值。在正常情況下，該基金尋求將至少80%的淨資產加上用於投資目的的任何借款金額投資於大盤股證券以及與此類證券具有類似經濟特徵的衍生品。就基金的 80% 政策而言，大盤股證券是指購買時市值處於 Russell 1000 Growth Index 所包含公司範圍內的股本證券。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: GraniteShares YieldBOOST Ether ETF is an actively managed fund that employs a synthetic income-generation strategy by selling put options on leveraged exchange-traded funds linked to the daily performance of Ether. The fund seeks to achieve 200% of the income derived from standard option strategies on the reference asset while maintaining exposure to the underlying leveraged instrument, albeit constrained by a cap on potential capital appreciation.
info.description_zh: GraniteShares YieldBOOST 以太 ETF 是一檔主動式管理基金，透過出售與以太每日表現掛鉤的槓桿交易所交易基金看跌期權，採用合成創收策略。該基金力求實現參考資產的標準選擇權策略所產生的 200% 的收入，同時保持對基礎槓桿工具的曝險，儘管受到潛在資本增值上限的限制。

info.description: Actively managed ETF seeking long-term capital growth by investing in US large-cap growth stocks selected through JPMorgan's fundamental data science investment process.

iShares ESG Aware MSCI USA ETF seeks to track the investment results of the MSCI USA Extended ESG Focus Index. The fund generally will invest at least 90% of its assets in the component securities of the underlying index and may invest up to 10% of its assets in certain futures, options and swap contracts, cash and cash equivalents. The underlying index is an optimized equity index designed to reflect the equity performance of U.S. companies that have favorable environmental, social and governance ("ESG") characteristics (as determined by the index provider), while exhibiting risk and return characteristics similar to those of the MSCI USA Index (the "parent index").
info.description_zh: iShares ESG Aware MSCI USA ETF 旨在追蹤 MSCI USA Extended ESG Focus Index 的投資結果。該基金通常將至少 90% 的資產投資於標的指數的組成證券，並可能將最多 10% 的資產投資於某些期貨、選擇權和掉期合約、現金和現金等價物。標的指數是優化的股票指數，旨在反映具有良好環境、社會和治理（「ESG」）特徵（由指數提供者確定）的美國公司的股票表現，同時表現出與 MSCI 美國指數（「母指數」）類似的風險和回報特徵。

info.description: AudioCodes Ltd. engages in the provision of communications software, products and productivity solutions for the digital workplace. The firm is involved in the development, manufacture, and market of products for transferring voice and data over the internet. Its products include products for Microsoft 365, session border controllers, multi-service business routers, meeting rooms, internet protocol phones, digital and analog media gateways, management products and solutions, and voice applications. The company was founded by Shabtai Adlersberg in 1992 and is headquartered in Or Yehuda, Israel.
info.description_zh: AudioCodes Ltd. 致力於為數位工作場所提供通訊軟體、產品和生產力解決方案。該公司從事透過網路傳輸語音和數據的產品的開發、製造和銷售。其產品包括Microsoft 365產品、會話邊界控制器、多服務業務路由器、會議室、網際網路協定電話、數位和類比媒體閘道、管理產品和解決方案以及語音應用程式。該公司由 Shabtai Adlersberg 於 1992 年創立，總部位於以色列 Or Yehuda。

info.description: Engine No. 1 Transform 500 ETF seeks investment results that closely correspond, before fees and expenses, to the performance of Morningstar US Large Cap Select Index composed of large-capitalization U.S. equities. The fund will invest, under normal circumstances, at least 80% of the value of its net assets, plus the amount of any borrowings for investment purposes, in component securities of the underlying index or in depositary receipts representing component securities in the underlying index. The underlying index targets the largest 500 U.S. stocks by market capitalization and weights them by float-adjusted market capitalization.
info.description_zh: Engine No. 1 Transform 500 ETF 尋求在費用和支出之前與由大盤美國股票組成的晨星美國大盤精選指數表現密切相關的投資結果。在正常情況下，該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產價值，加上任何用於投資目的的借款金額，投資於相關指數的組成證券或代表相關指數組成證券的存託憑證。基礎指數以市值最大的 500 隻美國股票為目標，並以流通市值對其進行加權。

info.description: Goldman Sachs Growth Opportunities ETF seeks long-term growth of capital. The fund invests, under normal circumstances, at least 80% of its net assets plus any borrowings for investment purposes (measured at the time of purchase) ("Net Assets") in equity securities. Although it invests primarily in publicly traded U.S. securities, it may invest up to 20% of its Net Assets in foreign securities, including securities of issuers in countries with emerging markets or economies ("emerging countries") and securities quoted in foreign currencies. The fund may invest in companies of any market capitalization. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 高盛成長機會 ETF 尋求資本的長期成長。在正常情況下，該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產加上任何用於投資目的的借款（在購買時計量）（「淨資產」）投資於股本證券。儘管其主要投資於公開交易的美國證券，但最多可將其淨資產的 20% 投資於外國證券，包括新興市場或經濟體國家（「新興國家」）發行人的證券以及以外幣報價的證券。該基金可以投資於任何市值的公司。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Goldman Sachs Enhanced U.S. Equity ETF seeks long-term growth of capital. The fund invests, under normal circumstances, at least 80% of its net assets plus any borrowings for investment purposes (measured at the time of purchase) ("Net Assets") in equity securities issued by small-, mid- and large-cap U.S. companies.
info.description_zh: 高盛增強型美國股票 ETF 尋求資本的長期成長。在正常情況下，該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產加上任何用於投資目的的借款（在購買時計量）（「淨資產」）投資於美國小型、中型和大型公司發行的股本證券。

info.description: JPMorgan Fundamental Data Science Large Core ETF seeks to provide long-term capital appreciation. Under normal circumstances, the fund invests at least 80% of its assets in equity securities of large, well established companies. Many of the equity securities in the fund's portfolio will be technology companies or companies that rely heavily on technological advances. In managing the fund, the adviser employs a fundamental data science enabled investment approach that combines research, data insights, and risk management. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 摩根大通基本資料科學大型核心 ETF 旨在提供長期資本增值。在正常情況下，該基金至少將其資產的 80% 投資於大型、成熟公司的股本證券。該基金投資組合中的許多股本證券將是科技公司或嚴重依賴技術進步的公司。在管理基金時，顧問採用了基礎數據科學支持的投資方法，結合了研究、數據洞察和風險管理。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Alpha Architect US Equity 4 ETF is an actively managed ETF that seeks broad-based exposure to the U.S. equity market through direct investments in U.S. companies with market capitalizations of $1 billion or greater, as well as investments in other ETFs offering similar exposure. The fund employs a systematic dividend-timing strategy designed to evaluate and potentially replace holdings prior to their ex-dividend dates to capture short-term supply/demand price imbalances while minimizing taxable income distributions.

Humilis US Focused Opportunities ETF is an actively managed, non-diversified equity strategy that integrates top-down macroeconomic analysis with bottom-up fundamental research to build a high-conviction portfolio of large-capitalization U.S. companies. The fund targets high-quality corporate issuers demonstrating strong earnings per share growth, solid balance sheets, stable operating margins, and historical dividend appreciation across different phases of the business cycle.
info.description_zh: Humilis US Focused Opportunities ETF 是一種主動管理的非多元化股票策略，將自上而下的宏觀經濟分析與自下而上的基本面研究相結合，以建立大市值美國公司的高信念投資組合。該基金的目標對像是在商業週期不同階段表現出強勁的每股盈餘成長、穩健的資產負債表、穩定的營業利潤率以及歷史股息增值的優質企業發行人。

info.description: National Security Emerging Markets Index ETF seeks to track the results, before fees and expenses, of the Alerian National Security Emerging Markets Index. The fund invests at least 80% of its total assets in component securities of the index. The index consists of stocks listed on globally recognized stock exchanges that excludes companies benefiting end-users that, in the view of the sponsor of the fund, National Security Index, LLC (the "Sponsor") pose a threat to the national security interests of the United States.
info.description_zh: 國家安全新興市場指數 ETF 旨在追蹤 Alerian 國家安全新興市場指數（未計費用和開支）的結果。該基金將其總資產的至少 80% 投資於該指數的組成證券。該指數由在全球公認的證券交易所上市的股票組成，不包括使最終用戶受益的公司，該基金的發起人 National Security Index, LLC（「發起人」）認為這些公司對美國的國家安全利益構成威脅。

info.description: Alphadroid Broad Markets Momentum ETF seeks to track the total return performance, before fees and expenses, of the AlphaDroid EZ-MO Broad Markets Momentum Index ("Broad Markets Index" or the "Index"). The fund manager employs a "passive management" (or indexing) investment approach designed to track the total return performance, before fees and expenses, of the index. The fund invests in various types of U.S. publicly traded ETFs that comprise the index ("Underlying ETFs") and therefore operates as a "fund-of-funds." The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Alphadroid Broad Markets Momentum ETF 旨在追蹤 AlphaDroid EZ-MO Broad Markets Momentum Index（「Broad Markets Index」或「Index」）的總回報表現（扣除費用和開支）。基金經理人採用「被動管理」（或指數化）投資方法，旨在追蹤指數未計費用和開支之前的總回報表現。該基金投資於構成該指數的各種類型的美國公開交易 ETF（「基礎 ETF」），因此以「基金中的基金」的形式運作。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: WisdomTree U.S. Adaptive Moving Average Fund utilizes a systematic trend-following overlay to dynamically allocate between U.S. large-cap equities and U.S. Treasury bills based on prevailing market momentum. The strategy is designed to provide full equity participation during uptrends while proactively reducing net exposure and shifting to cash equivalents during periods of high volatility or downward price trends to mitigate significant drawdowns.
info.description_zh: WisdomTree美國自適應移動平均基金利用系統性趨勢追蹤疊加，根據當前市場勢頭在美國大盤股和美國國債之間進行動態配置。該策略旨在在上漲趨勢期間提供全面的股權參與，同時在高波動或價格下跌趨勢期間主動減少淨敞口並轉向現金等價物，以減輕大幅回撤。

info.description: IQ Global Equity R&D Leaders ETF seeks results that correspond (before fees and expenses) generally to the price and yield performance of its underlying index, the IQ Global Equity R&D Leaders Index (the "underlying index"). The underlying index seeks to provide exposure to innovative companies by investing in the equities of companies that have high research and development ("R&D") spending around the world. The fund invests, under normal circumstances, at least 80% of its net assets, plus the amount of any borrowings for investment purposes, in the investments included in its underlying index. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: IQ 全球股票研發領袖 ETF 尋求與其標的指數 IQ 全球股票研發領袖指數（「標的指數」）的價格和收益率表現（未計費用和開支）相對應的結果。該指數旨在透過投資全球研發（「R＆D」）支出較高的公司的股票來提供對創新公司的投資。在正常情況下，該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產以及用於投資目的的任何借款金額投資於其基礎指數中包含的投資。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Rbb Fund Trust - Pathfinder Disciplined Us Equity Etf is an exchange traded fund launched by Opal Capital LLC. It is managed by Vident Asset Management. It invests in public equity markets of United States. It invests in stocks of companies operating across diversified sectors. It invests in growth and value stocks of companies across diversified market capitalization. The fund employs quantitative analysis to create its portfolio. Rbb Fund Trust - Pathfinder Disciplined Us Equity Etf is domiciled in the United States.
info.description_zh: Rbb Fund Trust - Pathfinder Disciplined Us Equity ETF 是 Opal Capital LLC 推出的交易所交易基金。它由 Vident 資產管理公司管理。它投資於美國公共股票市場。它投資於多元化行業的公司股票。它投資於多元化市值公司的成長型股票和價值型股票。該基金採用定量分析來創建其投資組合。 Rbb Fund Trust - Pathfinder Disciplined Us Equity ETF 註冊地為美國。

info.description: First Trust RiverFront Dynamic Emerging Markets ETF seeks to provide capital appreciation. The fund invests at least 80% of its net assets (including investment borrowings) in a portfolio of equity securities of emerging market companies, including through investments in common stock, depositary receipts, and common and preferred shares of real estate investment trusts, and forward foreign currency exchange contracts and currency spot transactions used to hedge the fund's exposure to the currencies in which the equity securities of such emerging market companies are denominated. The fund may invest in small, mid and large capitalization companies.

HCM Large Cap Growth ETF is an actively managed fund constructed utilizing a proprietary quantitative multi-factor modeling process to identify high-conviction large-cap stocks and sectors within the Russell 1000 Index universe based on fundamental and technical ranking metrics. The investment strategy overweights highly ranked broad market sectors and focuses allocations on individual equities falling within the top quartile of its systemic scores, supplemented by subjective macroeconomic and risk management analysis from the adviser's investment committee.
info.description_zh: HCM 大盤成長 ETF 是一款主動管理基金，利用專有的定量多因素建模流程構建，根據基本面和技術排名指標識別羅素 1000 指數範圍內高可信度的大盤股和板塊。此投資策略超重排名靠前的廣泛市場板塊，並將配置重點放在系統得分前四分之一的個股上，並輔以顧問投資委員會的主觀宏觀經濟和風險管理分析。

info.description: HIVE Digital Technologies Ltd. engages in building a bridge between the digital currency and blockchain sector and traditional capital markets. The firm operates data centers for computing and mining cryptocurrencies, including Bitcoin and other coins. It owns and operates green energy-powered data center facilities in Canada, Sweden, and Iceland. The company was founded on June 24, 1987 and is headquartered in San Antonio, TX.

TaoWeave, Inc. operates as a digital asset treasury company dedicated to Bittensor. It provides investors with a regulated, publicly traded vehicle to gain exposure to the decentralized AI economy. The company operates through the following business segments: Digital Assets, Managed Services, and Collaboration Products. The Digital Assets segment represents the business surrounding its treasury activity with Bittensor. The Managed Services segment represents the business surrounding managed services for video collaboration and network solutions. The Collaboration Products segment represents the business surrounding its Mezzanine product offerings. TaoWeave was founded in May 2000 and is headquartered in Denver, CO.

Sapient Quality Select ETF is an actively managed fund that targets U.S. equities by identifying companies exhibiting a convergence of high-quality financial characteristics and robust growth potential. The investment process utilizes a proprietary framework to screen for businesses with above-average profitability, strong management profiles, and attractive valuations, specifically focusing on entities positioned to benefit from long-term economic catalysts or transformative market themes.
info.description_zh: Sapient Quality Select ETF 是一檔主動式管理基金，透過識別具有高品質財務特徵和強勁成長潛力的公司來瞄準美國股票。投資流程利用專有框架來篩選獲利能力高於平均水平、管理能力強且估值有吸引力的企業，特別關注那些能夠從長期經濟催化劑或變革性市場主題中受益的實體。

info.description: abrdn International Small Cap Active ETF seeks long-term growth of capital. The fund seeks to achieve its objective by investing primarily in equity securities of small non-U.S. companies. Equity securities include, but are not limited to, common stock, preferred stock and depositary receipts. As a non-fundamental policy, under normal market conditions, it will invest at least 80% of the value of its net assets, plus any borrowings for investment purposes, in equity securities of non-U.S. small companies.
info.description_zh: abrdn International Small Cap Active ETF 尋求資本的長期成長。該基金尋求透過主要投資於小型非美國公司的股本證券來實現其目標。股本證券包括但不限於普通股、優先股及存託憑證。作為一項非基本面政策，在正常市場條件下，它將把至少80%的淨資產價值，加上任何用於投資目的的借款，投資於非美國小公司的股本證券。

info.description: Direxion Daily AMZN Bear 1X Shares seeks daily investment results, before fees and expenses, of 100% of the inverse (or opposite) of the daily performance of Amazon.com, Inc. The fund will enter into one or more swap agreements with major global financial institutions whereby the fund and the global financial institution will agree to exchange the return earned on an investment by the fund in AMZN that is equal, on a daily basis, to -100% of the value of the fund's net assets. It is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Direxion Daily AMZN Bear 1X Shares 尋求與 Amazon.com, Inc. 每日業績相反（或相反）100% 的每日投資結果（扣除費用和開支）。該基金將與主要全球金融機構簽訂一項或多項掉期協議，根據該協議，該基金和全球金融機構將同意交換該基金在 AMZN 的投資所賺取的回報，該回報每天等於該基金淨資產價值的 -100%。它是非多元化的。

info.description: GP-Act III Acquisition Corp. operates as a blank check company, which was created for the purpose of effecting a merger, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, reorganization or similar business combination with one or more businesses. The company was founded on November 23, 2020 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: GP-Act III Acquisition Corp. 作為一家空白支票公司運營，其創建目的是與一個或多個企業進行合併、股份交換、資產收購、股份購買、重組或類似業務合併。該公司成立於2020年11月23日，總部位於紐約州紐約。

info.description: Russell Inv Emerging Markets Equity Active ETF seeks to provide long term capital growth. The fund has a non-fundamental policy to invest, under normal circumstances, at least 80% of the value of its net assets plus borrowings for investment purposes in equity securities economically tied to emerging markets countries. The fund principally invests in equity securities, including common stock and preferred stock, of emerging markets companies, and in depositary receipts representing shares in such companies.
info.description_zh: Russell Inv Emerging Markets Equity Active ETF 致力於提供長期資本成長。該基金的非基本政策是，在正常情況下，將其淨資產價值的至少80%加上用於投資目的的借款投資於與新興市場國家經濟相關的股本證券。該基金主要投資於新興市場公司的股本證券，包括普通股和優先股，以及代表此類公司股份的存託憑證。

info.description: iShares ESG Advanced MSCI EM ETF seeks to track the investment results of the MSCI Emerging Markets Choice ESG Screened 5% Issuer Capped Index. The index is a free float-adjusted market capitalization-weighted index designed to reflect the equity performance of large- and mid-capitalization emerging market companies with favorable ESG ratings while applying extensive screens, including removing fossil fuel exposure. The fund generally will invest at least 90% of its assets in the component securities of the index and in investments that have economic characteristics that are substantially identical to the component securities of the index. It is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: iShares ESG Advanced MSCI EM ETF 旨在追蹤 MSCI 新興市場選擇 ESG 篩選 5% 發行人上限指數的投資結果。該指數是一個自由流通量調整後的市值加權指數，旨在反映具有良好 ESG 評級的大中型新興市場公司的股票表現，同時應用廣泛的篩選，包括消除化石燃料風險。該基金通常將至少 90% 的資產投資於指數成分證券以及與指數成分證券具有基本相同經濟特徵的投資。它是非多元化的。

info.description: Xeris Biopharma Holdings, Inc. is a biopharmaceutical company, which engages in developing and commercializing products across a range of therapies. Its products include Gvoke, Keveyis, and Recorlev. Gvoke is a ready-to-use liquid glucagon for the treatment of severe hypoglycemia. Keveyis is the therapy approved in the United States to treat hyperkalemic, hypokalemic, and related variants of primary periodic paralysis (PPP). Recorlev is a cortisol synthesis inhibitor approved for the treatment of endogenous hypercortisolemia in adult patients with Cushing's syndrome. The company was founded by Steven Prestrelski in 2005 and is headquartered in Chicago, IL.
info.industry_zh: 藥品製造商 - 特用藥品和非專利藥品
info.description_zh: Xeris Biopharma Holdings, Inc.是一家生物製藥公司，致力於開發和商業化一系列療法的產品。其產品包括 Gvoke、Keveyis 和 Recorlev。 Gvoke 是一種即用型液體胰高血糖素，用於治療嚴重低血糖。 Keveyis 是美國核准用於治療高血鉀、低血鉀和原發性週期性麻痺 (PPP) 相關變異的療法。 Recorlev 是一種皮質醇合成抑制劑，被批准用於治療患有庫欣氏症候群的成人患者的內源性高皮質醇血症。該公司由 Steven Prestrelski 於 2005 年創立，總部位於伊利諾州芝加哥。

info.description: iShares ESG Aware MSCI EM ETF seeks to track the investment results of the MSCI Emerging Markets Extended ESG Focus Index. The fund generally will invest at least 90% of its assets in the component securities of the underlying index and in investments that have economic characteristics that are substantially identical to the component securities of the underlying index. The index is an optimized equity index designed to reflect the equity performance of companies that have favorable ESG characteristics, while exhibiting risk and return characteristics similar to those of the MSCI Emerging Markets Index (the "parent index").
info.description_zh: iShares ESG Aware MSCI EM ETF 旨在追踪 MSCI 新兴市场扩展 ESG 焦点指数的投资结果。該基金通常將至少 90% 的資產投資於標的指數的組成證券以及具有與標的指數的組成證券基本相同的經濟特徵的投資。該指數是優化的股票指數，旨在反映具有良好 ESG 特徵的公司的股票表現，同時表現出與 MSCI 新興市場指數（「母指數」）類似的風險和回報特徵。

info.description: Matthews Emerging Markets Discovery Active ETF seeks capital appreciation. The fund is an actively-managed exchange-traded fund ("ETF") that seeks to achieve its investment objective by utilizing an investment strategy enhanced by the use of artificial intelligence. Under normal circumstances, the fund invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus the amount of any borrowings for investment purposes) in securities of U.S.-listed large capitalization companies.
info.description_zh: Matthews Emerging Markets Discovery Active ETF 尋求資本增值。该基金是一只主动管理的交易所交易基金（“ETF”），旨在通过利用人工智能增强的投资策略来实现其投资目标。在正常情况下，该基金将至少80%的净资产（加上任何用于投资目的的借款金额）投资于美国上市大型资本公司的证券。

info.description: WEBs Defined Volatility SPY ETF seeks to provide investment results that, before fees and expenses, correspond to the performance of the Syntax Defined Volatility US Large Cap 500 Index. The fund implements its investment objective by investing, under normal market conditions, at least 80% of its net assets in financial instruments that achieve the investment results of the index. The index is a rules-based strategy that seeks to track the performance of the SPDR S&P 500 ETF, with investment exposure to the underlying ETF adjusted for a targeted annual volatility rate of 20%. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: WEBs Defined Volatility SPY ETF 力求提供扣除費用和開支先前與 Syntax Defined Volatility US Large Cap 500 Index 的表現相對應的投資結果。該基金透過在正常市場條件下將至少80%的淨資產投資於實現指數投資結果的金融工具來實現其投資目標。該指數是一種基於規則的策略，旨在追蹤 SPDR S&P 500 ETF 的表現，並根據 20% 的目標年度波動率調整基礎 ETF 的投資曝險。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: First Trust IPOX Europe Equity Opportunities ETF seeks investment results that correspond generally to the price and yield (before the fund's fees and expenses) of an equity index called the IPOX  -100 Europe Index (the "index"). The fund will normally invest at least 90% of its net assets (including investment borrowings) in the common stocks and depositary receipts that comprise the index. The index seeks to measure the performance of the equity securities of the 100 largest and typically most liquid initial public offerings ("IPOs") (including spin-offs and equity carve-outs) of companies that are economically tied to Europe. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: First Trust IPOX Europe Equity Opportunities ETF 尋求與稱為 IPOX -100 Europe Index（「指數」）的股票指數的價格和收益率（在基金費用和開支之前）相對應的投資結果。該基金通常將至少 90% 的淨資產（包括投資借款）投資於構成該指數的普通股和存託憑證。該指數旨在衡量與歐洲經濟相關的 100 家規模最大且通常流動性最強的首次公開發行（「IPO」）（包括分拆和股權分拆）公司的股票表現。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Southwest Airlines Co. engages in the operation and management of a passenger airline. The firm also offers ancillary services such as early bird check-in, upgraded boarding, and transportation of pets and unaccompanied minors. It operates in the United States, the Commonwealth of Puerto Rico, Mexico, Jamaica, the Bahamas, Aruba, Dominican Republic, Costa Rica, Belize, Cuba, the Cayman Islands, and Turks and Caicos. The company was founded by Rollin W. King and Herbert D. Kelleher on March 9, 1967 and is headquartered in Dallas, TX.
info.description_zh: 西南航空有限公司從事客運航空公司的經營和管理。該公司還提供輔助服務，例如提前辦理登機手續、升級登機以及寵物和無人陪伴的未成年人的運輸。它在美國、波多黎各聯邦、墨西哥、牙買加、巴哈馬、阿魯巴、多明尼加共和國、哥斯達黎加、伯利茲、古巴、開曼群島以及特克斯和凱科斯群島開展業務。該公司由 Rollin W. King 和 Herbert D. Kelleher 於 1967 年 3 月 9 日創立，總部位於德克薩斯州達拉斯。

info.description: Symbotic, Inc. is an automation technology company, which engages in a robotics and automation-based product movement technology platform. It focuses on developing, commercializing, and deploying innovative, end-to-end technology solutions for supply chain operations. It operates through the United States and Canada geographical segments. The company was founded by Richard B. Cohen on December 11, 2020 and is headquartered in Wilmington, MA.
info.description_zh: Symbotic, Inc.是一家自動化技術公司，從事機器人和基於自動化的產品移動技術平台。它專注於為供應鏈營運開發、商業化和部署創新的端到端技術解決方案。它透過美國和加拿大的地理部門開展業務。該公司由 Richard B. Cohen 於 2020 年 12 月 11 日創立，總部位於馬薩諸塞州威爾明頓。

info.description: Micron Technology, Inc. engages in the provision of innovative memory and storage solutions. It operates through the following segments: Cloud Memory Business Unit (CMBU), Core Data Center Business Unit (CDBU), Mobile and Client Business Unit (MCBU), and Automotive and Embedded Business Unit (AEBU). The CMBU segment focuses on memory solutions for large hyperscale cloud customers and High-Bandwidth Memory for all data center customers. The CDBU segment is involved in memory solutions for mid-tier cloud, enterprise, and OEM data center customers and storage solutions for all data center customers. The MCBU segment focuses on memory and storage solutions for the mobile and client segments. The AEBU segment is involved in memory and storage solutions for the automotive, industrial, and consumer segments. The company was founded by Ward D. Parkinson, Joseph Leon Parkinson, Dennis Wilson, and Doug Pitman on October 5, 1978 and is headquartered in Boise, ID.

Valkyrie Bitcoin Miners ETF seeks to provide investors with total return. The fund is an actively-managed exchange-traded fund ("ETF") that will invest at least 80% of its net assets (plus borrowings for investment purposes) in securities of companies that derive at least 50% of their revenue or profits from bitcoin mining operations and/or from providing specialized chips, hardware and software or other services to companies engaged in bitcoin mining. It will not directly invest in bitcoin, or indirectly through the use of derivatives or through investments in funds or trusts that hold bitcoin. The fund is non-diversified.

VegaShares SpaceX & Beyond Earth ETF seeks capital appreciation through active, non-diversified investments across the commercial space ecosystem, including exploration, launch infrastructure, satellite connectivity, and orbital AI networking. The fund holds global equity securities involved in building and utilizing the orbital infrastructure stack without tracking a specific benchmark.

EchoStar Corp. engages in the design, development, and distribution of digital set-top boxes and products for direct-to-home satellite service providers. It operates through the following business segments: Pay-TV, Wireless, Broadband and Satellite Services, and Other. The Pay-TV segment business strategy is to be the best provider of video services in the United States by providing products with the best technology, outstanding customer service, and great value. The Wireless segment offers Retail Wireless services as well as a competitive portfolio of wireless devices. The Broadband and Satellite Services segment business strategy is to maintain and improve leadership position and competitive advantage through development of technologies and services marketed to selected sectors within the consumer, enterprise and government markets globally. The Other segment consists of legacy 5G Network and 5G Network deployment operations that will not be utilized in the Wireless segment's Hybrid MNO business. The company was founded by Charlie William Ergen, Candy Ergen, and James DeFranco in 1980 and is headquartered in Englewood, CO.

Dominari Holdings, Inc. engages in wealth management, investment banking, sales and trading, and asset management through its subsidiaries. It operates through the Dominari Financial and Legacy AIkido business segments. The Dominari Financial segment represents the company's broker-dealer business, which is composed of mostly underwriting and transactional service activities. The Legacy AIkido segment includes Aikido Labs, which manages the investments holdings of the legacy entity. The company was founded by Gilbert V. Levin and M. Karen Levin in 1967 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: Dominari Holdings, Inc.透過其子公司從事財富管理、投資銀行、銷售和交易以及資產管理業務。它透過 Dominari Financial 和 Legacy AIkido 業務部門運作。 Dominari Financial 部門代表該公司的經紀自營商業務，主要由承銷和交易服務活動組成。傳統合氣道部門包括合氣道實驗室，該實驗室管理傳統實體的投資控股。該公司由 Gilbert V. Levin 和 M. Karen Levin 於 1967 年創立，總部位於紐約州紐約市。

info.description: GDS Holdings Ltd. engages in developing and operating data centers in China. It builds, operates, and transfers data centers at other locations. Its data centers are carrier and cloud-neutral, which enable customers to connect to major telecommunications carriers, and to access a number of cloud service providers. The firm also offers colocation and managed services, which include direct private connection to major public cloud platforms. The company was founded by William Wei Huang in 2001 and is headquartered in Pudong, China.
info.description_zh: 萬國資料控股有限公司在中國從事資料中心的開發和營運。它在其他地點建立、運作和轉移資料中心。其資料中心與營運商和雲端無關，使客戶能夠連接到主要電信營運商，並存取許多雲端服務供應商。該公司還提供託管和託管服務，其中包括與主要公有雲平台的直接私人連接。該公司由William Wei Huang於2001年創立，總部位於中國浦東。

info.description: eBay, Inc. is a commerce company, whose platforms include an online marketplace and its localized counterparts, including off-platform businesses in Japan, as well as eBay's suite of mobile apps. It offers a platform for various product categories, including parts and accessories, collectibles, fashion, electronics, and home & garden. eBay generates revenue mainly through fees from sales, payment processing, and advertising. The company was founded by Pierre Morad Omidyar in September 1995 and is headquartered in San Jose, CA.

STKD Bitcoin & Gold ETF seeks long-term capital appreciation. The fund is an actively-managed exchange-traded fund ("ETF") that seeks to achieve its investment objective by investing via U.S.-listed futures contracts as well as pooled investment vehicles, such as exchange-traded products, in two complementary asset classes, a modern digital asset class and a traditional asset class. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: STKD 比特幣和黃金 ETF 尋求長期資本增值。該基金是一檔主動管理的交易所交易基金（「ETF」），旨在透過在美國上市的期貨合約以及交易所交易產品等集合投資工具投資於兩種互補的資產類別（現代數位資產類別和傳統資產類別）來實現其投資目標。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Shopify, Inc. is a global commerce company that provides essential internet infrastructure for commerce, offering trusted tools to start, scale, market, and run a retail business of any size. The Company's software enables merchants to run their business across all of their sales channels, including web and mobile storefronts, physical retail locations, social media storefronts and marketplaces. The Shopify platform provides merchants with a single view of their business across all of their sales channels and enables them to manage products and inventory, process orders and payments, fulfill and ship orders, build customer relationships, source products, leverage analytics and reporting and access financing, all from one integrated back office. The company was founded on September 28, 2004 and is headquartered in Ottawa, Canada.
info.description_zh: Shopify, Inc. 是一家全球商業公司，為商業提供必要的網路基礎設施，並提供值得信賴的工具來啟動、擴展、行銷和經營任何規模的零售業務。該公司的軟體使商家能夠在所有銷售管道上開展業務，包括網路和行動店面、實體零售店、社交媒體店面和市場。 Shopify 平台為商家提供了跨所有銷售管道的單一業務視圖，使他們能夠管理產品和庫存、處理訂單和付款、履行和發貨訂單、建立客戶關係、採購產品、利用分析和報告以及獲取融資，所有這些都透過一個整合後台進行。該公司成立於2004年9月28日，總部位於加拿大渥太華。

info.description: Generac Holdings, Inc. engages in the business of designing and manufacturing energy technology solutions. It operates under the Domestic and International segments. The Domestic segment includes the legacy Generac business and the acquisitions that are based in the United States and Canada. The International segment focuses on Generac business' Latin American export operations. The company was founded in 1959 and is headquartered in Waukesha, WI.

info.description: Arqit Quantum, Inc. engages in the provision of cybersecurity services via satellite and terrestrial forms. Its product is QuantumCloud which secures devices with cloud-based quantum encryption. The company was founded by David John Williams and David James Bestwick on April 26, 2021 and is headquartered in London, the United Kingdom.
info.description_zh: Arqit Quantum, Inc. 致力於透過衛星和地面形式提供網路安全服務。其產品是 QuantumCloud，它透過基於雲端的量子加密來保護設備。該公司由 David John Williams 和 David James Bestwick 於 2021 年 4 月 26 日創立，總部位於英國倫敦。

info.description: GraniteShares 2x Long MU Daily ETF seeks daily investment results, before fees and expenses, of 2 times (200%) the daily percentage change of the common stock of Micron Technology Inc. (NASDAQ: MU). The fund is an actively managed exchange traded fund that attempts to replicate 2 times (200%) the daily percentage change of the underlying stock by entering into financial instruments such as swaps and options on the underlying stock as well as directly purchasing the underlying stock. The fund is non-diversified.

VNET Group, Inc. operates as a carrier- and cloud-neutral internet data center services provider in China. It provides hosting and related services, including IDC services, cloud services, and business VPN services, to improve the reliability, security, and speed of its customers' internet infrastructure. The firm serves numerous industries, ranging from internet companies to government entities, blue-chip enterprises to small- and mid-sized enterprises. VNET Group was founded by Sheng Chen and Jun Zhang in 1999 and is headquartered in Beijing, China.
info.description_zh: VNET Group, Inc. 在中國作為營運商和雲端中立的互聯網資料中心服務供應商運營。它提供託管和相關服務，包括IDC服務、雲端服務和企業VPN服務，以提高客戶互聯網基礎設施的可靠性、安全性和速度。該公司服務於眾多產業，從網路公司到政府實體、藍籌企業到中小企業。互聯星空集團由陳勝和張軍於1999年創立，總部位於中國北京。

info.description: Alphabet, Inc. is a holding company, which engages in software, health care, transportation, and other technologies. It operates through the following segments: Google Services, Google Cloud, and Other Bets. The Google Services segment includes products and services, such as ads, Android, Chrome, devices, Google Maps, Google Play, Search, and YouTube. The Google Cloud segment refers to infrastructure and platform services, collaboration tools, and other services for enterprise customers. The Other Bets segment relates to the sale of healthcare-related services and internet services. The company was founded by Lawrence E. Page and Sergey Mikhaylovich Brin on October 2, 2015 and is headquartered in Mountain View, CA.
info.description_zh: Alphabet, Inc. 是一家控股公司，業務涉及軟體、醫療保健、運輸和其他技術。它透過以下部門運作：Google服務、Google雲端和其他賭注。 Google 服務部分包括廣告、Android、Chrome、裝置、Google 地圖、Google Play、搜尋和 YouTube 等產品和服務。 Google Cloud 部門是指為企業客戶提供基礎設施和平台服務、協作工具以及其他服務。其他投注部門涉及醫療保健相關服務和網路服務的銷售。該公司由 Lawrence E. Page 和 Sergey Mikhaylovich Brin 於 2015 年 10 月 2 日創立，總部位於加州山景城。

info.description: Pioneer Power Solutions, Inc. engages in designing, manufacturing, integrating, and selling distributed energy resources, on site and mobile power generation equipment, and a platform of mobile electric vehicle charging solutions. It operates through the Critical Power Solutions segment. The Critical Power Solutions segment engages in the provision of mobile EV charging solutions, power generation equipment and all forms of services, preventative maintenance, repairs, fuel polishing, and remote monitoring. The company was founded on September 16, 2008 and is headquartered in Fort Lee, NJ.

Codere Online Luxembourg SA engages in providing online sports betting and online casino services. It operates through the following segments: Spain, Mexico, Colombia, Other Operations, and Supporting Entities. The Spain segment consists of the revenue generated by Codere Online, S.A.U. The Mexico segment comprises of the Asociacion en Participacion (AenP) pursuant to the AenP Agreement. The Colombia segment refers to revenue generated by Codere Online Colombia S.A.S. The Other Operations segment includes Panama, Italy, Malta, Israel, and Gibraltar. The Supporting Entities segment covers the revenue generated by Codere Online Management Services Limited, Codere Israel Marketing Support Services LTD, Codere Online Luxembourg S.A., Codere Online U.S. Corp., Codere (Gibraltar) Marketing Services LTD, Servicios de Juego Online S.A.U., and Surviving Corporation. The company was founded in 2014 and is headquartered in Luxembourg.

DeFi Development Corp. provides business and commercial property financing services. It provides technology that connects commercial mortgage borrowers looking for debt to refinance, build, or buy commercial property including apartment buildings to commercial property lenders (including banks, credit unions, REITs, debt funds, and more) looking to deploy capital into commercial mortgages. The company was founded by Blake E. Janover on November 28, 2018 and is headquartered in Boca Raton, FL.
info.description_zh: DeFi Development Corp. 提供商業和商業房地產融資服務。它提供的技術將尋求債務再融資、建造或購買商業房地產（包括公寓大樓）的商業抵押貸款借款人與尋求將資本配置到商業抵押貸款的商業房地產貸款人（包括銀行、信用合作社、房地產投資信託基金、債務基金等）聯繫起來。該公司由 Blake E. Janover 於 2018 年 11 月 28 日創立，總部位於佛羅裡達州博卡拉頓。

info.description: Alphabet, Inc. is a holding company, which engages in software, health care, transportation, and other technologies. It operates through the following segments: Google Services, Google Cloud, and Other Bets. The Google Services segment includes products and services, such as ads, Android, Chrome, devices, Google Maps, Google Play, Search, and YouTube. The Google Cloud segment refers to infrastructure and platform services, collaboration tools, and other services for enterprise customers. The Other Bets segment relates to the sale of healthcare-related services and internet services. The company was founded by Lawrence E. Page and Sergey Mikhaylovich Brin on October 2, 2015 and is headquartered in Mountain View, CA.
info.description_zh: Alphabet, Inc. 是一家控股公司，業務涉及軟體、醫療保健、運輸和其他技術。它透過以下部門運作：Google服務、Google雲端和其他賭注。 Google 服務部分包括廣告、Android、Chrome、裝置、Google 地圖、Google Play、搜尋和 YouTube 等產品和服務。 Google Cloud 部門是指為企業客戶提供基礎設施和平台服務、協作工具以及其他服務。其他投注部門涉及醫療保健相關服務和網路服務的銷售。該公司由 Lawrence E. Page 和 Sergey Mikhaylovich Brin 於 2015 年 10 月 2 日創立，總部位於加州山景城。

info.description: MindWalk Holdings Corp. is an AI-driven biotherapeutic research, technology, and scientifically robust life science company that discovers and develops customized and novel antibodies by generating proprietary and patented processes, procedures, and innovative approaches to antibody discovery, development, and production. It operates through the following geographical segments: United States of America, Europe, Canada, Australia, and Other. The company was founded by Robert Beecroft on November 22, 1983 and is headquartered in Austin, TX.
info.description_zh: MindWalk Holdings Corp. 是一家由人工智慧驅動的生物治療研究、技術和科學穩健的生命科學公司，透過產生抗體發現、開發和生產的專有和專利流程、程序和創新方法來發現和開發定制的新型抗體。它透過以下地理區域運作：美國、歐洲、加拿大、澳洲和其他地區。該公司由 Robert Beecroft 於 1983 年 11 月 22 日創立，總部位於德克薩斯州奧斯汀。

info.description: ANI Pharmaceuticals, Inc. is a bio-pharmaceutical company, which engages in the development, manufacture, and marketing of branded and generic prescription pharmaceuticals. It operates through the Generics, Established Brands, and Other, and Rare Disease segments. The Generics, Established Brands, and Other segment consists of contract manufactured products, development services, royalties, and other. The Rare Disease segment involves the operations related to Cortrophin Gel. The company was founded on August 29, 1996 and is headquartered in Baudette, MN.

Home Federal Bancorp, Inc. of Louisiana is a holding company, which provides financial services to individuals, corporate entities, and other organizations. It provides services through the origination of loans and the acceptance of deposits in the form of passbook savings, certificates of deposit, and demand deposit accounts. The company was founded on April 1, 1924 and is headquartered in Shreveport, LA.
info.description_zh: 路易斯安那州 Home Federal Bancorp, Inc. 是一家控股公司，為個人、企業實體和其他組織提供金融服務。它透過發放貸款和接受存摺儲蓄、存款證和活期存款帳戶形式的存款來提供服務。該公司成立於 1924 年 4 月 1 日，總部位於路易斯安那州什里夫波特。

info.description: Performance Shipping, Inc. engages in the provision of shipping transportation services through its ownership of containerships. Its vessels are employed on time charters with liner companies carrying containerized cargo along worldwide shipping routes. The firm operates through the following segments: Tankers Vessels and Containers Vessels. Its fleet includes the following vessels: Sagitta, CEntaurus, New Jersey, Pamina, Domingo, Puelo, Pucon, March, Great, Hamburg, and Rotterdam. The company was founded on January 7, 2010 and is headquartered in Athens, Greece.

ioneer Ltd. engages in mineral exploration. It focuses on the development of the Rhyolite Ridge project. It operates through the North America and Australia geographical segments. The company was founded by Bernard Anthony Rowe on October 26, 2001 and is headquartered in North Sydney, Australia.

The Pennant Group, Inc. is a holding company, which engages in the provision of healthcare services to patients of all ages. It operates through the Home Health and Hospice Services, and Senior Living Services segments. The Home Health and Hospice Services segment provides a combination of clinical care services such as nursing, speech, occupational and physical therapy, medical social work, and home health aide services. The Senior Living Services segment deals with assisted and independent living and memory care businesses. The company was founded on January 24, 2019 and is headquartered in Eagle, ID.

Richmond Mutual Bancorporation, Inc. operates as the holding company of First Bank Richmond. It aims to own all of the outstanding shares of capital stock of First Bank Richmond. The company was founded in 1887 and is headquartered in Richmond, IN.

info.description: Cybin, Inc. operates as a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company on a mission to create safe and effective psychedelic-based therapeutics to address the large unmet need for new and innovative treatment options for people who suffer from mental health conditions. It is currently developing CYB003, a proprietary deuterated psilocybin analog for the treatment of major depressive disorder and CYB004, a proprietary deuterated DMT molecule for generalized anxiety disorder and has a research pipeline of investigational psychedelic-based compounds. The company was founded by Paul Glavine, Eric So, and John Kanakis on October 13, 2016 and is headquartered in Toronto, Canada.

Cue Biopharma, Inc. is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company, which engages in advancing a portfolio of potentially transformative therapies aimed at enabling functional cures across immunological disorders. Its pipeline includes CUE-221, a novel anti-IgE antibody with a dual mechanism of action, and CUE-401, designed to regulate inflammation and drive Treg-mediated tolerance. The company was founded by Ronald D. Seidel III, Steven Almo, and Rodolfo Chaparro on December 31, 2014 and is headquartered in Boston, MA.

Canaan, Inc. is a holding company, which engages in developing and selling Bitcoin mining machines and related services. It focuses on the development of green mining. The company was founded by Jia Xuan Li, Xiang Fu Liu and Nan Geng Zhang on January 19, 2013 and is headquartered in Singapore.
info.description_zh: Canaan, Inc.是一家控股公司，從事開發和銷售比特幣礦機及相關服務。重點發展綠色礦業。該公司由李嘉軒、劉向福和張南庚於2013年1月19日創立，總部位於新加坡。

info.description: Canton Strategic Holdings, Inc. is the first publicly traded company to leverage Canton Coin and support the Canton Network to advance institutional blockchain adoption and the digitization of financial markets. In addition to driving value through activities on the Canton Network, it also operates clinical-stage biotech research and development programs. The company was founded on March 28, 2017 and is headquartered in Bridgewater, NJ.

AXT, Inc. engages in the design, development, manufacture and distribution of compound and single element semiconductor substrates. It also sells specialty material substrates and raw materials used to make substrates and other related products. The company was founded by Morris S. Young and Davis Zhang in 1986 and is headquartered in Fremont, CA.
info.description_zh: AXT, Inc. 從事化合物和單元素半導體基板的設計、開發、製造和分銷。它還銷售特殊材料基材以及用於製造基材和其他相關產品的原材料。該公司由 Morris S. Young 和 Davis Zhang 於 1986 年創立，總部位於加州弗里蒙特。

info.description: Incannex Healthcare, Inc. is a biotech company, which engages in developing cannabinoid and psychedelic compound medicines. It focuses on the research and development for medicinal cannabis pharmaceutical products and psychedelic medicine therapies for treatment of a range of indications. The company was founded on April 27, 2001 and is headquartered in Norwest, Australia.
info.industry_zh: 藥品製造商 - 特用藥品和非專利藥品
info.description_zh: Incannex Healthcare, Inc.是一家生技公司，致力於開發大麻素和迷幻化合物藥物。它專注於藥用大麻藥物和用於治療一系列適應症的迷幻藥物療法的研究和開發。該公司成立於2001年4月27日，總部位於澳洲諾韋斯特。

info.description: Direxion Daily GOOGL Bull 1.5X Shares seeks daily investment results, before fees and expenses, of 150% of the daily performance of GOOGL. The fund will enter into one or more swap agreements with major global financial institutions whereby the fund and the global financial institution will agree to exchange the return earned on an investment by the fund in GOOGL that is equal, on a daily basis, to 150% of the value of the fund's net assets. It is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Direxion 每日 GOOGL 牛市 1.5 倍股票尋求每日投資績效（未計費用和開支）為 GOOGL 每日業績的 150%。該基金將與全球主要金融機構簽訂一項或多項互換協議，根據該協議，該基金和全球金融機構將同意交換該基金在 GOOGL 的投資所賺取的每日回報，該回報相當於該基金淨資產價值的 150%。它是非多元化的。

info.description: GraniteShares 2x Long GOOGL Daily ETF seeks daily investment results, before fees and expenses, of 2 times (200%) the daily percentage change of the common stock of Alphabet Inc. Class A (NASDAQ: GOOGL). The fund is an actively managed exchange traded fund that attempts to replicate 2 times (200%) the daily percentage change of the Underlying Stock by entering into financial instruments such as swaps and options on the Underlying Stock as well as directly purchasing the Underlying Stock. At the end of each trading day, the notional exposure against the Underlying Stock obtained through the combination of these instruments will be approximately 200% of the fund's net asset value.
info.description_zh: GraniteShares 2x Long GOOGL Daily ETF 尋求每日投資結果（扣除費用和開支）為 Alphabet Inc. A 類普通股（納斯達克股票代碼：GOOGL）每日百分比變化的 2 倍（200%）。該基金是一檔主動管理的交易所交易基金，試圖透過基礎股票的掉期和選擇權等金融工具以及直接購買基礎股票來複製基礎股票每日百分比變化的兩倍（200%）。在每個交易日結束時，透過這些工具組合獲得的標的股票的名義曝險將約為基金資產淨值的200%。

info.description: HomesToLife Ltd. engages in the retail of home furniture and sale of customized furniture solutions. It operates through the following business segments: Retail, Export sales and Leather Trading. The Retail segment includes the results of operations of HTL SG and HTLK. The Export Sales segment includes the results of operations of HTL FE, HTLF, HTLA, HTLJ, HTLUK, and HTL Marketing in relation to export sales. The Leather Trading segment includes the results of operations of HTL Marketing in relation to leather trading. The company was founded by Yong Pin Phua and Yong Tat Phua in September 1989 and is headquartered in Singapore.
info.description_zh: HomesToLife Ltd. 從事家居家具零售和訂製家具解決方案銷售。它透過以下業務部門運作：零售、出口銷售和皮革貿易。零售部門包括 HTL SG 和 HTLK 的營運表現。出口銷售部門包括 HTL FE、HTLF、HTLA、HTLJ、HTLUK 和 HTL Marketing 與出口銷售相關的營運績效。皮革貿易部門包括 HTL Marketing 與皮革貿易相關的營運績效。該公司由Yong Pin Phua 和Yong Tat Phua 於1989 年9 月創立，總部位於新加坡。

info.description: EVgo, Inc. engages in the provision of electric vehicle charging station services. It offers the EVgo network, home charging solutions, work charging solutions, and freedom station plans to electric car owners. The company was founded in October 2010 and is headquartered in El Segundo, CA.
info.description_zh: EVgo, Inc. 從事提供電動車充電站服務。它為電動車車主提供 EVgo 網路、家庭充電解決方案、工作充電解決方案和自由站計劃。該公司成立於 2010 年 10 月，總部位於加州埃爾塞貢多。

info.description: Vital Farms, Inc. packages, markets and distributes pasture-raised shell eggs, pasture-raised butter and other products. Its products are sold under the trade names Vital Farms, Alfresco Farms, Lucky Ladies and RedHill Farms, primarily to retail foodservice channels. The company was founded by Catherine Stewart, Matthew O'Hayer and Jason Jones in 2007 and is headquartered in Austin, TX.

2x XRP ETF seeks daily investment results, before fees and expenses, that correspond to two times (2x) the daily performance of XRP. The fund is an exchange-traded fund ("ETF") that seeks to achieve its investment objective primarily through managed exposure to XRP futures contracts that trade only on an exchange registered with the Commodity Futures Trading Commission ("XRP Futures Contracts"), and cash, cash-like instruments or high-quality securities that serve as collateral to the fund's investments in XRP Futures Contracts ("Collateral Investments"). The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 2x XRP ETF 尋求扣除費用和開支之前的每日投資結果，相當於 XRP 每日表現的兩倍 (2x)。該基金是一檔交易所交易基金（「ETF」），主要透過管理 XRP 期貨合約（僅在商品期貨交易委員會註冊的交易所交易）（「XRP 期貨合約」）以及作為基金 XRP 期貨合約投資抵押品的現金、類現金工具或高品質證券（「抵押投資」）來實現其投資目標。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Bloomia Holdings, Inc. engages in the provision of in-store and digital advertising solutions. It serves the consumer-packaged goods (CPG) manufacturers, retailers, shopper marketing agencies, and brokerages markets. The company was founded in 1990 and is headquartered in Minneapolis, MN.

BullFrog AI Holdings, Inc. is a digital biopharmaceutical company, which engages in artificial intelligence and machine learning driven analysis of complex data sets in medicine and healthcare. The company was founded by Vininder Singh in August 2017 and is headquartered in Gaithersburg, MD.

Quanome Technologies, Inc. engages in providing cross-border supply chain solutions. It operates through the Cross-border Freight Solutions and Pharmaceutical Distribution segments. The company was founded by Henry Liu and Shuai Li in February 2018 and is headquartered in Itasca, IL.
info.description_zh: Quanome Technologies, Inc. 致力於提供跨境供應鏈解決方案。它透過跨境貨運解決方案和藥品分銷部門運作。該公司由 Henry Liu 和 Shuai Li 於 2018 年 2 月創立，總部位於伊利諾伊州艾塔斯卡。

info.description: VerifyMe, Inc. engages in the provision of software driven predictive analytics logistics. It operates through the Precision Logistics and Authentication segments. The Precision Logistics segment specializes in predictive analytics for optimizing delivery of time and temperature sensitive perishable products. The Authentication segment focuses on the anti-counterfeit and brand protection. The company was founded by Norman A. Gardner on November 10, 1999 and is headquartered in Lake Mary, FL.

info.description: Gloo Holdings, Inc. operates as a technology platform for the faith and flourishing ecosystem, providing values-based AI, resources, insights and funding so people and communities flourish and organizations thrive. The company was founded on May 9, 2025 and is headquartered in Boulder, CO.

Research Frontiers, Inc. engages in development, licensing and commercialization of suspended particle device (SPD) light-control technology for automobiles, homes, buildings, aircraft, boats, exhibition and display applications markets. It develops and licenses technologies to other companies that manufactures and markets SPD-smart chemical emulsion or light-control film made from chemical emulsion, lamination services and electronics to power end-products incorporating the film, skylights and sunroofs. The company was founded by Robert L. Saxe in October 1965 and is headquartered in Woodbury, NY.

Leverage Shares 2X Long ARM Daily ETF seeks daily levered investment results, before fees and expenses, of two times (200%) of the daily percentage change in the price of ARM. The fund is an actively managed ETF. It invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus borrowings for investment purposes) in financial instruments with economic characteristics that, in combination, provide 200% daily leveraged exposure to the price of ARM, consistent with the fund's investment objective. The fund is non-diversified.

CaliberCos, Inc. operates as an asset management firm. It provides various support services including asset management & fund set-up services, as well as lending support, construction & development management, and real estate brokerage services. The company was founded by John Christopher Loeffler II and Jennifer Schrader in January 2009 and is headquartered in Scottsdale, AZ.

Lantronix, Inc. engages in the provision of software as a service (SaaS), engineering services, hardware for edge computing, the Internet of things (IoT), and remote environment management (REM). Its services include embedded IoT solutions, IoT systems solutions, and software and engineering services. The company was founded by Bernhard Bruscha in June 1989 and is headquartered in Irvine, CA.

BillionToOne, Inc. is a next-generation molecular diagnostics company on a mission to create powerful and accurate tests that are accessible to all. Its patented Quantitative Counting Templates (QCT) molecular counting platform is a multiplex technology capable of accurately counting DNA molecules at the single-molecule level. The was founded by Oguzhan Atay, Sukrit Silas, and David Tsao in 2016 and is headquartered in Menlo Park, CA.

Factorial Energy, Inc. engages in the development and commercialization of solid-state battery technologies. Its platforms include FEST and Solstice, designed to deliver high-performance, scalable battery solutions for applications in drones, robotics, automotive, and other advanced mobility sectors. The company is headquartered in Billerica, MA.
info.description_zh: Factorial Energy, Inc. 從事固態電池技術的開發和商業化。其平台包括 FEST 和 Solstice，旨在為無人機、機器人、汽車和其他先進移動領域的應用提供高性能、可擴展的電池解決方案。該公司總部位於馬薩諸塞州比爾里卡。

info.description: Arm Holdings Plc engages in the licensing, marketing, research, and development of microprocessors, systems IP, graphics processing units, physical IP and associated systems IP, software, and tools. It operates through the following geographical segments: United Kingdom, United States, and Other Countries. The company was founded on November 12, 1990 and is headquartered in Cambridge, the United Kingdom.

Netcapital, Inc. is a fintech company, which engages in the provision of financial solutions. The firm's platform allows private companies to raise capital online and provides private equity investment opportunities to investors. The company was founded by Sean F. Lee on April 25, 1984 and is headquartered in Boston, MA.

info.description: Innodata, Inc. is a data engineering company, which engages in providing artificial intelligence software platforms and management of its services. It operates through the following business segments: Digital Data Solutions (DDS), Synodex, and Agility. The DDS segment combines deep neural networks and human expertise in multiple domains to make unstructured information useable. The Synodex segment enables clients in the insurance and healthcare sectors to transform medical records into useable digital data and to apply technologies to the digital data to augment decision support. The Agility segment provides tools and related professional services that enable public relations and communications professionals to discover influencers, amplify messages, monitor coverage, and measure the impact of campaigns. The company was founded by Todd H. Solomon in 1988 and is headquartered in Ridgefield Park, NJ.

SPDR Galaxy Transformative Tech Accelerators ETF seeks to provide long term capital appreciation. The Sub-Adviser seeks to achieve the fund's investment objective by investing in equity securities of foreign and domestic Transformative Tech Accelerators. Transformative Tech Accelerators are companies that provide products or services contributing to the disruptive potential of novel technologies (e.g., blockchain and artificial intelligence ("AI")). The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: SPDR Galaxy Transformative Tech Accelerators ETF 尋求提供長期資本增值。副顧問尋求透過投資國內外轉型技術加速器的股本證券來實現基金的投資目標。變革性技術加速器是提供有助於新技術（例如區塊鏈和人工智慧（“AI”））顛覆性潛力的產品或服務的公司。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Viking Therapeutics, Inc. is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company, which engages in the development of therapies for metabolic and endocrine disorders. The company was founded by Brian Lian and Michael A. Dinerman on September 24, 2012 and is headquartered in San Diego, CA.

First Trust Nasdaq Semiconductor ETF seeks investment results that correspond generally to the price and yield (before the fund's fees and expenses) of the Nasdaq US Smart Semiconductor IndexTM. The fund invests at least 90% of its net assets (including investment borrowings) in the common stocks and depository receipts that comprise the index. The index is designed to provide exposure to U.S. companies comprising the semiconductor sector that have been selected based upon their liquidity and weighted based upon their cumulative score on three investing factors: volatility, value and growth. It is non-diversified.

Harte-Hanks, Inc. is a global customer experience company operating in three business segments: Marketing Services, Customer Care, and Fulfillment & Logistics Services. The company's mission is to partner with clients to provide them with a robust customer-experience, or CX, strategy, data-driven analytics and actionable insights combined with seamless program execution to better understand, attract, and engage their customers. Its services include strategic planning, data strategy, performance analytics, creative development, and execution, technology enablement, marketing automation, B2B and B2C e-commerce, cross-channel customer care, and product, print, and mail fulfillment. The company was founded in 1923 and is headquartered in Chelmsford, MA.
info.description_zh: Harte-Hanks, Inc. 是一家全球客戶體驗公司，經營三個業務部門：行銷服務、客戶服務以及履行和物流服務。該公司的使命是與客戶合作，為他們提供強大的客戶體驗（CX）、策略、數據驅動的分析和可行的見解，並結合無縫的專案執行，以更好地了解、吸引和吸引客戶。其服務包括策略規劃、數據策略、績效分析、創意開發和執行、技術支援、行銷自動化、B2B 和 B2C 電子商務、跨通路客戶服務以及產品、印刷和郵件履行。該公司成立於 1923 年，總部位於馬薩諸塞州切姆斯福德。

info.description: Intuitive Surgical, Inc. engages in the provision of robotic-assisted surgical solutions and invasive care through a comprehensive ecosystem of products and services. Its products include Da Vinci Surgical and Ion Endoluminal systems. The company was founded by Frederic H. Moll, John Gordon Freund, and Robert G. Younge in November 1995 and is headquartered in Sunnyvale, CA.
info.description_zh: Intuitive Surgical, Inc. 透過全面的產品和服務生態系統提供機器人輔助手術解決方案和侵入性護理。其產品包括達文西手術系統和離子腔內系統。該公司由 Frederic H. Moll、John Gordon Freund 和 Robert G. Younge 於 1995 年 11 月創立，總部位於加州桑尼維爾。

info.description: SPDR Galaxy Hedged Digital Asset Ecosystem ETF seeks to provide long term capital appreciation. The Sub-Adviser seeks to achieve the fund's investment objective by investing, directly or indirectly, in (i) equity securities of foreign and domestic companies within the crypto asset and blockchain industries, (ii) ETFs that primarily hold bitcoin and/or ether futures contracts, (iii) bitcoin and ether futures contracts, (iv) exchange-traded products that hold bitcoin or ether as a reference asset, and (v) covered call options and protective put options on investments held in the portfolio. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: SPDR Galaxy 對沖數位資產生態系統 ETF 旨在提供長期資本增值。副顧問尋求透過直接或間接投資於（i）加密資產和區塊鏈行業內的外國和國內公司的股本證券，（ii）主要持有比特幣和/或以太坊期貨合約的ETF，（iii）比特幣和以太坊期貨合約，（iv）以比特幣或以太幣作為參考資產交易所的投資期權產品，以及（v）投資組合中持有的投資基金。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Greenland Energy Co. is a blank check company. It was formed for the purpose of effecting a merger, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, reorganization, or similar business combination with one or more businesses. The company was founded on July 23, 2024 and is headquartered in New York, NY.

VanEck Semiconductor ETF seeks to replicate as closely as possible, before fees and expenses, the price and yield performance of the MVIS US Listed Semiconductor 25 Index. The fund normally invests at least 80% of its total assets in securities that comprise the fund's benchmark index. The index includes common stocks and depositary receipts of U.S. exchange-listed companies in the semiconductor industry. Such companies may include medium-capitalization companies and foreign companies that are listed on a U.S. exchange. The fund is non-diversified.

HUHUTECH International Group, Inc. engages in the provision of designs and provides customized high-purity gas and chemical production systems and equipment. The company was founded by Yu Jun Xiao on July 8, 2021 and is headquartered in Wuxi City, China.

Global X Internet of Things ETF seeks to provide investment results that correspond generally to the price and yield performance, before fees and expenses, of the Indxx Global Internet of Things Thematic Index. The fund invests at least 80% of its total assets in the securities of the underlying index. The underlying index is designed to provide exposure to exchange-listed companies in developed markets that facilitate the Internet of Things industry, including companies involved in wearable technology, home automation, connected automotive technology, sensors, networking infrastructure/software, smart metering and energy control devices. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Global X 物聯網 ETF 尋求提供與 Indxx 全球物聯網主題指數的價格和收益率表現（未計費用和開支）大致相對應的投資結果。該基金將其總資產的至少 80% 投資於相關指數的證券。該指數旨在為已開發市場的交易所上市公司提供投資機會，促進物聯網產業的發展，包括涉及穿戴式技術、家庭自動化、連網汽車技術、感測器、網路基礎設施/軟體、智慧計量和能源控制設備的公司。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Nicholas Bitcoin and Treasuries AfterDark ETF is an actively managed investment strategy designed to capture bitcoin's return profile specifically during U.S. overnight hours, from market close to the following market open. The fund maintains a dual-exposure structure, holding bitcoin-related instruments during the overnight session while rotating into short-term U.S. Treasuries and cash equivalents during U.S. daytime trading hours to potentially mitigate the volatility often associated with standard market sessions.
info.description_zh: Nicholas 比特幣與國債 AfterDark ETF 是一種主動管理的投資策略，旨在捕捉比特幣的回報情況，特別是在美國隔夜時段（從市場收盤到隨後的市場開盤）。該基金維持雙重曝險結構，在隔夜交易時段持有比特幣相關工具，同時在美國日間交易時段轉向短期美國國債和現金等價物，以潛在地減輕通常與標準市場交易時段相關的波動性。

info.description: NetSol Technologies, Inc. engages in the provision of information technology and enterprise software solutions. The firm activities include licensing, subscriptions, modification, enhancement, and support of its suite of financial applications under the brand name NFS Ascent. It operates through the following geographical segments: North America, Europe, and Asia-Pacific. The company was founded by Najeeb Ullah Ghauri, Salim Ullah Ghauri, Naeem Ullah Ghauri, and Irfan Mustafa on March 18, 1997 and is headquartered in Encino, CA.

Aethlon Medical, Inc. is a medical technology company which focuses on developing products to diagnose and treat life and organ threatening diseases. It develops Aethlon Hemopurifier, which is a clinical-stage immunotherapeutic device designed to combat cancer and life-threatening viral infections. The firm operates through the following segments: Aethlon and ESI. The Aethlon segment is involved in therapeutic business activities. The ESI segment consists of diagnostic business activities. The company was founded by James A. Joyce on April 17, 1991 and is headquartered in San Diego, CA.
info.description_zh: Aethlon Medical, Inc. 是一家醫療技術公司，專注於開髮用於診斷和治療威脅生命和器官的疾病的產品。該公司開發了 Aethlon Hemopurifier，這是一種臨床階段的免疫治療設備，旨在對抗癌症和危及生命的病毒感染。該公司透過以下部門運作：Aethlon 和 ESI。 Aethlon 部門從事治療業務活動。 ESI 部門包括診斷業務活動。該公司由 James A. Joyce 於 1991 年 4 月 17 日創立，總部位於加利福尼亞州聖地亞哥。

info.description: GraniteShares YieldBOOST QQQ ETF seeks current income; the fund's secondary investment objective being exposure to the performance of the ProShares UltraPro QQQ (NASDAQ: TQQQ) subject to a limit on potential investment gains. The fund is an actively managed ETF that seeks current income while maintaining the opportunity for an indirect exposure to the share price of the ProShares UltraPro QQQ, subject to a limit on potential gains from increases in the price of the underlying ETF's shares. The fund is non-diversified.
