The index is a float-adjusted market capitalization weighted index designed to define and measure the investable universe of publicly traded companies domiciled in emerging markets, excluding China. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: SPDR 標普新興市場（中國除外）ETF 尋求提供在扣除費用和支出之前大致與標普新興市場（中國除外）BMI 相對應的投資結果。在正常情況下，基金將至少80%的淨資產（加上用於投資目的的借款金額）投資於構成指數的證券。該指數是一個浮動調整市值加權指數，旨在定義和衡量新興市場（不包括中國）上市公司的可投資範圍。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Pulmatrix, Inc. is a clinical stage biotechnology company, which engages in the development and discovery of novel inhaled therapeutics products. The company was founded by David Alan Edwards, Mark J. Gabrielson, Alexander M. Klibanov, and Robert S. Langer, Jr. in April 2003 and is headquartered in Framingham, MA.
info.description_zh: Pulmatrix, Inc.是一家臨床階段生物技術公司，致力於新型吸入治療產品的開發和發現。該公司由 David Alan Edwards、Mark J. Gabrielson、Alexander M. Klibanov 和 Robert S. Langer, Jr. 於 2003 年 4 月創立，總部位於馬薩諸塞州弗雷明漢。

info.description: Digital Asset Debt Strategy ETF seeks long-term capital appreciation and, secondarily, income. The fund is an actively managed exchange-traded fund ("ETF"). Under normal market conditions the fund invests at least 80% of its net assets in debt securities of issuers that are directly involved in digital asset-related activities. The digital asset-related activities that such issuers may be involved in include (i) mining of digital assets; (ii) holding digital assets in their corporate treasury or government treasury; and (iii) working on platforms to facilitate payment with, or the transfer of, digital assets.
info.description_zh: 數位資產債務策略ETF尋求長期資本增值，其次是收入。該基金為主動式管理型交易所交易基金（“ETF”）。在正常市場條件下，該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產投資於直接參與數位資產相關活動的發行人的債務證券。此類發行人可能參與的數位資產相關活動包括（i）數位資產的挖礦； (ii) 在公司金庫或政府金庫中持有數位資產； (iii) 致力於開發促進數位資產支付或轉移的平台。

info.description: Rackspace Technology, Inc. engages in the provision of end-to-end multi-cloud technology services. The firm designs, builds and operates its customers' cloud environments across technology platforms. It operates through the following segments: Public Cloud and Private Cloud. The Public Cloud segment is a services-centric, capital-light model providing value-added cloud solutions through managed services, Elastic Engineering and professional services offerings for customer environments hosted on the AWS, Microsoft Azure and Google Cloud public cloud platforms. The Private Cloud segment is a technology-forward, capital-intensive model providing managed service offerings for customer environments hosted in data centers as well as in those owned by customers or by third parties such as colocation providers. The company was founded on July 21, 2016 and is headquartered in San Antonio, TX.

Global X AI Semiconductor & Quantum ETF seeks to provide investment results that correspond generally to the price and yield performance, before fees and expenses, of the Global X AI Semiconductor & Quantum Index. The fund invests at least 80% of its net assets, plus borrowings for investment purposes, in the securities of the underlying index), which may include common stocks, ADRs and GDRs. The underlying index, as presently constituted, is designed to track the performance of companies that are involved in the artificial intelligence ("AI") semiconductor and quantum computing ecosystems. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Global X AI 半導體和量子 ETF 力求提供與 Global X AI 半導體和量子指數未計費用和開支前的價格和收益率表現大致相符的投資結果。該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上用於投資目的的借款）投資於相關指數的證券，其中可能包括普通股、ADR 和 GDR。目前構成的基礎指數旨在追蹤參與人工智慧（「AI」）半導體和量子運算生態系統的公司的表現。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: First Trust Dorsey Wright Dynamic Focus 5 ETF seeks investment results that correspond to the price and yield of an index called the Dorsey Wright Dynamic Focus Five TM Index. The fund will normally invest at least 80% of its net assets in the ETFs that comprise the index. The index is designed to provide targeted exposure to the five First Trust sector and industry-based ETFs that the index determines offer the greatest potential to outperform the other First Trust sector and industry-based ETFs and that satisfy certain trading volume and liquidity requirements.
info.description_zh: First Trust Dorsey Wright Dynamic Focus 5 ETF 尋求與名為 Dorsey Wright Dynamic Focus Five TM 指數的指數的價格和收益率相對應的投資結果。該基金通常將至少 80% 的淨資產投資於構成該指數的 ETF。該指數旨在提供對 5 個 First Trust 部門和行業 ETF 的有針對性的投資，該指數認為這些 ETF 具有超越其他 First Trust 部門和行業 ETF 的最大潛力，並且滿足一定的交易量和流動性要求。

info.description: F/m Accumulator Ultrashort Treasury Fund is an actively managed fund-of-funds structured to capture institutional total returns from short-duration fixed-income instruments while completely eliminating recurring taxable distribution payouts to its shareholders. The strategy dynamically shifts capital among underlying registered exchange-traded funds holding U.S. government obligations with maturities under one year, deploying a disciplined tactical rotation out of underlying positions prior to their dividend record dates to allow asset growth to compound directly within the fund's net asset value.
info.description_zh: F/m Accumulator Ultrashort Treasury Fund 是一種主動管理的基金中的基金，其結構旨在獲取短期固定收益工具的機構總回報，同時完全消除向股東支付的經常性應稅分配支出。該策略在持有期限在一年以下的美國政府債券的基礎註冊交易所交易基金之間動態轉移資本，在股息記錄日期之前從基礎頭寸中部署嚴格的戰術輪換，以使資產增長直接在基金的資產淨值內實現複合增長。

info.description: Engine No. 1 Transform Supply Chain ETF seeks long-term growth of capital. The fund is an actively managed exchange-traded fund ("ETF") that invests in U.S.-listed equity, ADR securities, and non-U.S. developed and emerging market-listed securities, which over time may vary as market and investment opportunities change. The fund may also enter into currency-related spot transactions when it transacts in equities denominated in foreign currencies or invest in certain derivative instruments, such as currency futures or forwards that will help the adviser manage risk associated with foreign currency exposure, if any, or futures contracts. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 一號引擎變革供應鏈ETF尋求資本的長期成長。該基金是主動式管理型交易所交易基金（「ETF」），投資於美國上市股票、ADR 證券以及非美國已開發和新興市場上市證券，隨著時間的推移，這些證券可能會隨著市場和投資機會的變化而變化。當基金進行以外幣計價的股票交易或投資某些衍生性商品（例如貨幣期貨或遠期合約）時，也可能會進行與貨幣相關的現貨交易，這將有助於顧問管理與外幣風險（如有）或期貨合約相關的風險。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Keysight Technologies, Inc. engages in the provision of electronic design and test solutions that are used in the design, development, manufacture, installation, deployment, validation, optimization, and secure operation of electronics systems to communications, networking, and electronics industries. It operates through the Communications Solutions Group (CSG) and Electronic Industrial Solutions Group (EISG) segments. The CSG segment serves customers spanning the global commercial communications and aerospace, defense, and government end markets. The EISG segment offers test and measurement solutions across electronic industrial end markets, focusing on applications in the automotive, and energy industry and measurement solutions for semiconductor design and manufacturing, consumer electronics, education, and general electronics manufacturing. The company was founded by William R. Hewlett and David Packard in 1937 and is headquartered in Santa Rosa, CA.
info.description_zh: 是德科技公司致力於提供電子設計和測試解決方案，這些解決方案用於通訊、網路和電子行業電子系統的設計、開發、製造、安裝、部署、驗證、最佳化和安全操作。它透過通訊解決方案集團（CSG）和電子工業解決方案集團（EISG）部門運作。 CSG 部門為全球商業通訊、航空航太、國防和政府終端市場的客戶提供服務。 EISG 部門提供跨電子工業終端市場的測試和測量解決方案，重點關注汽車和能源產業的應用以及半導體設計和製造、消費性電子、教育和通用電子製造的測量解決方案。該公司由 William R. Hewlett 和 David Packard 於 1937 年創立，總部位於加州聖羅莎。

info.description: TCW Artificial Intelligence ETF seeks long-term growth of capital. The fund will invest, under normal circumstances, at least 80% of the value of its net assets, plus the amount of any borrowings for investment purposes, in securities of businesses that the Adviser has identified, through annual reports, press releases and other public statements by an issuer, as well as the Adviser's due diligence process, as using, or as having demonstrated an intent to use, predictive or generative AI in a way that is or has the potential to deliver a material improvement in the company's financial condition. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: TCW人工智慧ETF尋求資本的長期成長。在正常情況下，該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產價值，加上任何用於投資目的的借款金額，投資於顧問透過發行人的年度報告、新聞稿和其他公開聲明以及顧問的盡職調查流程確定的企業證券，這些企業使用或已表明有意使用預測性或生成性人工智慧，以實現或有可能對公司的財務狀況帶來實質改善。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: AIxCrypto Holdings, Inc. is dedicated to building an ecosystem that integrates AI and blockchain while bridging Web2 and Web3. Its core products include the BesTrade DeAI Agent and the AIxC ecosystem products. The company was founded on March 29, 2004 and is headquartered in Carlsbad, CA.
info.description_zh: AIxCrypto Holdings, Inc.致力於建立一個融合人工智慧和區塊鏈、連接Web2和Web3的生態系統。其核心產品包括BesTrade DeAI Agent和AIxC生態產品。該公司成立於2004年3月29日，總部位於加州卡爾斯巴德。

info.description: Artelo Biosciences, Inc. is a clinical stage biopharmaceutical company, which focuses on the development of therapeutics that target lipid-signaling pathways, including the endocannabinoid system. Its product candidate pipeline includes ART27.13-Synthetic Cannabinoid Agonist, ART26.12-FABP5 inhibitor, and ART12.11-Synthetic CBD Cocrystal. The company was founded on May 2, 2011 and is headquartered in Solana Beach, CA.
info.description_zh: Artelo Biosciences, Inc. 是一家臨床階段生物製藥公司，專注於開發脂質訊號路徑（包括內源性大麻素系統）的療法。其候選產品管道包括 ART27.13-合成大麻素激動劑、ART26.12-FABP5 抑制劑和 ART12.11-合成 CBD Cocrystal。該公司成立於2011年5月2日，總部位於加州索拉納海灘。

info.description: Beneficient is a financial services company, which engages in providing alternative assets, financial and investment services. It offers services to individual investors, wealth advisors, general partners, and institutional investors. It operates through the following segments: Ben Liquidity, Ben Custody, Customer ExAlt Trusts, and Corporate and Other. The Ben Liquidity segment offers liquidity products and services. The Ben Custody segment provides trust and custody administration services. The Customer ExAlt Trusts segment includes investments in alternative assets. The Corporate and Other segment relates to its overhead and administrative costs. The company was founded by Brad K. Heppner on June 6, 2023 and is headquartered in Dallas, TX.

Charlton Aria Acquisition Corp. operates as a blank check company, which engages in the effecting of a merger, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, reorganization or similar business combination with one or more businesses. The company was founded on March 22, 2024 and is headquartered in Wilmington, DE.

Decoy Therapeutics, Inc. operates as a preclinical-stage biotechnology company. It engages in leveraging machine learning and AI tools alongside high-speed synthesis techniques to rapidly design, engineer and manufacture peptide conjugate drug candidates that target serious unmet medical needs. The company was founded by Frederick E. Pierce, Barbara Hibner, Peter Marschel, Michael Lipp, and Jodi Cooper in 2020 and is headquartered in Houston, TX.

DiaMedica Therapeutics, Inc. operates as a clinical stage biopharmaceutical company, which engages in the development of novel recombinant proteins. It develops the DM199 product candidate, which focuses on acute ischemic stroke (AIS) and chronic kidney disease (CKD). The company was founded by Wayne Lautt on January 21, 2000 and is headquartered in Minneapolis, MN.

Entegris, Inc. engages in the development, manufacture, and supply of specialty materials for the microelectronics industry. It operates through the Materials Solutions (MS) and Advanced Purity Solutions (APS) segments. The Materials Solutions segment provides materials-based solutions, such as chemical vapor and atomic layer deposition materials, chemical mechanical planarization ("CMP") slurries and pads, ion implantation specialty gases, formulated etch and clean materials, and other specialty materials that enable customers to achieve better device performance and faster time to yield, while providing for lower total cost of ownership. The Advanced Purity Solutions segment offers filtration, purification and contamination-control solutions that improve customers' yield, device reliability and cost by ensuring the purity of critical liquid chemistries and gases and the cleanliness of wafers and other substrates used throughout semiconductor manufacturing processes, the semiconductor ecosystem and other high-technology industries. The company was founded in 1966 and is headquartered in Billerica, MA.
info.description_zh: Entegris, Inc. 從事微電子行業特殊材料的開發、製造和供應。它透過材料解決方案（MS）和高級純度解決方案（APS）部門運作。材料解決方案部門提供基於材料的解決方案，例如化學氣相和原子層沉積材料、化學機械平坦化（“CMP”）漿料和墊、離子注入特種氣體、配方蝕刻和清潔材料以及其他特種材料，使客戶能夠實現更好的裝置性能和更快的產量，同時降低總擁有成本。高階純度解決方案部門提供過濾、純化和污染控制解決方案，透過確保關鍵液體化學品和氣體的純度以及半導體製造流程、半導體生態系統和其他高科技產業中使用的晶圓和其他基材的清潔度，提高客戶的產量、設備可靠性和成本。該公司成立於 1966 年，總部位於馬薩諸塞州比爾里卡。

info.description: Kulicke & Soffa Industries, Inc. engages in the design, manufacture, and sale of semiconductor and electronics assembly solutions. The firm operates through the Ball Bonding Equipment, Wedge Bonding Equipment, Advanced Solutions, and Aftermarket Products and Services (APS) segments. The Ball Bonding Equipment segment involves the design, development, manufacture and sale of wafer level bonding equipment. The APS segment includes the variety of tools, spares and services for the equipment. The company was founded by Frederick W. Kulicke and Albert Soffa in 1951 and is headquartered in Fort Washington, PA.

Koss Corp. engages in the design, manufacture, and sale of stereo headphones and accessories. Its products include wireless, ear clip, over ear, and on ear earphones, bluetooth speaker and cushions, cases, cables, and apparel accessories. The company was founded by John C. Koss Sr. in 1958 and is headquartered in Milwaukee, WI.

Maison Solutions, Inc. operates as a holding company with interests in food retailing. It offers traditional Asian food and merchandise to U.S. consumers, in particular to members of Asian-American communities. The firm's products include meats, seafood, and Asian vegetables and fruits such as Chinese broccoli, bitter melon, winter gourd, Shanghai baby bokchoy, longan and lychee. The company was founded in July 2019 and is headquartered in Monterey Park, CA.
info.description_zh: Maison Solutions, Inc. 作為一家控股公司經營，涉足食品零售業務。它向美國消費者，特別是亞裔美國人社區的成員提供傳統的亞洲食品和商品。該公司的產品包括肉類、海鮮以及亞洲蔬菜和水果，如綠花椰菜、苦瓜、冬瓜、上海小白菜、龍眼和荔枝。該公司成立於 2019 年 7 月，總部位於加州蒙特利公園。

info.description: Onconetix, Inc. is a commercial stage biotechnology company, which engages in the research, development and commercialization of proprietary therapeutics, diagnostics and services for clinicians and patients for oncology. The company was founded in October 2018 and is headquartered in Cincinnati, OH.
info.description_zh: Onconetix, Inc.是一家商業階段的生物技術公司，致力於為臨床醫生和患者提供腫瘤學專有治療、診斷和服務的研究、開發和商業化。該公司成立於 2018 年 10 月，總部位於俄亥俄州辛辛那提。

info.description: Priority Technology Holdings, Inc. engages in collection, storage, lending, and sending money through its commerce engine. The firm provides merchant services, payables, banking, and treasury solutions. It operates through the following segments: Small and Medium-sized Businesses (SMB) Payments, Business-to-Business (B2B) Payments, and Enterprise Payments. The SMB Payments segment includes provision of full-service acquiring and payment-enabled solutions for business-to-consumer transactions. The B2B Payments segment relates to accounts for payable automation solutions to corporations, software partners, and financial institutions. The Enterprise Payments segment refers to provision of embedded finance and banking as a service (BaaS) solution to customers to modernize legacy platforms and accelerate software partners' strategies to monetize payments. The company was founded by John V. Priore, Thomas Charles Priore, and Sean Kiewiet in August 2005 and is headquartered in Alpharetta, GA.

Patriot Acquisition Corp. is a blank check company, which was formed for the purpose of effecting a merger, consolidation capital stock exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, stock purchase, reorganization, or similar business combination with one or more businesses. The company was founded on October 16, 2025 and is headquartered in Radnor, PA.

Quantum Computing, Inc. engages in developing novel algorithms and solutions utilizing quantum and quantum-inspired computing to solve difficult problems in various industries. It leverages its expertise in finance, computing, security, mathematics, and physics to develop commercial applications for the financial, security, and government sectors. The company was founded on July 25, 2001 and is headquartered in Hoboken, NJ.
info.description_zh: 量子計算公司致力於利用量子和量子啟發計算開發新穎的演算法和解決方案，以解決各行業的難題。它利用其在金融、計算、安全、數學和物理方面的專業知識，為金融、安全和政府部門開發商業應用。該公司成立於2001年7月25日，總部位於新澤西州霍博肯。

info.description: Sanmina Corp. engages in the provision of integrated manufacturing solutions, components, products and repair, logistics and after-market services. It operates through the following segments: Integrated Manufacturing Solutions (IMS) and Components, Products and Services (CPS). The IMS segment consists of printed circuit board assembly and test, final system assembly and test and direct-order-fulfillment. The CPS segment includes interconnect systems and mechanical systems. The company was founded by Jure Sola in 1980 and is headquartered in San Jose, CA.

Silvaco Group, Inc. provides technology computer aided design software, electronic data automation software and semiconductor intellectual property. The TCAD, EDA and SIP solutions enable semiconductor and photonics companies to increase productivity, accelerate their product's time to market and reduce their development and manufacturing costs. Its services include SPICE Modeling Services, TCAD Modeling Services, Library Design Services and Library Characterization Services. The company was founded on November 18, 2009 and is headquartered in Santa Clara, CA.
info.description_zh: Silvaco Group, Inc. 提供技術電腦輔助設計軟體、電子資料自動化軟體和半導體智慧財產權。 TCAD、EDA 和 SIP 解決方案使半導體和光子學公司能夠提高生產力、加快產品上市時間並降低開發和製造成本。其服務包括 SPICE 建模服務、TCAD 建模服務、庫設計服務和庫表徵服務。該公司成立於2009年11月18日，總部位於加州聖克拉拉。

info.description: Teamshares, Inc. is a tech-enabled acquiror of SMEs, intending to be a permanent home when owners retire. The company was founded on June 28, 2019 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: Teamshares, Inc. 是一家以科技為支撐的中小企業收購者，旨在成為業主退休後的永久住所。該公司成立於2019年6月28日，總部位於紐約州紐約。

info.description: Velos Acquisition I Corp. is a blank check company. It was formed for the purpose of effecting a merger, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, reorganization or similar business combination with one or more businesses. The company was founded on March 12, 2024 and is headquartered in New York, NY.

VisionSys AI, Inc. is a holding company, which engages in the provision of IT-focused supplementary science, technology, engineering, and mathematics (STEM) education services. It operates an education platform that has live distance instruction, classroom-based learning, and online learning modules. The company was founded by Shao Yun Han in September 2002 and is headquartered in Beijing, China.
info.description_zh: VisionSys AI, Inc. 是一家控股公司，致力於提供以 IT 為重點的補充科學、技術、工程和數學 (STEM) 教育服務。它經營一個教育平台，具有遠距教學、課堂學習和線上學習模組。該公司由邵雲韓於2002年9月創立，總部位於中國北京。

info.description: Vistagen Therapeutics, Inc. is a late clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company, which engages in developing and commercializing medication and treatment for anxiety, depression, and other central nervous system disorders. Its product portfolio includes Fasedienol (PH94B) nasal spray for social anxiety disorder, Itruvone (PH10) nasal spray for depression disorders, AV-101 oral NMDR glycine site antagonist for depression and neurological disorders, PH15 acute treatment for improvement of cognition, PH80 acute management of vasomotor symptoms due to menopause, and PH284 acute management of Wasting syndrome (Cachexia). The company was founded by H. Ralph Snodgrass and Gordon Keller on May 26, 1998 and is headquartered in South San Francisco, CA.

Lazard Next Gen Technologies ETF seeks long-term capital appreciation. Under normal circumstances, the portfolio invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus any borrowings for investment purposes) in equity and equity-related securities (namely, common and preferred stock, American Depositary Receipts ("ADRs"), Global Depositary Receipts, warrants, rights and participatory notes) of or related to Next Gen Technologies Companies located throughout the world. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Lazard Next Gen Technologies ETF 尋求長期資本增值。在正常情況下，投資組合將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上任何用於投資目的的借款）投資於位於世界各地的下一代技術公司或與其相關的股票和股票相關證券（即普通股和優先股、美國存託憑證（「ADR」）、全球存託憑證、認股權證、權利和參與票據）。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: CleanSpark, Inc. is a bitcoin mining technology company, which engages in the management of data centers. Its operations include College Park, Norcross, Washington, Sandersville, Dalton, and Massena. The company was founded by S. Matthew Schultz and Bryan Huber on October 15, 1987 and is headquartered in Henderson, NV.

Oxley Bridge Acquisition Ltd. operates as a blank check company. It was formed for the purpose of effecting a merger, capital stock exchange, asset acquisition, stock purchase, reorganization or similar business combination with one or more business. The company was founded on August 6, 2024 and is headquartered in Vancouver, Canada.

Pacer Metarus Nasdaq 100 Dividend Multiplier 600 ETF seeks to track the total return performance, before fees and expenses, of the Metaurus Nasdaq Dividend Multiplier Total Return Index - Series 600. The index, as designed, has two components: (i) a Nasdaq-100 component and (ii) a dividend component consisting of long positions in annual futures contracts that provide exposure to ordinary dividends paid on the common stocks of companies included in the Nasdaq-100 Index. The Advisor attempts to invest all, or substantially all, of its assets in the component securities that make up the index. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Pacer Metarus Nasdaq 100 Dividend Multiplier 600 ETF 旨在追蹤 Metaurus Nasdaq Dividend Multiplier Total Return Index - Series 600 的總回報表現（未扣除費用和開支）。按照設計，該指數有兩個組成部分：(i) Nasdaq-100 成分和 (ii) 股息成分，由年度期貨合約的多頭頭寸組成，這些合約提供對包括以下公司的普通股支付的普通股股息的敞口被納入納斯達克 100 指數。顧問試圖將其全部或幾乎全部資產投資於構成指數的組成證券。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Daily surprises, near and far. Your source for travel inspiration and more. Travel moves you!

General Purpose Acquisition Corp. operates as a blank check company. It was formed for the purpose of effecting a merger, amalgamation, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, reorganization, or similar business combination with one or more businesses. The company was founded by Peter Georgiopoulos and Leonard Vrondissis on July 25, 2025 and is headquartered in Millbrook, NY.

Level Four Large Cap Growth Active ETF seeks maximum total return and above peer average risk-adjusted return. The fund invests primarily in equity securities of carefully selected, high-quality U.S. companies. The fund invests primarily in the domestic equity securities of companies selected by Level Four Capital Management, LLC for their growth potential within various market sectors.
info.description_zh: 第四級大盤成長主動 ETF 尋求最大總回報和高於同業平均風險調整回報。本基金主要投資於精心挑選的優質美國公司的股本證券。該基金主要投資於 Level Four Capital Management, LLC 因其在各個市場領域的成長潛力而選擇的公司的國內股本證券。

info.description: Siddhi Acquisition Corp. operates as a blank check company which was formed for the purpose of effecting a merger, capital stock exchange, asset acquisition, stock purchase, reorganization or similar business combination. The company was founded by Brian D. Finn on July 05, 2024 and is headquartered in New York, NY.

Cambridge Acquisition Corp. operates as a blank check company. It was formed for the purpose of effecting a merger, capital stock exchange, asset acquisition, stock purchase, reorganization, or similar business combination with one or more businesses. The company was founded on October 24, 2025 and is headquartered in Boston, MA.

Intelligent Livermore ETF seeks to provide long-term capital appreciation. The fund uses Intelligent Alpha, LLC's proprietary artificial intelligence-powered stock selection strategy to create an intelligent equal weight portfolio of global large cap stocks with over $1 billion in market capitalization. The securities selected will be based on the major trading trends inspired by the greatest traders in the world. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 智能利弗莫爾 ETF 尋求提供長期資本增值。該基金採用Intelligent Alpha, LLC專有的人工智慧選股策略，創造出市值超過10億美元的全球大盤股的智慧等權重投資組合。所選的證券將基於受世界上最偉大的交易者啟發的主要交易趨勢。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Primech Holdings Ltd. engages in the technology-driven facilities services, predominantly serving both public and private sectors throughout Singapore. The firm offers an extensive range of services tailored to meet the complex demands of its diverse clientele. Primech Holdings through its subsidiary Primech AI, develops HYTRON, an autonomous restroom-cleaning robot that combines AI perception with robotic manipulation. Its services include advanced general facility maintenance services, specialized cleaning solutions such as marble polishing and facade cleaning, meticulous stewarding services, and targeted cleaning services for offices and homes. It integrates eco-friendly practices and smart technology solutions to enhance operational efficiency and client satisfaction. The company was founded on December 29, 2020 and is headquartered in Singapore.

AOT Growth and Innovation ETF seeks long-term capital appreciation. The fund is an actively managed exchange-traded fund (ETF) that invests in U.S. listed equity securities that have high growth potential based on a low marginal cost business model. It's investment universe consists of publicly traded equity securities listed in the United States with a minimum market capitalization of $800 million. The Sub-Adviser also excludes REITs, and Business Development Companies ("BDCs").
info.description_zh: AOT 成長與創新 ETF 尋求長期資本增值。該基金是一檔主動管理的交易所交易基金（ETF），投資於基於低邊際成本商業模式的具有高成長潛力的美國上市股票證券。其投資領域包括在美國上市的公開交易股票證券，市值最低為 8 億美元。副顧問也不包括房地產投資信託基金和業務發展公司（「BDC」）。

info.description: HUTCHMED (China) Ltd. is a holding company, which engages in the research and development, manufacture, and sale of pharmaceuticals and health-oriented consumer products. It operates through the Oncology/Immunology and Other Ventures segments. The Oncology/Immunology segment includes the discovery, development, and commercialization of targeted therapies and immunotherapies for the treatment of cancer and immunological diseases. The Other Ventures segment involves the other commercial businesses which include the sales, marketing, manufacture, and distribution of prescription drugs and healthcare products. The company was founded on December 18, 2000 and is headquartered in Hong Kong.

Simplify Tax Aware Diversified Income Strategy ETF is an actively managed fund that seeks capital appreciation by investing in a flexible, multi-strategy portfolio of income-linked instruments, targeting enhanced core fixed income, credit-hedged high yield, option-based income, equity income, and foreign currency strategies. The portfolio executes its exposures predominantly via total return swaps on asset-class-focused ETFs and U.S. Government securities, using a tax-aware framework with one-year contract maturities and minimization of distributions to optimize long-term capital gains and after-tax efficiency.

Hut 8 Corp. engages in the development and operation of data centers at scale, supporting AI, high-performance computing (HPC), ASIC compute, and other energy-intensive technology applications. It operates through the following segments: Power, Digital Infrastructure, Compute, and Others. The Power segment manages the origination, development, and management of powered land and energy infrastructure. The Digital Infrastructure refers to the development, ownership, and operation of facilities designed to support next-generation, energy-intensive technology application. The Compute segment deals with operating businesses that deploy and monetize compute assets across next-generation energy-intensive technology. The Others segment offers equipment sales and repairs. The company was founded on January 27, 2023 and is headquartered in Miami, FL.

Dakota Active Equity ETF seeks to achieve capital appreciation. The fund is an actively managed exchange traded fund ("ETF") that seeks to achieve its investment objective by investing directly or indirectly through other ETFs, in a portfolio of U.S. equity securities. Under normal circumstances, the fund invests at least 80% of its net assets, plus borrowings for investment purposes, in equity securities of U.S. companies or underlying ETFs that provide exposure to equity securities of U.S. companies. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Dakota Active Equity ETF 尋求實現資本增值。該基金是一檔主動管理的交易所交易基金（「ETF」），旨在透過直接或透過其他 ETF 間接投資於美國股本證券投資組合來實現其投資目標。在正常情況下，該基金將至少80%的淨資產以及用於投資目的的借款投資於美國公司的股本證券或提供美國公司股本證券敞口的基礎ETF。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Rain Enhancement Technologies Holdco, Inc. develops, manufactures, and commercializes ionization rainfall generation technology to provide additional rainfall for industries, supranational organizations, countries, and localities. The company is headquartered in Naples, FL.
info.description_zh: Rain Improvement Technologies Holdco, Inc. 開發、製造和商業化電離降雨產生技術，為工業、跨國組織、國家和地區提供額外的降雨。該公司總部位於佛羅裡達州那不勒斯。

info.description: Blue Acquisition Corp. operates as a blank check company. It engages in the effecting of a merger, amalgamation, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, reorganization or similar business combination with one or more businesses. The company was founded on February 10, 2025 and is headquartered in Newport Beach, CA.

Defiance 5G Next Gen Connectivity ETF seeks to track the total return performance, before fees and expenses, of the Bluestar 5G Communications Index (the index). The fund uses a passive management approach to track the total return performance, before fees and expenses, of the index. The index consists of a tiered, modified market capitalization-weighted portfolio of the U.S.-listed equity securities, including depositary receipts, of companies whose products or services are predominantly tied to the development of 5G networking and communication technologies.
info.description_zh: Defiance 5G Next Gen Connectivity ETF 旨在追蹤藍星 5G 通訊指數（簡稱「指數」）扣除費用和開支之前的總回報表現。該基金採用被動管理方法來追蹤該指數扣除費用和支出之前的總回報表現。該指數由在美國上市的股票證券（包括其產品或服務主要與 5G 網路和通訊技術的發展相關的公司的存託憑證）的分級、修改後的市值加權投資組合組成。

info.description: Bold Eagle Acquisition Corp. operates as a blank check company. It formed for the purpose of effecting a merger, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, reorganization and similar business combination with one or more businesses. The company was founded on February 22, 2021 and is headquartered in New York, NY.

Argent Large Cap ETF seeks long-term capital appreciation. The fund is an actively managed exchange-traded fund ("ETF") that seeks to achieve its investment objective by investing in the equity securities of large-capitalization companies that Argent Capital Management LLC, the fund's sub-adviser (the "Sub-Adviser"), believes are high quality, enduring businesses. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Argent Large Cap ETF 尋求長期資本增值。該基金是一檔主動管理的交易所交易基金（「ETF」），旨在透過投資大型公司的股權證券來實現其投資目標，該基金的副顧問（「副顧問」）Argent Capital Management LLC 認為這些公司是高品質、持久的企業。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: SPDR MSCI ACWI Climate Paris Aligned ETF seeks to provide investment results that, before fees and expenses, correspond generally to the total return performance of the MSCI ACWI Climate Paris Aligned Index. The fund generally invests substantially all, but at least 80%, of its total assets in the securities comprising the index. The index is designed to exceed the minimum standards for a "Paris-Aligned Benchmark" under the EU BMR. A Paris-Aligned Benchmark is designed to align with a principal objective of the Paris Agreement to limit the increase in the global average temperature to well below 2 degrees Celsius above pre-industrial levels.
info.description_zh: SPDR MSCI ACWI 氣候巴黎調整 ETF 力求提供在扣除費用和開支之前的投資結果，該結果通常與 MSCI ACWI 氣候巴黎調整指數的總回報表現相對應。該基金通常將其總資產的大部分（但至少 80%）投資於構成該指數的證券。該指數旨在超過歐盟 BMR 下「巴黎一致基準」的最低標準。巴黎協調基準旨在與《巴黎協定》的主要目標保持一致，即將全球平均氣溫上升幅度限制在遠低於工業化前水準 2 攝氏度。

info.description: Baillie Gifford Emerging Markets ETF delivers an actively managed, research-driven framework targeting 60 to 100 high-conviction growth companies across emerging and frontier markets. Capitalizing on structural themes like artificial intelligence infrastructure, supply chain electrification, digital finance, and rising local consumption, the approach employs bottom-up fundamental selection to capture substantial long-term capital appreciation unconstrained by benchmark positioning relative to the MSCI Emerging Markets Index.
info.description_zh: Baillie Gifford Emerging Markets ETF 提供了一個積極管理、研究驅動的框架，針對新興市場和前沿市場的 60 至 100 家高可信度成長型公司。此方法利用人工智慧基礎設施、供應鏈電氣化、數位金融和不斷增長的本地消費等結構性主題，採用自下而上的基本面選擇來捕捉長期資本增值，不受相對於 MSCI 新興市場指數的基準定位的限制。

info.description: Tower Semiconductor Ltd. engages in providing semiconductor solutions. It also offers technology and manufacturing platforms for integrated circuits (ICs) in growing markets such as consumer, industrial, automotive, mobile, infrastructure, medical, and aerospace and defense. It focuses on creating positive and sustainable impact on the world through long term partnerships and its advanced and innovative analog technology offering, comprised of a broad range of customizable process platforms such as SiGe, BiCMOS, mixed-signal/CMOS, RF CMOS, CMOS image sensor, non-imaging sensors, integrated power management (BCD and 700V), and MEMS. Its designs enable a quick and accurate design cycle as well as process transfer services including development, transfer, and optimization, to IDMs and fabless companies. The company was founded in 1993 and is headquartered in Migdal Haemek, Israel.

Keel Infrastructure Corp. engages in building artificial intelligence focused data centers and energy assets. It focuses on infrastructure and energy required to support high-performance computing and artificial intelligence workloads. The company was founded on April 1, 2026 and is headquartered in New York, NY.

Touchstone Large Company Growth ETF utilizes a high-conviction, bottom-up investment approach to identify large-capitalization companies possessing durable competitive advantages and the potential for reliable long-term earnings growth. The strategy integrates a distinct valuation discipline into its selection process, aiming to participate in capital appreciation while maintaining price sensitivity within the growth equity universe by typically maintaining a concentrated portfolio of 25 to 35 equity securities.
info.description_zh: Touchstone大型公司成長ETF採用高信念、自下而上的投資方法來識別擁有持久競爭優勢和可靠的長期獲利成長潛力的大資本公司。該策略將獨特的估值規則融入其選擇過程中，旨在參與資本增值，同時透過通常維持由 25 至 35 種股票證券組成的集中投資組合來維持成長股票領域內的價格敏感度。

info.description: Universal Electronics, Inc. engages in providing universal wireless control solutions for the home. Its offerings include Home Entertainment Products, Climate Control Solutions, Smart Home and Security Products, Software and Cloud Services and Intellectual Property and Licensing. Its brands include One For All and Ecolink. The company was founded on November 21, 1986 and is headquartered in Scottsdale, AZ.

iShares Asia 50 ETF seeks to track the investment results of the S&P Asia 50TM composed of 50 of the largest Asian equities. The fund generally will invest at least 80% of its assets in the component securities of its index and in investments that have economic characteristics that are substantially identical to the component securities of its index and may invest up to 20% of its assets in certain futures, options and swap contracts, cash and cash equivalents. It is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: iShares Asia 50 ETF 旨在追蹤由 50 隻最大的亞洲股票組成的 S&P Asia 50TM 的投資結果。該基金通常將至少 80% 的資產投資於其指數的組成證券以及具有與其指數組成證券基本相同的經濟特徵的投資，並可能將最多 20% 的資產投資於某些期貨、選擇權和掉期合約、現金和現金等價物。它是非多元化的。

Coda Octopus Group, Inc. engages in the developing, manufacturing, and marketing of subsea products. The firm operates through the following segments: Marine Technology Business (Products), Acoustics Sensors and Materials Business (PAL), and Defense Engineering Services Business. The Marine Technology Business segment develops solutions for subsea and underwater markets. The Acoustics Sensors and Materials Business segment engages in the provision of a comprehensive range of products and solutions, with a primary focus on medical imaging and Non-Destructive Testing. The Defense Engineering Services Business segment engages in defense contractors and designs, engineers, manufactures and supplies proprietary sub-assemblies for incorporation into broader mission critical defense systems. It also operates through the Americas, Europe, Australia or Asia, and Middle East or Africa geographical segments. The company was founded in 1994 and is headquartered in Orlando, FL.
info.description_zh: Coda Octopus Group, Inc. 從事海底產品的開發、製造和行銷。該公司透過以下部門運作：海洋技術業務（產品）、聲學感測器和材料業務（PAL）以及國防工程服務業務。海洋技術業務部門為海底和水下市場開發解決方案。聲學感測器和材料業務部門提供全面的產品和解決方案，主要專注於醫學影像和無損檢測。國防工程服務業務部門與國防承包商合作，設計、工程師、製造和供應專有的子組件，以納入更廣泛的關鍵任務防禦系統。它也透過美洲、歐洲、澳洲或亞洲、中東或非洲地理區域開展業務。該公司成立於 1994 年，總部位於佛羅裡達州奧蘭多。

info.description: iTonic Holdings Ltd. operates as a holding company with interests in providing healthcare solutions. The firm through its subsidiaries engages in the development and commercialization of brachytherapy TPS specifically used for radioactive particle implantation, a type of radiotherapy used in treating cancer patients by placing radioactive sources inside the patient that kill cancer cells and shrink tumors. The company was founded in 1998 and is headquartered in Beijing, China.
info.description_zh: iTonic Holdings Ltd. 作為一家控股公司運營，致力於提供醫療保健解決方案。該公司透過其子公司從事專門用於放射性粒子植入的近距離放射治療 TPS 的開發和商業化，這是一種透過將放射源放置在患者體內殺死癌細胞並縮小腫瘤來治療癌症患者的放射療法。公司成立於1998年，總部位於中國北京。

info.description: MIRA Pharmaceuticals, Inc. operates as a clinical development stage biopharmaceutical company. It engages in developing its product candidates, Ketamir-2 and MIRA-55, designed to address unmet medical needs in pain management, depression, PTSD, and cognitive function. The company was founded by Adam Kaplin on September 3, 2020 and is headquartered in Miami, FL.
info.description_zh: MIRA Pharmaceuticals, Inc. 是一家临床开发阶段的生物制药公司。該公司致力於開發候選產品 Ketamir-2 和 MIRA-55，旨在解決疼痛管理、憂鬱症、創傷後壓力症候群 (PTSD) 和認知功能方面未滿足的醫療需求。该公司由 Adam Kaplin 于 2020 年 9 月 3 日创立，总部位于佛罗里达州迈阿密。

info.description: WisdomTree Space Economy Fund invests primarily in equity securities of global companies involved in activities that form the space economy value chain, including launch vehicles, orbital infrastructure, satellite broadband, Earth observation intelligence, and defense space systems. The fund seeks to capture structural growth opportunities tied to the commercial space economy, geospatial intelligence, and defense modernization.

CollPlant Biotechnologies Ltd. operates as a regenerative and aesthetic medicine company. It engages in the research, development, manufacture, and marketing of medical products for tissue repair such as bioprinting of tissues and organs, and medical aesthetics. Its products include VergenixSTR, VergenixFG, and Collink.3D. The company was founded by Oded Shoseyov in June 2004 and is headquartered in Rehovot, Israel.
info.description_zh: CollPlant Biotechnologies Ltd. 是一家再生和美容醫學公司。它從事組織器官生物列印、醫學美容等組織修復醫療產品的研究、開發、製造和行銷。其產品包括VergenixSTR、VergenixFG和Collink.3D。該公司由 Oded Shoseyov 於 2004 年 6 月創立，總部位於以色列雷霍沃特。

info.description: Auddia, Inc. engages in the development of audio content ecosystem technology and products. The firm operates an interactive radio platform called Auddia, which is a subscription based commercial free AM and FM software application. It also offers Vodacast, an interactive podcasting platform and application, which enables listeners to see video and other digital content in a digital feed that correlates with the podcast audio. The company was founded by Jeffrey J. Thramann in 2011 and is headquartered in Boulder, CO.
info.description_zh: Auddia, Inc. 從事音訊內容生態系統技術和產品的開發。該公司經營一個名為 Auddia 的互動廣播平台，這是一個基於訂閱的商業免費 AM 和 FM 軟體應用程式。它還提供 Vodacast，這是一個互動式播客平台和應用程序，使聽眾能夠在與播客音訊相關的數位來源中觀看影片和其他數位內容。該公司由 Jeffrey J. Thramann 於 2011 年創立，總部位於科羅拉多州博爾德。

info.description: Digi Power X, Inc. is an energy infrastructure company that develops cutting-edge data centers to drive the expansion of sustainable energy assets. It focuses on validation through mining, hosting solutions, and blockchain software solutions. It operates through the following segments: Cryptocurrency Mining, Sales of Energy and Electricity, and Colocation Services. The company was founded on February 18, 2017 and is headquartered in Miami, FL.

Quantum X Labs, Inc. engages in the provision of digital advertising platform that develops and markets a variety of technological platforms that automate, optimize, and monetize digital online campaigns. It operates through the Search and Digital Content segments. The Search segment focuses on developing technological software solutions that perform automation, optimization, and monetization of internet campaigns. The Digital Content segment refers to the creation and editing of content to generate revenues from advertising platforms such as Google, Facebook, Yahoo, and Apple. The company was founded by Lior Wayn on August 16, 1985 and is headquartered in Ramat Hachayal, Israel.

Everpure, Inc. engages in the business of delivering innovative and disruptive data storage, products, and services that enable customers to maximize the value of data. The firm is also involved in the provision of data storage and management with a mission to redefine the storage experience by simplifying how people consume and interact with data. The company was founded by John M. Hayes and John Colgrove in October 2009 and is headquartered in Santa Clara, CA.
info.description_zh: Everpure, Inc. 致力於提供創新和顛覆性的資料儲存、產品和服務，使客戶能夠最大限度地發揮資料價值。該公司還提供資料儲存和管理，其使命是透過簡化人們使用資料和與資料互動的方式來重新定義儲存體驗。該公司由 John M. Hayes 和 John Colgrove 於 2009 年 10 月創立，總部位於加州聖克拉拉。

info.description: Zhongchao, Inc. is a holding company, which engages in the provision of healthcare information, education, and training services. It operates under the Services and Drugs segments. It offers online and onsite health information services, healthcare education programs, and healthcare training products, consisting primarily of clinical practice training, open classes of medical topics, interactive case studies, academic conference and workshops, continuing education courses, articles, and short videos with educational healthcare content to healthcare professionals as well as the public. The company was founded by Wei Guang Yang on August 17, 2012 and is headquartered in Shanghai, China.

Direxion Daily MU Bull 2X Shares seeks daily investment results, before fees and expenses, of 200% of the daily performance of MU. The fund, under normal circumstances, invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus any borrowings for investment purposes) in the securities of MU and financial instruments, such as swap agreements and options, that, in combination, provide 2X daily leveraged exposure to MU, consistent with the fund's investment objective. The fund is non-diversified.

DaVita, Inc. engages in the provision of medical care services. It operates through the US Dialysis and Related Lab Services, and Other-Ancillary Services and Strategic Initiatives segments. The US Dialysis and Related Lab Services segment offer kidney dialysis services in the United States for patients suffering from chronic kidney failure. The Other-Ancillary Services and Strategic Initiatives segment consists primarily of pharmacy services, disease management services, vascular access services, clinical research programs, physician services, direct primary care, end stage renal disease seamless care organizations, and comprehensive care. The company was founded in 1994 and is headquartered in Denver, CO.
Single-stock leveraged ETF that seeks daily investment results of 2x (200%) the daily price performance of Everpure, Inc (P; formerly Pure Storage) common stock, before fees and expenses.

Vuzix Corp. is a supplier of Smart-Glasses and Augmented Reality technologies and products for the consumer and enterprise markets. Its products include personal display and wearable computing devices that offer users a portable viewing experience, provide solutions for mobility, wearable displays and augmented reality. The firm also holds 246 patents and patents pending and numerous IP licenses in the Video Eyewear field. It has offices in Rochester, NY, Oxford, UK, and Tokyo, Japan. The company was founded by Paul J. Travers in 1997 and is headquartered in West Henrietta, NY.
info.description_zh: Vuzix Corp. 是一家為消費者和企業市場提供智慧眼鏡和擴增實境技術及產品的供應商。其產品包括個人顯示器和穿戴式運算設備，為使用者提供便攜式觀看體驗，並提供行動性、穿戴式顯示器和擴增實境解決方案。該公司還在視訊眼鏡領域擁有 246 項專利和正在申請的專利以及眾多智慧財產權許可。它在紐約羅徹斯特、英國牛津和日本東京設有辦事處。該公司由 Paul J. Travers 於 1997 年創立，總部位於紐約州西亨麗埃塔。

info.description: AVAX One Technology Ltd. is a digital infrastructure company accelerating the transition to an onchain financial economy. The firm builds power first, modular data centers in energy advantaged regions leveraging behind the meter generation and microgrid design to deliver reliable, cost efficient compute capacity for AI and high-performance computing (HPC) workloads. It continues to mine Bitcoin in Alberta and Ohio, operating at a hashrate of approximately 300 PH/s. The company maintains a strategic Avalanche digital asset treasury, accumulating AVAX and generating onchain yield through native staking and ecosystem participation. Together, these three pillars give public market investors unique exposure to both the digital infrastructure layer and the onchain economy. The company was founded on December 22, 2017 and is headquartered in West Palm Beach, FL.

Alamar Biosciences, Inc. engages in developing a proteomic liquid biopsy platform and sells instruments, consumables & services for the early detection of diseases. Its products include ARGO HT system, NULISA assays for Immunology, neurology & oncology, NULISAqpcr custom assay development, technology access program and Alamar analysis solutions. The company was founded by Yuling Luo, Yiyuan Yin and Steve Chen in May 2018 and is headquartered in Fremont, CA.

Freenome, Inc. operates as an early detection company, which engages in the development of blood-based screening tests to detect cancer. Its proprietary multiomics discovery platform analyzes circulating cell-free DNA methylation patterns at single-base resolution alongside additional biomarkers to detect multiple cancers. The company was founded by Riley Ennis in 2014 and is headquartered in Brisbane, CA.

RUM Group, Inc. engages in operating an online neutral video platform. It operates through the following geographical segments: United States, Canada, and Other. The company was founded in October 2013 by Chris Pavlovski and is headquartered in Longboat Key, FL.
info.description_zh: RUM Group, Inc. 從事營運線上中立視訊平台。它透過以下地理區域運作：美國、加拿大和其他地區。該公司由 Chris Pavlovski 於 2013 年 10 月創立，總部位於佛羅裡達州朗博特島。

info.description: Jet.AI, Inc. engages in the provision of a business-to-business software platform for SaaS products and private aviation services. Its projects include Manitoba, Maritimes, and Moapa. The company was founded by Michael D. Winston on June 4, 2018 and is headquartered in Las Vegas, NV.
info.description_zh: Jet.AI, Inc. 致力於為 SaaS 產品和私人航空服務提供企業對企業軟體平台。其項目包括曼尼托巴省、濱海省和莫阿帕省。該公司由 Michael D. Winston 於 2018 年 6 月 4 日創立，總部位於內華達州拉斯維加斯。

info.description: Firefly Neuroscience, Inc. is an artificial intelligence (AI) technology company, which engages in developing neuroscientific solutions for mental illnesses and neurological disorders. It offers Brain Network Analytics (BNA) platform, a software as a medical solution for the diagnostic and treatment methods for conditions such as depression, dementia, anxiety disorders, concussions, and ADHD. The company was founded in 1979 and is headquartered in Kenmore, NY.

YYForce Ltd. operates as an AI-native workforce management platform, which engages in providing integrated facility management (IFM). Its platform, YY Circle, offers solutions for hospitality, food and beverage, retail, and other service sectors to predict, plan, and optimize workforce deployment. The company was founded by Fu Xiao Wei and Zhang Fan in December 2010 and is headquartered in Singapore.

DNA X, Inc. engages in the provision of crypto trading services to the public. The company was founded by Ram Chandran, Isaac Eteminan, Anush Gopalan, Jai Kumar, Sudu Srinivasan and Joakim Wiklund on August 5, 1999 and is headquartered in San Diego, CA.

Epsium Enterprise Ltd. operates as a holding company, which engages in import trading and distribution of wines and spirits. It offers a range of products, including Chinese liquor, French cognac, Scottish whisky, fine wines, champagne, and other miscellaneous alcoholic beverages. Its brands include Moutai, Xijiu, Wuliangye, Remy Martin Cognac, Macallan, Cointreau, Piper Heidsieck Champagne, French Fine Wines, Red and White Wines. The company was founded by Son I Tam on March 24, 2020 and is headquartered in Macau.
info.industry_zh: 飲料 - 釀酒廠和釀酒廠
info.description_zh: Epsium Enterprise Ltd. 作為一家控股公司運營，從事葡萄酒和烈酒的進口貿易和分銷。它提供一系列產品，包括中國白酒、法國干邑白蘭地、蘇格蘭威士忌、精品葡萄酒、香檳和其他各種酒精飲料。旗下品牌包括茅台、習酒、五糧液、人頭馬干邑、麥卡倫、君度、海德雪香檳、法國精品葡萄酒、紅白葡萄酒等。該公司由Son I Tam於2020年3月24日創立，總部位於澳門。

info.description: 21Shares 2x Long Sui ETF seeks daily investment results, before fees and expenses, that correspond to two times (2x) the daily price performance of SUI. Under normal circumstances, the fund will invest at least 80% of the fund's assets in, or provide exposure equal to, financial instruments that the Adviser and Sub-Adviser believe, in combination, should produce daily returns consistent with the fund's investment objective of seeking daily investment results, before fees and expenses, that correspond to two times (2x) the daily price performance of SUI. The fund does not invest directly in SUI. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 21Shares 2x Long Sui ETF 尋求每日投資結果（扣除費用和開支），相當於 SUI 每日價格表現的兩倍 (2x)。在正常情況下，基金將至少 80% 的基金資產投資於顧問和副顧問認為組合起來應產生與基金的投資目標一致的每日回報（不包括費用和開支）的金融工具，或提供相當於 SUI 每日價格表現兩倍 (2x) 的每日投資結果（扣除費用和開支）。該基金不直接投資於 SUI。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: XCF Global, Inc. is a pioneering sustainable aviation fuel company dedicated to accelerating the aviation industry's transition to net-zero emissions. The firm is developing and operating state-of-the-art clean fuel SAF production facilities engineered to the highest levels of compliance, reliability, and quality. The company is headquartered in Houston, TX.

Filana Therapeutics, Inc. engages in the development of novel drugs and diagnostics. It focuses on developing product candidates intended for the treatment of Alzheimer's disease, including PTI-125 and PTI-125Dx. The company was founded by Remi Barbier in May 1998 and is headquartered in Austin, TX.
info.description_zh: Filana Therapeutics, Inc. 從事新藥和診斷方法的開發。它專注於開髮用於治療阿茲海默症的候選產品，包括 PTI-125 和 PTI-125Dx。該公司由 Remi Barbier 於 1998 年 5 月創立，總部位於德克薩斯州奧斯汀。

info.description: Rocket One, Inc. engages in the development of new generation therapies for dermatological disorders. Its product pipeline focuses on potential treatments for indications including atopic dermatitis (also known as eczema), chronic wounds, psoriasis, asthma, and acne. It offers the BioLexa Platform, a drug compound platform for the treatment of eczema. The company was founded by Robbie Knie, Matthew D. Eitner, and James Ahern on May 16, 2017 and is headquartered in Hoboken, NJ.

LOBO Technologies Ltd. engages in the manufacture and sale of electric vehicles. The company designs and develops e-bicycles, e-mopeds, e-tricycles, and electric off-highway four-wheeled shuttles. It operates through the Electric Vehicles and Accessories Sales and Software Royalties and Development, and Design Services segments. The Electric Vehicles and Accessories Sales segment engages in the manufacture and sale of electric vehicles and accessories. The Software Royalties and Development, and Design Services segment provides software solutions development for automotive electronics. The company was founded on October 25, 2021 and is headquartered in Wuxi, China.
info.description_zh: LOBO Technologies Ltd.從事電動車的製造和銷售。該公司設計和開發電動自行車、電動輕便摩托車、電動三輪車和電動非公路四班車。它透過電動車及配件銷售、軟體版稅和開發以及設計服務部門運作。電動車及配件銷售分部從事電動車及配件的製造及銷售。軟體版稅和開發以及設計服務部門提供汽車電子軟體解決方案開發。公司成立於2021年10月25日，總部位於中國無錫。

info.description: Zeo Energy Corp. operates as a vertically integrated provider of residential solar energy systems, other energy efficient equipment, and related services. The company was founded in 2005 and is headquartered in New Port Richey, FL.

Nuwellis, Inc. operates as a medical device company. It engages in the provision of products for the treatment of fluid overload. The firm's products include Aquadex FlexFlow System, which provides an ultrafiltration for the removal of salt and water in patients with hypervolemia, or fluid overload. It operates through Cardiac and Coronary Disease Products segment. The company was founded by Crispin Marsh and William S. Peters in November 1999 and is headquartered in Eden Prairie, MN.
info.description_zh: Nuwellis, Inc. 是一家醫療器材公司。它從事提供治療液體超負荷的產品。該公司的產品包括 Aquadex FlexFlow 系統，​​該系統提供超濾功能，用於去除血液體積過多或液體超負荷患者的鹽和水。它透過心臟和冠心病產品部門運作。該公司由 Crispin Marsh 和 William S. Peters 於 1999 年 11 月創立，總部位於明尼蘇達州伊甸園草原。

info.description: Turbo Energy SA provides energy solutions. It engages in the developing, manufacturing and distributing of photovoltaic products. The company was founded on September 18, 2013 and is headquartered in Valencia, Spain.
info.description_zh: Turbo Energy SA 提供能源解決方案。它從事光伏產品的開發、製造和銷售。該公司成立於2013年9月18日，總部位於西班牙巴倫西亞。

info.description: Tempest Therapeutics, Inc. is a clinical-stage oncology company advancing a diverse portfolio of small molecule product candidates containing tumor-targeted and/or immune-mediated mechanisms with the potential to treat a wide range of tumors. The company's novel programs range from early research to later-stage investigation in a randomized global study in first-line cancer patients. Tempest Therapeutics was founded in 2011 and is headquartered in Brisbane, CA.
info.description_zh: Tempest Therapeutics, Inc.是一家臨床階段的腫瘤公司，致力於開發多種小分子候選產品組合，其中包含腫瘤靶向和/或免疫介導機制，具有治療多種腫瘤的潛力。該公司的新穎項目涵蓋從早期研究到針對第一線癌症患者的隨機全球研究的後期調查。 Tempest Therapeutics 成立於 2011 年，總部位於加州布里斯班。

info.description: Twin Vee PowerCats Co. engages in the design, manufacture, and sale of recreational and commercial power catamaran boats. The firm is focused on designing and developing its products under the ELECTRA Power Sports brand. It operates through the Twin Vee PowerCats and Wizz Banger, Inc. Segments. The Twin Vee PowerCats segment designs, manufactures, and sells recreational and commercial powerboats. The Wizz Banger, Inc. segment refers to a development-stage subsidiary with plans to develop an innovative online marketplace leveraging artificial intelligence (AI) to transform how customers search for and purchase recreational marine assets. The company was founded by Roger Dunshee in 1996 and is headquartered in Fort Pierce, FL.

Datasea Intelligent Technology Ltd. operates as a provider of products, services, and integrated solutions for enterprise and retail customers. The company's advanced research and development capabilities form the core infrastructure and backbone of its offerings, supported by a cloud-based, AI-driven platform that enables intelligent data integration and application. It is also focusing on medical applications, such as ultrasonic cosmetology. The company was founded on January 8, 2026 and is headquartered in Beijing, China.

Murano Global Investments Plc operates as a real estate company. The firm owns, develops and invests in hotel, resort and commercial properties. It focuses on capturing value at all stages of the real estate cycle. The company was founded in 2010 and is headquartered in London, the United Kingdom.

Black Titan Corp. was formed for the purpose of effecting a merger between Titan Pharmaceuticals Inc. and TalenTec Sdn Bhd. It intends to explore and identify viable business opportunities. The company was founded on July 11, 2024 and is headquartered in Petaling Jaya, Malaysia.

IM Cannabis Corp. engages in the production and sale of medical cannabis products. It offers dry flower products and cannabis oil products under the IMC brand. The company was founded on March 7, 1980 and is headquartered in Glil Yam, Israel.

info.description: Silexion Therapeutics Corp. is a clinical-stage biotechnology company, which engages in the discovery and development of treatments for KRAS-driven cancers. The company was founded on November 30, 2008 and is headquartered in in Modiin, Israel.

info.description: Jaguar Health, Inc. is a commercial stage pharmaceuticals company, which engages in the development of gastrointestinal products. It operates through the following segments: Animal Health and Human Health. The Animal Health segment is focused on development and commercialization of prescription and non-prescription products for companion and production animals. The Human Health segment is involved in manufacturing human products and the ongoing advertising of Mytesi, which is used for the symptomatic relief of non-infectious diarrhea in adults with HIV/AIDS on antiretroviral therapy. The company was founded by Lisa A. Conte on June 6, 2013 and is headquartered in San Francisco, CA.

Amber International Holding Ltd. is a web3 financial solutions and infrastructure company it provides institutional market access, execution infrastructure, and investment solutions to help institutions and high-net-worth individuals optimize their digital asset portfolios. Its operations through the following Amber Premium brand. It operates through the Marketing Solutions and Enterprise Solutions segments. The company is headquartered in Singapore.

21Shares Sui ETF is a passive investment fund designed to provide direct, regulated exposure to SUI, the native token of the Sui Network, by tracking its performance via a specific pricing benchmark. The strategy involves holding physical SUI tokens in institutional-grade custody and seeks to reflect additional rewards generated from staking a portion of the Trust's SUI holdings, net of expenses and liabilities.
