Under normal circumstances, the fund will invest at least 80% of its net assets in the securities of investment vehicles that offer exposure to the digital assets that comprise the CoinShares-Compass Crypto Market 35% Capped Index. The index is a diversified digital asset index which seeks to track the performance of the ten largest digital assets by market capitalization, weighted according to their market capitalization with a maximum weighting of 35%. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: CoinShares Altcoins ETF 旨在提供資本增值。在正常情況下，該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產投資於投資工具的證券，這些投資工具提供構成 CoinShares-Compass 加密貨幣市場 35% 上限指數的數位資產的曝險。該指數是一個多元化的數位資產指數，旨在追蹤市值最大的十大數位資產的表現，並根據其市值進行加權，最大權重為35%。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Mettler-Toledo International, Inc. engages in the provision of precision instruments and services. The firm manufactures weighing instruments for use in laboratory, industrial, packaging, logistics, and food retailing applications. It also manufactures several related analytical instruments and provides automated chemistry solutions used in drug and chemical compound discovery and development, metal detection and other end-of-line inspection systems used in production and packaging and provides solutions for use in certain process analytics applications. It operates through the following segments: U.S. Operations, Swiss Operations, Western European Operations, Chinese Operations, and Other Operations. The U.S. Operations segment represents certain of the company's marketing and producing organizations located in the United States. The Swiss Operations segment is involved in the marketing and producing organizations located in Switzerland, as well as extensive research and development operations that are responsible for the development, production, and marketing of precision instruments, including weighing, analytical, and measurement technologies for use in a variety of industrial, and laboratory applications. The Western European Operations segment includes marketing and producing organizations in Western Europe, excluding operations located in Switzerland. The Chinese Operations segment focuses on marketing and producing organizations located in China. The Other Operations segment refers to the operations that exist outside these reportable segments. The company was founded in 1991 and is headquartered in Columbus, OH.

Agilent Technologies, Inc. engages in the provision of application focused solutions for life sciences, diagnostics, and applied chemical markets. It operates through the following segments: Life Sciences and Diagnostics Markets, Applied Markets, and Agilent CrossLab. The Life Sciences and Diagnostics Markets segment offers active pharmaceutical ingredients for oligo-based therapeutics as well as solutions that include reagents, instruments, software and consumables. The Applied Markets segment refers to the application-focused solutions that include instruments and software that enable customers to identify, quantify, and analyze the physical and biological properties of substances and products. The Agilent CrossLab segment spans the entire lab with its extensive services and consumables portfolio in addition to software and laboratory automation solutions. The company was founded in May 1999 and is headquartered in Santa Clara, CA.

ProShares Ultra QQQ TOP 30 seeks daily investment results, before fees and expenses, that correspond to two times (2x) of the daily performance of the Nasdaq-100 Top 30 Index. The fund invests in financial instruments that ProShare Advisors believes, in combination, should produce daily returns consistent with the daily target. The index is designed to measure the performance of the top 30 companies from the Nasdaq-100 Index. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: ProShares Ultra QQQ TOP 30 尋求每日投資結果（未計費用和開支），相當於 Nasdaq-100 Top 30 指數每日表現的兩倍 (2x)。該基金投資於 ProShare Advisors 認為綜合起來應產生與每日目標一致的每日回報的金融工具。該指數旨在衡量納斯達克 100 指數中排名前 30 名的公司的表現。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: TON Strategy Co. operates as a digital asset treasury company. It focuses on the Toncoin ecosystem. The company was founded by Rory J. Cutaia on November 27, 2012 and is headquartered in Las Vegas, NV.

WEBs Defined Volatility QQQ ETF seeks to provide investment results that, before fees and expenses, correspond to the performance of the Syntax Defined Volatility Triple Q's Index. The manager implements its investment objective by investing, under normal market conditions, at least 80% of its net assets in financial instruments that achieve the investment results of the index. The index is a rules-based strategy that seeks to track the performance of the Invesco QQQ TrustSM, Series 1, with investment exposure to the underlying ETF adjusted for a targeted annual volatility rate of 22%. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: WEBs Defined Volatility QQQ ETF 力求提供扣除費用和開支先前與 Syntax Defined Volatility Triple Q 指數表現相對應的投資結果。管理人透過在正常市場條件下將至少 80% 的淨資產投資於實現指數投資結果的金融工具來實現其投資目標。該指數是一種基於規則的策略，旨在追蹤 Invesco QQQ TrustSM 系列 1 的表現，基礎 ETF 的投資曝險根據 22% 的目標年度波動率進行調整。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Amneal Pharmaceuticals, Inc. is a medicine company, which engages in the provision of pharmaceuticals. Its product portfolio includes generics, specialty, biosciences, and product catalog. It operates through the following segments: Generics, Specialty, and AvKARE. The Generics segment relates to oral solids, powders, liquids, sterile injectables, nasal sprays, inhalation and respiratory products, biosimilar products, ophthalmics, films, and transdermal patches and topicals. The Specialty segment refers to the development, promotion, sale, and distribution of proprietary branded pharmaceutical products. The AvKARE segment provides pharmaceuticals, medical, and surgical products and services to governmental agencies. The company was founded by Chirag K. Patel and Chintu Patel in 2002 and is headquartered in Bridgewater, NJ.
info.industry_zh: 藥品製造商 - 特用藥品和非專利藥品
info.description_zh: Amneal Pharmaceuticals, Inc. 是一家從事藥品供應的醫藥公司。其產品組合包括仿製藥、特種藥、生物科學和產品目錄。它透過以下部門運作：仿製藥部門、專業部門和 AvKARE 部門。仿製藥部門涉及口服固體、粉末、液體、無菌注射劑、鼻噴劑、吸入和呼吸產品、生物相似藥、眼科、薄膜、透皮貼片和外用藥。特種藥品部門是指專有品牌藥品的開發、推廣、銷售及分銷。 AvKARE 部門向政府機構提供藥物、醫療和外科產品及服務。該公司由 Chirag K. Patel 和 Chintu Patel 於 2002 年創立，總部位於新澤西州布里奇沃特。

info.description: NICE Ltd. engages in the provision of enterprise software solutions and services. It operates through the following segments: Customer Engagement, and Financial Crime and Compliance Solutions. The Customer Engagement segment provides suites such as compliance and risk, workforce optimization, operational efficiency, customer experience, and sales and retention. The Financial Crime and Compliance Solutions segment includes embedded-AI solutions that identify risks and help prevent money laundering and fraud, as well as help ensure financial markets compliance in real-time. The company was founded on September 28, 1986 and is headquartered in Raanana, Israel.

Smith & Wesson Brands, Inc. is a holding company, which engages in the manufacture, design, and provision of firearms. Its portfolio includes handguns, long guns, handcuffs, suppressor, and other firearm-related products. The firm's brands are Smith & Wesson, M&P, Thompson/Center Arms, and Gemtech. The company was founded by Horace Smith and Daniel Baird Wesson in 1852 and is headquartered in Maryville, TN.

Global X NASDAQ 100 Collar 95-110 ETF seeks to provide investment results that correspond generally to the price and yield performance,before fees and expenses, of the Nasdaq-100 Quarterly Collar 95-110 Index ("underlying index"). The fund invests at least 80% of its total assets in the securities of the Nasdaq-100 Quarterly Collar 95-110 Index ("underlying index"). The underlying index measures the performance of a risk management strategy that holds the underlying stocks of the NASDAQ 100 Index and applies an options collar strategy (i.e., a mix of short (sold) call options and long (purchased) put options) on the NASDAQ 100 Index. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Global X NASDAQ 100 Collar 95-110 ETF 尋求提供與 Nasdaq-100 Quarterly Collar 95-110 指數（「基礎指數」）的價格和收益率表現（扣除費用和開支）大致相對應的投資結果。該基金將其總資產的至少 80% 投資於 Nasdaq-100 Quarterly Collar 95-110 指數（「基礎指數」）的證券。標的指數衡量持有納斯達克 100 指數標的股票的風險管理策略的績效，並對納斯達克 100 指數應用期權領策略（即空頭（賣出）看漲期權和多頭（買入）看跌期權的組合）。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Pacer Nasdaq 100 Top 50 Cash Cows Growth Leaders ETF seeks to track the total return performance, before fees and expenses, of the Pacer Nasdaq 100 Top 50 Cash Cows Growth Leaders Index. The initial Index universe is typically derived from the component companies of the Nasdaq-100 Index. The initial universe of companies is typically screened based on their average projected free cash flows and earnings (if available) over each of the next two fiscal years. Under normal circumstances, the fund will seek to invest at least 80% of the fund's total assets in growth securities. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Pacer Nasdaq 100 Top 50 Cash Cows Growth Leaders ETF 旨在追蹤 Pacer Nasdaq 100 Top 50 Cash Cows Growth Leaders Index 扣除費用和開支之前的總回報表現。最初的指數範圍通常源自於納斯達克 100 指數的成分公司。公司的初始範圍通常是根據未來兩個財政年度的平均預期自由現金流和收益（如果有）進行篩選的。一般情況下，基金會尋求將基金總資產的至少80%投資於成長型證券。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: REX IncomeMax Option Strategy ETF seeks current income and exposure to the share price of select U.S.-listed securities, subject to a limit on potential investment gains. The fund is an actively managed exchange-traded fund ("ETF") that seeks current income and exposure to the share price of select U.S.-listed securities, subject to a limit on potential investment gains. Under normal circumstances, the fund will invest in Underlying Securities directly. The fund is non-diversified.

JPMorgan Nasdaq Hedged Equity Laddered Overlay ETF seeks to provide capital appreciation. The manager seeks to provide capital appreciation through participation in the broad equity markets while hedging overall market exposure relative to traditional long-only equity strategies. The manager seeks to provide capital appreciation through participation in the broad equity markets while hedging overall market exposure relative to traditional long-only equity strategies. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 摩根大通納斯達克對沖股票階梯疊加 ETF 旨在提供資本增值。管理人尋求透過參與廣泛的股票市場來提供資本增值，同時對沖相對於傳統多頭股票策略的整體市場風險。管理人尋求透過參與廣泛的股票市場來提供資本增值，同時對沖相對於傳統多頭股票策略的整體市場風險。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Invesco QQQ Hedged Advantage ETF seeks to provide capital appreciation. The manager seeks to achieve its investment objective by investing primarily in a portfolio of U.S. equity securities that is intended to substantially replicate the performance of the Nasdaq-100 Index and utilizing an option overlay strategy designed to partially hedge the fund's downside exposure when equity markets decline. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Invesco QQQ 對沖優勢 ETF 旨在提供資本增值。該管理人尋求透過主要投資於美國股票證券投資組合來實現其投資目標，該投資組合旨在大幅複製納斯達克 100 指數的表現，並利用旨在部分對沖股市下跌時基金下行風險的期權疊加策略。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Crocs, Inc. engages in the design, development, manufacture, worldwide marketing, sale, and distribution of lifestyle footwear and accessories. It operates through the Crocs Brand and HEYDUDE Brand segments. The Crocs Brand segment refers to the United States, South Korea, China, Japan, Singapore, Canada, Germany, Great Britain, France, Malaysia, Australia, Puerto Rico, the Netherlands, Australia, India, and Ireland. The HEYDUDE Brand segment focuses on the United States. The company was founded by Scott Seamans, George B. Boedecker, Jr., and Lyndon V. Hanson III in 2002 and is headquartered in Broomfield, CO.
info.description_zh: Crocs, Inc. 從事時尚鞋類和配件的設計、開發、製造、全球行銷、銷售和分銷。它透過 Crocs 品牌和 HEYDUDE 品牌部門運作。 Crocs 品牌細分市場涉及美國、韓國、中國、日本、新加坡、加拿大、德國、英國、法國、馬來西亞、澳洲、波多黎各、荷蘭、澳洲、印度和愛爾蘭。 HEYDUDE 品牌細分市場專注於美國。該公司由 Scott Seamans、George B. Boedecker, Jr. 和 Lyndon V. Hanson III 於 2002 年創立，總部位於科羅拉多州布魯姆菲爾德。

info.description: Global X Genomics & Biotechnology ETF seeks to provide investment results that correspond generally to the price and yield performance, before fees and expenses, of the Solactive Genomics Index ("underlying index"). The fund invests at least 80% of its total assets in the securities of the underlying index. The underlying index is designed to provide exposure to exchange-listed companies that are positioned to benefit from further advances in the field of genomic science and biotechnology, as well as applications thereof (collectively, "Genomics & Biotechnology Companies"), as defined by Solactive AG, the provider of the underlying index. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Global X Genomics & Biotechnology ETF 力求提供與 Solactive Genomics 指數（「基礎指數」）未計費用和開支前的價格和收益率表現大致相符的投資結果。該基金將其總資產的至少 80% 投資於相關指數的證券。基礎指數旨在為交易所上市公司提供投資機會，這些公司將受益於基因組科學和生物技術及其應用領域的進一步發展（統稱為「基因組學和生物技術公司」），正如基礎指數提供商 Solactive AG 所定義的那樣。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: The KraneShares InspereX Nasdaq Dynamic Buffered High Income Index ETF seeks to provide investment results that, before fees and expenses, correspond generally to the price and yield performance of a specific equity and derivative securities index. The Fund's current index is the Nasdaq InspereX Dynamic Buffered High Income Index. The Underlying Index is designed to track the performance of a systematic enhanced collar strategy that seeks to limit losses while providing option income. The Underlying Index models a strategy that includes these components: 1.total return exposure to the Nasdaq-100 Index; 2.short call options (i.e., selling call options) on the Nasdaq-100 Index, which involve the selling of a series of short-dated call options (i.e., five days or less) to generate option income, with new call options being sold each day; and 3. short futures positions (i.e., selling futures) on the Nasdaq-100 Futures Excess Return Index, which is dynamically adjusted on a daily basis as it seeks to replicate the effect of rolling monthly put options on the Nasdaq-100 Index and provide downside protection against losses. The Fund may invest directly in any component of the Nasdaq-100 Index or may invest in an exchange-traded fund ("ETF") that seeks to track the Nasdaq-100 Index.
info.description_zh: KraneShares InspereX 納斯達克動態緩衝高收入指數 ETF 旨在提供未計費用和支出的投資結果，該結果通常與特定股票和衍生證券指數的價格和收益率表現相對應。該基金目前的指數是納斯達克InspereX動態緩衝高收入指數。基礎指數旨在追蹤系統性增強型領子策略的表現，該策略旨在限制損失，同時提供選擇權收入。基礎指數模型包含以下組成部分的策略： 1. 納斯達克 100 指數的總回報敞口； 2.納斯達克 100指數的空頭買權（即賣出買權），涉及賣出一系列短期（即五天或以下）買權以產生選擇權收入，每天都會賣出新的買權；期貨超額回報指數的空頭期貨部位（即賣出期貨），該指數每天動態調整，旨在複製納斯達克 100 指數每月滾動看跌期權的效果，並提供針對損失的下行保護。該基金可以直接投資於 Nasdaq-100 指數的任何組成部分，也可以投資於追蹤 Nasdaq-100 指數的交易所交易基金（「ETF」）。

info.description: EverCommerce, Inc. engages in providing integrated, vertically-tailored software-as-a-service solutions for service-based small and medium sized businesses. It operates through the United States and International geographical segments. The company was founded by Eric Remer in September 2016 and is headquartered in Denver, CO.

Certara, Inc. engages in the provision of software and technology-enabled services for drug developers. It offers cell and gene therapy, clinical pharmacology, complex biologics, decision analytics and modeling, drug development and regulatory strategy, and model-based analysis services. The company was founded on June 27, 2017 and is headquartered in Radnor, PA.

Golden Eagle Dynamic Hypergrowth ETF seeks capital appreciation. The fund is an actively managed exchange-traded fund that seeks to achieve its investment objective by investing, under normal market conditions, at least 80% of its net assets (plus any borrowings for investment purposes) in the common stock of "hypergrowth companies.
info.description_zh: 金鷹動態超增長ETF尋求資本增值。該基金是一檔主動管理的交易所交易基金，旨在透過在正常市場條件下將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上任何用於投資目的的借款）投資於「高速成長公司」的普通股來實現其投資目標。

info.description: First Trust NASDAQ-100 Equal Weighted Index Fund seeks investment results that correspond generally to the price and yield (before the fund's fees and expenses) of an equity index called the NASDAQ-100 Equal Weighted TM Index. The fund will normally invest at least 90% of its net assets (including investment borrowings) in the securities that comprise the index. The index is the equal-weighted version of the NASDAQ-100 Index which includes 100 of the largest U.S. and international non-financial companies listed on Nasdaq based on market capitalization.
info.description_zh: First Trust NASDAQ-100 等加權指數基金尋求的投資結果通常與名為 NASDAQ-100 等加權 TM 指數的股票指數的價格和收益率（基金費用和開支之前）相對應。該基金通常將至少 90% 的淨資產（包括投資借款）投資於構成該指數的證券。該指數是 NASDAQ-100 指數的等權重版本，其中包括按市值計算在納斯達克上市的 100 家最大的美國和國際非金融公司。

info.description: Leverage Shares 2X Long TSM Daily ETF seeks daily levered investment results, before fees and expenses, of two times (200%) of the daily percentage change in the price of TSM. The fund is an actively managed ETF. It invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus borrowings for investment purposes) in financial instruments with economic characteristics that, in combination, provide 200% daily leveraged exposure to the price of TSM, consistent with the fund's investment objective. The fund is non-diversified.

ProShares Ultra QQQ Equal Weight seeks daily investment results, before fees and expenses, that correspond to two times (2x) the daily performance of the Nasdaq-100 Equal Weighted Index. The fund offers magnified exposure to equal-weighted Nasdaq-100 constituents, reducing mega-cap technology concentration while providing 2x leveraged daily index participation.

Invesco QQQ Equal Weight ETF is a non-diversified, index-based strategy that provides exposure to the 100 largest non-financial companies listed on the Nasdaq Stock Market using an equal-weighted methodology. The fund offers a balanced path to the Nasdaq-100 universe by assigning an initial 1% weight to each constituent, effectively mitigating the single-stock and mega-cap concentration risk inherent in market-capitalization-weighted strategies
info.description_zh: Invesco QQQ 等權重 ETF 是一種非多元化、基於指數的策略，採用等權重方法提供對納斯達克股票市場上市的 100 家最大非金融公司的投資。該基金為每個成分股分配初始 1% 的權重，為進入納斯達克 100 指數提供了一條平衡的路徑，有效降低了市值加權策略中固有的單股和大型股集中風險

info.description: CYBER HORNET S&P 500 and Solana 75/25 Strategy ETF seeks to replicate, before fees and expenses, the total return of the S&P 500 and S&P Solana 75/25 Blend Index. The index measures the weighted return performance of a multi-asset strategy that consists of a 75% weight in the S&P 500 Index and a 25% weight in the S&P Solana Index. The fund will invest approximately 75% of its assets in the stock of large U.S. companies that comprise the S&P 500 Index and will invest in Solana so that the total value of the Solana to which the fund has economic exposure is approximately 25% of the assets of the fund.
info.description_zh: CYBER HORNET S&P 500 和 Solana 75/25 策略 ETF 力求在扣除費用和開支之前複製 S&P 500 和 S&P Solana 75/25 混合指數的總回報。該指數衡量多元資產策略的加權報酬表現，其中 S&P 500 指數權重為 75%，S&P Solana 指數權重為 25%。該基金將把約 75% 的資產投資於構成 S&P 500 指數的美國大型公司的股票，並將投資於 Solana，以便該基金所涉經濟風險的 Solana 總價值約為該基金資產的 25%。

info.description: Tailwind 2.0 Acquisition Corp. is a blank check company. The company was founded on May 29, 2025 and is headquartered in Greenwich, CT.
info.description_zh: Tailwind 2.0 Acquisition Corp. 是一家空白支票公司。該公司成立於2025年5月29日，總部位於康乃狄克州格林威治。

info.description: First Trust Switzerland AlphaDEX Fund seeks investment results that correspond generally to the price and yield (before the fund's fees and expenses) of an equity index called the NASDAQ AlphaDEX Switzerland Index. The fund will normally invest at least 90% of its net assets (including investment borrowings) in the securities that comprise the index. The index is designed to select stocks from the NASDAQ Switzerland Index (the "base index") that may generate positive alpha, or risk-adjusted returns, relative to traditional indices through the use of the AlphaDEX selection methodology.
info.description_zh: First Trust Switzerland AlphaDEX 基金尋求的投資結果通常與稱為納斯達克 AlphaDEX 瑞士指數的股票指數的價格和收益率（在基金費用和開支之前）相對應。該基金通常將至少 90% 的淨資產（包括投資借款）投資於構成該指數的證券。該指數旨在透過使用 AlphaDEX 選擇方法，從納斯達克瑞士指數（「基礎指數」）中選擇相對於傳統指數可產生正 alpha 或風險調整回報的股票。

info.description: iShares Nasdaq-100 ex Top 30 ETF seeks to track the investment results of the Nasdaq-100 ex Top 30 Index. The index measures the performance of approximately 70 securities of domestic and international non-financial companies listed on Nasdaq based on market capitalization, as determined by Nasdaq, Inc. The fund generally will invest at least 80% of its assets in the component securities of its underlying index.
info.description_zh: iShares Nasdaq-100 ex Top 30 ETF 旨在追蹤 Nasdaq-100 ex Top 30 指數的投資結果。該指數根據納斯達克公司確定的市值衡量在納斯達克上市的約 70 種國內和國際非金融公司證券的表現。該基金通常將至少 80% 的資產投資於其基礎指數的組成證券。

info.description: Themes Cloud Computing ETF seeks to track the performance, before fees and expenses, of the Solactive Cloud Computing Index. The index is designed to provide exposure to companies that have business operations in the field of cloud computing based in developed market countries. The fund will invest, under normal circumstances, at least 80% of its net assets, plus the amount of any borrowings for investment purposes, in securities that comprise the index and in American Depositary Receipts ("ADRs") and Global Depositary Receipts ("GDRs") based on the securities in the index. The fund is non-diversified.

Silver Pegasus Acquisition Corp. operates as a blank check company. It was formed for the purpose of effecting a merger, amalgamation, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, reorganization or similar business combination with one or more businesses. The company was founded on June 5, 2024 and is headquartered in Santa Clara, CA.
info.description_zh: Silver Pegasus Acquisition Corp. 作為一家空白支票公司營運。它的成立目的是與一個或多個企業進行合併、合併、股份交換、資產收購、股份購買、重組或類似的業務合併。該公司成立於2024年6月5日，總部位於加州聖克拉拉。

info.description: Horizon NASDAQ-100 Defined Risk ETF seeks capital appreciation and capital preservation. Horizon Investments, LLC ("Horizon" or the "Adviser") seeks to achieve the fund's investment objective by investing primarily in Flexible Exchange Options ("FLEX Options") that provide exposure to the Nasdaq-100 Index and implementing an options-based strategy that seeks to generate income, manage volatility and reduce downside risk.
info.description_zh: Horizo​​n NASDAQ-100 定義風險 ETF 尋求資本增值和資本保值。 Horizo​​n Investments, LLC（「Horizo​​n」或「顧問」）尋求透過主要投資於提供納斯達克 100 指數曝險的靈活交易選擇權（「FLEX 選擇權」）並實施旨在產生收入、管理波動性和降低下行風險的基於選擇權的策略來實現基金的投資目標。

info.description: Cadence Design Systems, Inc. engages in the provision of design and development of integrated circuits and electronic devices. It operates through the following geographical segments: Americas, Asia, EMEA, and Japan. The company was founded by Alberto Sangiovanni-Vincentelli, Gudmundur A. Hjartarson, K. Bobby Chao, and K. Charles Janac in June 1988 and is headquartered in San Jose, CA.
info.description_zh: Cadence Design Systems, Inc. 從事積體電路和電子設備的設計和開發。它透過以下地理區域開展業務：美洲、亞洲、歐洲、中東和非洲和日本。該公司由 Alberto Sangiovanni-Vincentelli、Gudmundur A. Hjartarson、K. Bobby Chao 和 K. Charles Janac 於 1988 年 6 月創立，總部位於加州聖荷西。

info.description: Nasdaq, Inc. is a holding company, which engages in trading, clearing, exchange technology, regulatory, securities listing, information, and public and private company services. It operates through the following segments: Capital Access Platforms, Financial Technology, and Market Services. The Capital Access Platforms segment delivers liquidity, transparency, and integrity to the corporate issuer and investment community by empowering clients to effectively navigate the capital markets, achieve their sustainability goals, and drive governance excellence. The Financial Technology segment offers platforms that improve the liquidity, transparency, and integrity of the global economy by architecting and operating the markets. The Market Services segment includes equity derivative trading and clearing, cash equity trading, fixed income, currency, and commodities trading. The company was founded by Gordon S. Macklin in 1971 and is headquartered in New York, NY.

American Dynamism Acquisition Co. operates as a blank check company. info.description: Pacer BlueStar Engineering the Future ETF seeks to track the total return performance, before fees and expenses, of the BlueStar Robotics and 3D Printing Index (the "Index"). The index is a rules-based index that consists of globally-listed stocks and depositary receipts of companies that derive at least 50% of their revenues from Robotics and 3D Printing Companies, as determined by the index provider. The fund adviser will generally use a "replication" strategy to achieve its investment objective, meaning it will invest in all of the component securities of the index. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Pacer BlueStar Engineering the Future ETF 旨在追蹤 BlueStar 機器人和 3D 列印指數（「指數」）扣除費用和開支之前的總回報表現。該指數是一個基於規則的指數，由指數提供者確定的至少 50% 收入來自機器人和 3D 列印公司的全球上市股票和存託憑證組成。基金顧問通常會使用「複製」策略來實現其投資目標，這意味著它將投資於指數的所有組成證券。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Check Point Software Technologies Ltd. is engaged in the development and marketing of software and hardware solutions for information technology security. Its products include Quantum, CloudGuard, Harmony, and Infinity-Vision. The company was founded by Gil Shwed, Marius Nacht, and Shlomo Kramer in July 1993 and is headquartered in Tel Aviv, Israel.

EDAP TMS SA is a holding company, which, through its subsidiary, engages in the development, production, and marketing of minimally invasive medical devices for urological diseases. It operates through the High Intensity Focused Ultrasound (HIFU) and Urology Devices and Services (UDS) segments. The HIFU segment develops, manufactures, and markets devices for the minimally invasive ablation of certain types of localized tumors using HIFU technology. The UDS segment focuses on the development, marketing, manufacturing, and servicing of medical devices for the minimally invasive diagnosis or treatment of urological disorders, mainly urinary stones, and other clinical indications. The company was founded on December 3, 1979 and is headquartered in Vaulx-en-Velin, France.

Grab Holdings Ltd. engages in the provision of millions of people each day to access its driver- and merchant-partners to order food or groceries, send packages, hail a ride or taxi, pay for online purchases or access services such as lending, insurance, wealth management and telemedicine, all through a single "everyday everything" app. The firm operates in food deliveries and mobility and by TPV in the e-wallets segment of financial services in Southeast Asia. It operates through the following segments: Deliveries, Mobility, Financial Services, and Others. The Deliveries segment connects driver-partner and merchant-partners with consumers to create a localized logistics platform, facilitating, and performing on-demand and scheduled delivery of a wide variety of daily necessities, including ready-to-eat meals and groceries, as well as point-to-point parcel delivery. The Mobility segment offers consumers rides provided by driver-partners across a wide variety of multi-modal mobility options. The Financial Services segments include digital payments, lending, receivables factoring, and digital banking services in certain markets. The Others segment deals with mapping services, autonomous vehicle services, and last-mile delivery infrastructure. The company was founded by Anthony Tan Ping Yeow and Tan Hooi Ling in 2012 and is headquartered in Singapore.

Leverage Shares 2X Long GRAB Daily ETF seeks daily levered investment results, before fees and expenses, of two times (200%) of the daily percentage change in the price of the ADR of GRAB. The fund is an actively managed ETF. The fund invests at least 80% of its net assets in the Underlying Security and financial instruments with economic characteristics that, in combination, provide 200% daily leveraged exposure to the price of GRAB, consistent with the fund's investment objective. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 槓桿股票 2 倍多頭 GRAB 每日 ETF 尋求每日槓桿投資結果（未計費用和開支）為 GRAB ADR 價格每日百分比變化的兩倍 (200%)。該基金是主動式管理ETF。該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產投資於標的證券和具有經濟特徵的金融工具，這些工具結合起來提供 GRAB 價格的 200% 每日槓桿敞口，這與基金的投資目標一致。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Berto Acquisition Corp. II is a blank check company, formed for the purpose of effecting a merger, amalgamation, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, reorganization or similar business combination with one or more businesses. The company was founded on July 15, 2025 and is headquartered in Las Vegas, NV.

Iron Dome Acquisition I Corp. is a blank check company incorporated for the purpose of effecting a merger, amalgamation, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, reorganization or similar business combination with one or more businesses or entities. The company was founded on September 5, 2025 and is headquartered in New York, NY.

Jayud Global Logistics Ltd. is a holding company, which engages in the provision of cross-border supply chain solutions. It offers freight forwarding services, supply chain management, and other value-added services. The company operated through People's Republic of China & Hong Kong, and United States of America segments. Jayud Global Logistics was founded by Xiao Gang Geng in September 2009 and is headquartered in Shenzhen, China.

Maze Therapeutics, Inc. is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company, which engages in harnessing the power of human genetics to develop novel, small molecule precision medicines for patients living with renal, cardiovascular, and related metabolic, or CVRM diseases. Its pipeline includes the Compass platform, which allows it to identify and characterize genetic variants in disease and then link those variants to the biological pathways that drive disease in specific patient groups through a process to refer a variant functionalization. The company was founded by Mark Daly, Aaron D. Gitler, Stephen Elledge, Sekar Kathiresan, and Jonathan S. Weissman on August 29, 2017 and is headquartered in San Francisco, CA.

MongoDB, Inc. engages in the development and provision of a general-purpose database platform. The firm's products include MongoDB Enterprise Advanced, MongoDB Atlas, and Community Server. It also offers professional services including consulting and training. The company was founded by Eliot Horowitz, Dwight A. Merriman, Kevin P. Ryan, and Geir Magnusson Jr. in 2007 and is headquartered in New York, NY.

PurePlay Nvidia Ecosystem Picks & Shovels Index ETF seeks to track the performance of a rules-based index designed to provide targeted, passive exposure to global public companies representing the full upstream and downstream value chain enabling Nvidia Corporation to manufacture, assemble, deploy, and operate high-performance computer systems. The fund employs a thematic supply-chain selection methodology using FactSet relationship data and a 50% revenue contribution threshold across six designated functional pillars to capture the physical infrastructure behind artificial intelligence deployment, while explicitly avoiding direct equity investments in shares of Nvidia Corporation.
info.description_zh: PurePlay Nvidia Ecosystem Picks & Shovels Index ETF 旨在追蹤基於規則的指數的表現，該指數旨在為代表整個上游和下游價值鏈的全球上市公司提供有針對性的被動投資，使 Nvidia Corporation 能夠製造、組裝、部署和運營高性能電腦系統。該基金採用主題供應鏈選擇方法，利用 FactSet 關係數據和跨六個指定功能支柱的 50% 收入貢獻門檻來捕獲人工智慧部署背後的實體基礎設施，同時明確避免對 Nvidia 公司股票的直接股權投資。

info.description: Invesco S&P SmallCap Information Technology ETF seeks to track the investment results (before fees and expenses) of the S&P SmallCap 600 Capped Information Technology Index. The fund generally will invest at least 90% of its total assets in the securities that comprise the index. Strictly in accordance with its guidelines and mandated procedures, S&P Dow Jones Indices, LLC compiles, maintains and calculates the index, which is designed to measure the performance of securities of small-capitalization U.S. companies in the information technology sector, as defined by the Global Industry Classification Standard.
info.description_zh: Invesco S&P SmallCap Information Technology ETF 旨在追蹤 S&P SmallCap 600 Capped Information Technology Index 的投資結果（扣除費用和開支）。該基金通常會將至少 90% 的總資產投資於構成該指數的證券。標普道瓊斯指數有限責任公司嚴格按照其指導方針和規定程序編制、維護和計算該指數，該指數旨在衡量全球行業分類標準所定義的信息技術領域美國小型公司的證券表現。

info.description: Quanterix Corp. engages in the development of ultra-sensitive digital immunoassay platform that advances precision health for life sciences research and diagnostics. Its products and services include Simoa Assay Kits, HD-X analyzer, SR-X Biomarker Detection System, SP-X Imaging and Analysis System, 2470 Arrayer, Simoa Accelerator Laboratory, Uman NF-Light, and Homebrew -Custom Assay Development. The company was founded by Nicholas J. Naclerio and David R. Walt in April 2007 and is headquartered in Billerica, MA.

Rapid7, Inc. engages in the provision of cyber security analytics and automation services. Its products include Metasploit, Nexpose, AppSpider, tCell by Rapid7, as well as insight platforms such as InsightDR, InsightIVM, InsightAppSec, InsightConnect, and InsightOps. The firm also offers security and product consulting services. The company was founded by Alan P. Matthews, Tas Giakouminakis, and Chad Loder in July 2000 and is headquartered in Boston, MA.
info.description_zh: Rapid7, Inc. 從事提供網路安全分析和自動化服務。其產品包括Metasploit、Nexpose、AppSpider、Rapid7的tCell，以及InsightDR、InsightIVM、InsightAppSec、InsightConnect和InsightOps等洞察平台。該公司還提供安全和產品諮詢服務。該公司由 Alan P. Matthews、Tas Giakouminakis 和 Chad Loder 於 2000 年 7 月創立，總部位於馬薩諸塞州波士頓。

info.description: Spero Therapeutics, Inc. is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company, which focuses on identifying, developing, and commercializing treatments involving bacterial infections, including multi-drug resistant bacterial infections, and rare diseases Its pipeline product candidates include Tebipenem HBr, SPR720, and SPR206. The company was founded by Ankit A. Mahadevia and Laurence Rahme in April 2013 and is headquartered in Cambridge, MA.
info.description_zh: Spero Therapeutics, Inc.是一家臨床階段的生物製藥公司，專注於識別、開發和商業化涉及細菌感染（包括多重抗藥性細菌感染）和罕見疾病的治療方法，其管道候選產品包括Tebipenem HBr、SPR720和SPR206。該公司由 Ankit A. Mahadevia 和 Laurence Rahme 於 2013 年 4 月創立，總部位於麻薩諸塞州劍橋。

info.description: 60 Degrees Pharmaceuticals, Inc. develops medicines for the treatment and prevention of infectious diseases. Its product Arakoda helps in the prevention of malaria. The company was founded by Geoffrey Dow on September 9, 2010 and is headquartered in Washington, DC.

T. Rowe Price Innovation Leaders ETF (TNXT) is an actively managed fund targeting long-term capital growth by investing in a diversified portfolio of companies identified as global leaders in disruptive innovation. The strategy integrates a top-down evaluation of secular growth trends with a fundamental bottom-up analysis to select 150 to 250 high-quality companies distinguished by advanced technologies, superior business models, and significant research and development expenditures.
info.description_zh: T. Rowe Price Innovation Leaders ETF (TNXT) 是一檔積極管理的基金，透過投資於被認定為全球顛覆性創新領導者的公司的多元化投資組合，實現長期資本成長。該策略將長期成長趨勢自上而下的評估與自下而上的基本分析相結合，選出150至250家以先進技術、卓越商業模式和大量研發支出為特色的優質公司。

The company was founded on June 3, 2025 and is headquartered in Singapore.
